reviews.title: Lee no longer has the quality control that is needed for consistent sizing and fabric make up
reviews.text:
Before you purchase any LEE Women's Relaxed Fit Straight Leg Jeans, check out the fabric mix. That is, they say this particular Jean is 98% cotton and 2% spandex, but this is NOT the case. I purchased three of these, same size, 3 different colors. WOW- there is NO, NOT ANY consistency in the actual measurements or fabric make up on these jeans. I found the ones made in Mexico are not made to specs at all.
The one's made in Egypt are great, and as described. I did luck out on 2 of the 3 pairs. Had to return the pair made in Mexico. Even though all 3 pants were the same size, the cut from the one's made in Mexico were 1.5" shorter inseam. Legs (each) were 1" too big on each leg. The material just immediately stretched out. Been buying these specific Lee Jeans for decades and these past few years to current, are so inconsistent in the measurements as well as the material. If Lee is making the same jean, why does each color have a different fabric mix? Why are the one's made in Mexico, not cut/sized as described? Shouldn't this particular model of Lee Jeans be consistent in sizing and fabric content, no matter the color or where it is made.

reviews.title: Just the jeans I was looking for!
reviews.text:
I had been looking for a pair of jeans that would be appropriate for a 45+year old woman. These fit the bill beautifully!!!
I have donated more pants over the last year than I care to think about. Why? Because most of today's women's casual pants are low riders. I wanted a pair of pants that fit at the waist and these do. They are incredibly durable and comfortable. The supplier was prompt in delivery. I was so happy with these jeans I ordered another pair. My only wish is that they came in a khaki shade. I opted for black. They wash and hang out beautifully. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.title: Recommend.
reviews.text:
Fantastic fit for this size 16 woman. I ordered the short length and they are just right. I'm 5"4'.
I'm in my fifties and these are really working well. I have full thighs, behind and a belly. These are hugging me in a flattering way, without being tight at all. In the past I've bought Lee pants/jeans that were way too big in the waist or just too loose.

These are really nice looking.

reviews.title: Brand look-alike? Lee has NEVER cut women's jeans the same way as men's
reviews.text:
I have been buying and wearing Lee Jeans for about 30 years now so I would say that I know the brand pretty well. The last 2 times that I have purchased Lee Jeans here they have had a very funky fit. The hip and upper thigh is tight while the waistline is enormous. I am a curvy woman - my waist is smaller than my hips and so I don't wear men's jeans because of the straight hip to waist cut, the waistline just bags on me while the hip is snug. These jeans fit like that.

Lee has NEVER cut women's jeans the same way as men's, that's why I have worn them all these years. I am highly suspicious of brand look-alike here. I think that the jeans that I got were not actually made by Lee. They don't look like Lee, they don't fit like Lee, and so I have returned them. I guess I won't be buying Lee Jeans here if I can't be sure of what I am getting.

This is the second time that I've had this happen buying Lee Jeans from Amazon. Interestingly enough I have purchased Lee Jeans that fit just right (as expected) from Amazon as well, and recently too.

reviews.text: I purchased these because I have an identical pair that are probably four years old and are starting to look faded. reviews.title: Leggings?
reviews.text: If at first you don't succeed... My attempt to buy jeans before this one left me very unhappy with that item's wholly unpredictable fit, so I returned those and ordered these. I've ordered this item before with good results but the color I like has been unavailable, so I broke down and finally ordered them in another color. Well boy howdy, I might as well have not bothered. The fit in the waist and hip is good and true to the provided size chart, but the legs are skin tight like leggings -- not at all correct for relaxed fit straight leg. So these are being returned too, and though I know I should "try again" I'm becoming very wary.

reviews.title: My favorite jeans

I'm 5'8 30inch inseam and the length hits right on the top of my sneakers. reviews.title: Awesome Fleece.
reviews.text: When I look at reviews for clothing items, I like to see reviews that include the reviewers size, only because ordering clothes online can be difficult , and as we all know, manufacturers sizing belongs to their own, so a large on one product is more like a medium, etc etc... So I'll start out with that first... I'm 6 ft, with a 48 chest and 36-38 waist. My dress shirts have an arm length of about 34-35. The distance from the bottom of my neck/throat to my waist line is about 21-22 inches. And I weigh about 235 pounds. The XL sized fleece, which is the size I normally get in everything.... Was perfect for me. Plenty of chest room, arm room, and more than enough mid-section room, and I tried this one with just a thin under armour shirt on. I should add that the fleece does go below my specific waist line, approx 3-4 inches, which is a plus of course because I don't like jackets and fleeces that just end right at the waistline. After I wear some layers underneath, it can only be a better fit. I have to point out, I don't like tight jackets and this isn't one of them. So I hope this helps with sizing, at least with someone close to my size. As far as quality, no shortcuts taken.…

reviews.title: Felt, not fleece
reviews.text: While the cut and stitching are good, the fabric is not really fleece, but rather a kind of felt: "A cloth or stuff made of matted fibers... fulled or wrought into a compact substance by rolling and pressure ... without spinning or weaving." The inside fibers are loose, not firmly attached: I can pinch them into a clump with my fingers. I attach photos comparing this coat with my 10 year old Columbia fleece. I wondered if this is one of the counterfeits people mentioned. This review describes the fabric, with a photo of the interior that looks like what I received: "The inner face of the fabric has a felt-like feel that’s very soft and the outside is a low-pile shaggy fleece (think Mountain Hardwear Monkey Man, but less shaggy). ... After a couple weeks of wear and two nights on the trail, the Steens Mountain is still in great shape, even with me: a notorious spiller and snagger." Perhaps it is actually o.k.?

reviews.title: Great quality, looser, relaxed fit
reviews.text:
I just tried it on and really like it. Great quality. The collar can be zipped up or it can lay flat like a traditional jacket. The large size fits me great. I like the strong and thick elastic near the wrists. (The sleeves don't just hang.) It's a little loose in the chest and arms, but that's fine with me, as I like a more relaxed fit. The two interior pockets are pretty loose, but are deep and would hold a lot.

To give a better idea of the fit, I'm 6'3" and 185-190 lbs. So, tall and skinny with long legs. If the length of the torso material was any shorter, I'd search for a size large tall. I hope this helps someone :-)

reviews.title: Perfectly Sized and Comfortable Jacket Provides Just The Right Amount of Warmth
reviews.text:
I ordered this jacket a couple days before a group hike up Icehouse Canyon in the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument. I knew it would be cold and would likely be raining on the hike and didn't want to freeze. I already had a Columbia waterproof windbreaker but wanted more warmth than a windbreaker could provide and didn't want to get overheated.

When the jacket arrived, I was surprised by how well it fit. After reading all those reviews saying the jacket ran large, I wasn't sure what I'd get. But it fit perfectly and I took it on my hike up Icehouse Canyon. We eventually encountered a cold rain as expected but the Columbia Men's Steens Fleece Jacket kept me warm, even though my "waterproof" windbreaker was completely saturated. I was very satisfied by the way it fit underneath the windbreaker (first photo).

I've also used this jacket for snow hikes like Mt Baden Powell (second photo) and it performed well. My only gripe with this jacket and the reason I deducted one star, is that the jacket is somewhat bulky and seems to take up the entire backpack when you're not wearing it.

Overall, this is an excellent jacket for cool weather hikes if you don't mind how bulky it…

reviews.title: COUNTERFEIT JACKET SOLD!
reviews.text:
First, I'm writing this review almost 2 months late here due to having an extremely busy holiday season, so I haven't had the chance to bother filing a return when I immediately noticed the new jacket I purchased is not the same quality as my old official Columbia jacket I still own. But I'm so frustrated with this loss, that at least I can leave a review to let others know the downgrade of this jacket.

**In the photo: Fake Jacket (Left Side) and Official Jacket (Right Side)

I own the same Columbia Jacket bought 5 years ago and still have it, and it's amazing! This new jacket I've received, the fleece material has a thin, see-through, cheap knock-off feel. The original has a heavier-denser fleece material. The main front logo on the new jacket is a tag stitched on the wearer's left side versus official embroidered logo on the wearers right side. The original side pocket zipper zips upwards to open. The new jacket side pocket zips downwards to open. The original has a bungee cord to tighten the bottom jacket's waist level, and this new one doesn't have any bungee cord (this could be a product change feature though).

reviews.title: Four Shirts Compared
reviews.text:
I bought four red t-shirts (different brands and sizes) at the same time in order to compare them for size, quality, and comfort. This Dickies shirt was the best of the four and I will switch to buying these for my husband's t-shirts. Here are the details: I ordered two Hanes Tagless (a Hanes XL shirt, plus another in Large, in order to compare the sizes), one Russell Athletic (in Large), and one Dickies (in Large). Large is my husband's usual size, but based on other reviews, I didn't know if the Hanes Large would fit well. As expected, the Hanes Large size is 1.5 inches smaller than this Dickies shirt (shoulder to shoulder) and 1 inch smaller than the Russell Athletic shirt. In fact, the Hanes EXTRA-LARGE and this Dickies LARGE were exactly the same size. This Dickies shirt fits my husband a little loosely, which is exactly as he likes his shirts.

Quality-wise, both of the Hanes shirts were far inferior to this Dickies shirt and the Russell Athletic shirt. Of all four shirts, the fabric of this Dickies shirt was very soft to the touch, and very supple -- no scratchiness at all -- thus much more comfortable to wear. It is by far my husband's favorite. One of the Hanes shirts is…

reviews.title: Great fit for a big and tall person
reviews.text:
My SO often has difficulty finding shirts that fit well because he is big and tall (6'5''), not one or the other. The problem is that shirts often are too short and ride-up when he raises his arms, even if the rest of the shirt fits well. This one fits well - there's no obvious ride-up. There's really not a whole lot to say - it's a shirt! It fits well, it's comfortable, and the fabric appropriately soft.

Edit: I forgot to mention that he purchased an XLT version of the shirt. So, if you are both tall and big, make sure you purchase the "T" size.

reviews.text: This is the second Dickies t-shirt I have purchased from Amazon. The first one tore in the armpit area, this one near the waist. It’s not really a tear, it’s just bad sewing and no quality control. Each of them were wore just once, then washed and hung on hanger to dry. The weight and material are nice, just very poor sewing. reviews.title: Great for HOT BLOODED ladies.  Look great without looking over heated!
reviews.text:
Check out Grandma in her Women's T-shirt. She's rockin it and Grandpa's loving it! Grandma is shown wearing a large. I ordered her normal size to make sure that Grandma was comfortable in her shirt. She was and she loved it!

This turned out to be a very nice womanly fit. Not a snug fitting junior style, but shorter sleeves and some curve to it, it's a nice fitting t-shirt without out it looking manly! These shirts arrived as expected.
My favorite quality is that these shirts REALLY ARE BREATHABLE. They do wear cooler than most cotton t-shirt. I put it on not expecting a large difference, but it's there. And for a mama bear that gets HOT.....this is a great t-shirt!
They are reasonably soft (about a 8 on the scale of 1-10)
Softly shaped womanly fit
Nice round neckline
Crisp clean color.
No off-white yellow color.
I'd order them again.

reviews.title: CURVY GIRLS PLEASE READ.
reviews.text:
I am 5'5, 38D and 180 pounds with an hourglass body. My hips are much wider in compared to my waist. I usually stick to a large in any women's top and it always works out. However, I am disappointed in this. First off, the chest fits more tightly than a t shirt should. The hip area is VERY form fitting. Overall, I would suggest to size up at least one size if you have a curvy body.

Also, let's talk material. It's NOT soft at all. Do not listen to any reviews here. I'll save you the time. You are paying for a $5 HANES t-shirt. The quality won't be great, so don't expect it to hold up after 1-2 washes.

Overall? Sending back my tees I ordered. You can go to much better stores, even Target's Universal Thread for a $5 tee with much softer material.

reviews.title: Too snug
reviews.text: I returned the t-shirt. I am 5'4", 135 pounds, normally wear a size 10 or medium, but this t-shirt was very snug around my hips. I asked my husband, "Have I become a "large" woman??" He laughed and assured me not. I'm 65 years old and not into body-hugging clothes, and this Tee was just not gonna make it for me.

reviews.title: Decent tee, not worth the price when purchased in bulk
reviews.text: I purchased ten of these shirts after trying various other brands of women's bulk tee shirts and being disappointed. Due to the fact that these are sold individually, my costs were higher than I would have preferred, but I assumed based on the pictures that this would be worth it. These tee shirts are not as pictured. In the photo of the white tee it looks like it is made of a thicker fabric than ordinary tee shirts, and this is why I purchased them. However, these shirts are as thin as any other cheap tee shirt that you might find out there, which I know because I have purchased several kinds of those shirts while trying to find something thicker. The white shirt is transparent to the point of being inappropriate when worn alone and would need to be worn as a layer. That said, there are several redeeming qualities for this shirt. The first is that they make an excellent undershirt and are very thin and breathable for that purpose. The second is that they are cut as a woman's tee shirt rather than a man's and this makes a big difference. Overall, I would say that this is an okay tee shirt, but probably not worth the money if you are buying them in bulk.

reviews.title: Good for price
reviews.text: Got it for my girlfriend to make a custom shirt and was a bit small but good for the price

reviews.title: I would not recommend. Invest in a higher quality item. Feels like a $9 item.
reviews.text: I am not happy with this product at all. I've bought cheap things made in china via ebay with no real brand, that's what this feels like. Branding is vague and tag has little information just brand and size. The tag on the item is a thin piece of material with the "brand" cheaply sewn on at the ends. The material is really thin and easily stretched. I feel like this is a $9 item you would find on the Wish App. An app that does cheap Chinese imports. The buttons are cheap plastic. The shawl collar has no defined crease and you'll adjust frequently through out the day. Coming back to the thinness of the fabric if you put something like a phone in the pockets it will sag. I can see the pockets stretching and sagging with frequent use. With cleaning this item you will have to set it on a flat surface over a towel if you hang to dry it will stretch out. I've come to expect high quality items from amazon for good prices. This is just the opposite. There's a reason it's cheap and even then I think it's over priced. Please if you have the money invest in a higher quality item.

reviews.title: nice sweater. I am 6'4" 240 with a bit ...
reviews.text: reat price, nice sweater. I am 6'4" 240 with a bit of a pot belly and this sweater fits great even though it says "slim fit" just like the majority of sweaters that are sold on amazon, nice sweaters. I'm right at the cusp of XL and XXL so depending on the maker of the sweater and what country it's made in the fit could go either way, but 2X is usually the winner, especially if it's from China. But with this sweater 2XL fits just right. If I didn't take a chance on buying "slim fit" sweaters I would be missing out.

reviews.title: I'm more of a stocky/thick build with much wider shoulders/chest/back than waste and this fits me very well in the chest ...
reviews.text: I'm really surprised this doesn't have more 5 star reviews. I'm guessing it's due to the word "slim fit" yet the skinny guys are still finding it big. I'll say that relatively speaking, this isn't a true "slim fit". I'd say it's more of an athletic fit more than anything. I'm more of a stocky/thick build with much wider shoulders/chest/back than waste and this fits me very well in the chest area. It's not too tight on me which is a sign that it's not a true slim, generally because true slim fit clothing I need to go 1 size up to accommodate the smaller chest/back widths. I always buy slim fit suits, go up 1 or even 2 chest width sizes, then hem everything to fit. With this cardigan, no alterations would be needed. I just purchased two more I like it so much. Hopefully the QC is good and the next 2 fit just as well.

reviews.title: Worth it even for just a season if you can get it to last
reviews.text:
I was generally very happy with how this cardigan looked. Got several compliments and really loved the slim fit of it. As a 6'1" slim dude with long arms, it actually fit very well down to my wrists. It actually was pleasantly longer in the arms than expected. That perfect length of, "Extra length for bending your arms, but not overly long." Longer-armed dudes might be familiar with long-sleeved shirts/sweaters that fit OK if your arms are straight down, but pull up uncomfortably the moment you move them around.

CONS: There was a LOT of fuzz. I know this is a relatively cheaper cardigan. Although it looks very good, the overall material quality is mostly what you would expect. I had several busted threads under one of my arms that I noticed the very first time I put it on. Since I like the cardigan so much though, I'm just having it replaced and crossing my fingers that the other one at least lasts a season.

My other minor complaint is that the shawl collar seems to have trouble staying 'folded back'. IE: moving around tends to mess it up or 'thin' it out. Instead of being double-backed fully in the pictures, it kind of only goes halfway there, if that makes any sense. I have…

reviews.text: i wasn't expecting much considering how cheap this cardigan was, but it still was not worth the money. The material is so thin that you can see the color/design of my shirt through this cardigan. I also find the sleeves to be disproportionate to the size of the cardigan. they were tighter than normal and needed to be forced over the long sleeves of a dress shirt. Based on the feel of the fabric, I can't see this lasting more than 3-4 washings. It's going back.

reviews.title: ... after wearing it a few times has been very comfortable and good quality
reviews.text: Item fit as described and so far after wearing it a few times has been very comfortable and good quality. Good deal for the price, and I look good in it.

reviews.title: I call it my "Mr. Rogers" sweater and I might be a much nicer person when I wear it.
reviews.text: I bought this sweater because I was invited to talk about Mr. Rogers and I thought it would be cool to wear a cardigan. Why this brand? Because of the extremely low price. I knew that if I didn't like it, I hadn't invested all that much. Well, it's become my #1 favorite sweater. Why? Because it fits (the XL is really an XL and it is stretchy); because it looks good; because it's easy to wash and dry, and because it buttons down the front so I don't have to take off my glasses, pull it over my head, and then comb my hair each time I put it on. Also, as a college professor I think it makes me look, well, like a college professor. And, just maybe, I'm a nicer person when I wear my "Mr. Rogers" sweater.

reviews.title: Good looking, Fit true to size, Great color
reviews.text:
I ordered the charcoal cardigan and it arrived much quicker than expected. It took about 3 days on standard shipping. I was underwhelmed when opening it as the packaging seemed like I bought it for a dollar at Conway. However when I took it out of the plastic container it was great, The material was light and soft and the fit was perfect. I'm 5'11 and well built and the the medium size fit perfectly.

Only thing that could have made it better was if the collar had a stiffer fold or a hard plastic in it to hold it in place, it unfolds and asks for a mirror to get that perfect fold. However if you aren't walking through NYC in the wind like me, it should be perfectly fine.

reviews.title: Comparison of 3 shirts/brands

I like all three of the shirts for quality and comfort, with small difference in each that may make a difference for you.

Fruit of the Loom - I bought black, and it's definitely black. The fabric is the heaviest (thick but also a little stiff) of all three shirts. It fits like an Under Armour shirt, which is to say athletic -- the sleeves are tight and it's fitted in the chest. The sleeves are long enough to reach my wrists without pulling up.

Hanes Adult Tagless Long Sleeve Tee (this shirt) - the black is a little on the Navy Blue side. The fabric is lighter, but not thin, and soft. There is a little extra room through the body and sleeves; it feels fitted, but not tight. The sleeves are long enough to reach my wrists without pulling up.

Gildan Men's G240 Ultra Cotton Long…

reviews.title: Durable, good fit, summer and winter necessity for me - second purchase and will buy again
reviews.text:
Second time purchased, wearing one right now.

I buy these for summer - reduce skin exposure when outside gardening and such. I buy them for winter when I want to layer-up. They are excellent fit - XL for me - and they are really XL, not L or XXL! They look good enough for wear under an unbuttoned shirt or alone.

No tag - I hate those things scratching the back of the neck. They are also long enough that when tucked in - they stay tucked.

For summer, they wick the sweat well and don't make me overheat like some non cotton shirt may.. The sleeves also have good elasticity so when I push them up, they stay up and don't then sag and drag in the future. I don't like baggy, saggy, sleeves either and these shirts keep doing the job there.

Another problem with some long sleeve tees is the arms are too tight and after a while wearing they harass the hair on the arms. Not a big thing to suffer, but it is a reason to take it off after a while. These shirts are good fit on the forearms and don't fight too tight.

They clean up well enough after gardening or dropping some bbq sauce or whatever down the front as well. Little extra shot of liquid soap on a spot and the cotton seems to release…

reviews.title: Great quality and priced right!!!!
reviews.text: These Hanes longsleeve shirts definitely keep you warm whether it's worn as an undershirt or worn alone. Look great tucked in or left out. They are soft and true to their size. Hold up great after repeated washing and drying with no shrinkage. Great quality and priced right. Just what you expect from Hanes.

reviews.title: Good but not Great.......
reviews.text: I received my four long sleeve t-shirts last week. I had hopes that the 6.1 once weight would be thicker than what arrived. My bad. After washing, their softness was good but not great. When it comes to underwear, I'm picky I guess. Next time I'll order another product but will keep these and use them because they are good........just not great. Just remembered something.........I usually wear a medium size and ordered so on these........but they were tight on me so maybe order one size bigger than usual. Just my experience.

reviews.title: sized to fit no one
reviews.text: I have worn Hanes Men's T-shirts for years, and they have always fit me very well. Now Hanes is marketing this so-called Adult T-shirt instead of a Men's T-shirt. It is supposed to fit both sexes, but I find that it fits neither sex properly. It still has the Hanes quality materials and construction, but the body fits like a tube sock (way too tight) while the underarm section bags and looks stupid. I am disappointed that I can no longer count on Hanes for a properly fitted T-shirt.

reviews.title: Nah! x 2
reviews.text: One sleeve was 3 inches longer than the other. In other words, one sleeve was 3 inches shorter than the other. Plus, the cotton is so rough I can use it to polish the silver. So I purchased a second one of these shirts in 12/2022, and the fabric is perfect...for scrubbing hard-to-remove dead skin on one's body, or baked in food on a frying pan.

reviews.title: Great ventalation in the arm pit!
reviews.text: I have owned Hanes products for as long as i can remember and they have been exceptional quility and longevity, but these shirts are the complete opposite, i purchased 5 long sleeve orange shirts for work, and cycle through them as needed. Every single shirt has developed holes in the arm pits ranging from a finger to a fist size hole. I purchased these in September, less then 6 months ago. I have never been so disappointed in a peice of clothing then i am with these shirts.

reviews.title: Buy one in every color!
reviews.text: This is my THIRD "color" of this dress this summer. I have worn all three to weddings and strangers were stopping me to compliment me on my dress. Classy, fun and timeless. Don't skip the petticoat and you'll bring down the house!

reviews.title: 1950s housewife dresses
reviews.text:
These dresses were purchased for a show choir performance. We have 30 girls, with varying sizes from XS to XXL. The dress did not come in a large enough size for a couple of girls, but we bought 2 dresses, split them at the side seams, and sewed in a piece of fabric from the 2nd dress from under the arm to the bottom hem. With the pattern we chose it was not noticeable at all. We added 1.5" red satin ribbon at the waist and a red petticoat. When paired with boys dressed in black suits with white shirts and red ties the look was stunning on stage.

Because there was a cinching at the waist (whether black belt that came with it, or red ribbon we sewed on at the back zipper) the waist fit in every case. The bodice fit all girls well, with the exception of one girl it was just too big on. Because there were vertical seams over the bust we were able to easily take in the dress through the bust for a final perfect fit.

reviews.title: Omg this dress with a petticoat was so pretty. The fit was perfect
reviews.text: Omg this dress with a petticoat was so pretty. The fit was perfect. I looked like a southern charm

reviews.title: I Loved It So Much I'm Ordering More!
reviews.text:
[[VIDEOID:9ed40cf70509f57ff73b8f941314ea89]] It is impossible to accurately describe how much I love this dress. Being of a larger size, I don't typically order clothing over the internet (too many body shape issues to deal with). When I saw this dress, I just had to take the chance. I followed the manufacturer's sizing chart (the one included in the photos) an ordered the 1XPlus. My measurements are 45" bust, 39" waist and I am 190 pounds. Imagine my delight when it arrived and I anxiously tried it on to find it fit perfectly. Whew! What a relief! Even the thin belt included was long enough.

The dress fabric is wonderful with a good weight to it and enough spandex to make it fit comfortably. The included belt is thin and flocked on the top. Heavy people don't usually like thin belts, but this one didn't look too bad. You can always purchase a wider belt for it. I see some people complained about the length of the belt since there are no belt loops to hold the extra length in place. The belt is made of a rubber material and looks to me like you could simply snip off the end. Or make a ribbon strap around it to hold it down.

You don't "need" a petticoat with this,…

reviews.title: WARNING Read who the seller is!!!
reviews.text: This is more a warning review! I ordered this dress originally in a large after reading other reviews as I am 5'9" and 150lbs but when I received the dress it had at least 2 extra inches in the waist. Other than the size I LOVED the dress; the cotton felt great and the shape was wonderful (posted picture of original dress). I have no idea how to sew so I decided to send it back and reorder the same dress in a medium. When it arrived I was so excited but as soon as I opened it I felt it was NOT the same dress. The second dress was mostly a polyester material and so thin you could see my tattoo on my stomach through the material and the sewing was terrible and uneven. I contacted the seller multiple times and he wouldn't tell me why the material was wrong. Finally after reading a little further I missed a warning in the description that states to MAKE sure you're buying from GK Queen as others are imitation and lower quality. I went backed and looked and sure enough the second time I bought was from some Aikan. So frustrated right now I'm just giving up on the dress as I've had nothing but bad luck with it.

reviews.title: It's a beautiful dress I loved it at first sight
reviews.text: I followed the product review and ordered a size bigger and it fit perfectly. It's a beautiful dress I loved it at first sight.

reviews.title: Amazing, so thankful for a good purchase
reviews.text:
Perfect dress at a perfect price. We are just thrilled with this purchase! How often does price, fit, form, design, and quick delivery come together? Not often enough! This time the stars were aligned. We ordered this dress for a dance. We ordered the size large. The dress fits our daughter perfectly. Her measurements are:

Bust 36 inches
Waist 35 inches
Height 5 ft 9 inches
Weight 157 pounds.

It comes just to her knees. We have a tulle underskirt that adds bounce and completes the full skirt design. It is a very high waisted dress. We choose to not use the belt at all. I added photos of the dress. Some are silly!

reviews.title: A new favorite!
reviews.text:
This dress has become my favorite wardrobe item since I ordered it a week or two ago. The fabric is a thick, unlined cotton that, although it doesn't feel like a ball gown, is very comfortable and feels nice enough that I'm confident wearing it to formal events. The cut is very flattering to someone with a pear-shaped figure, and especially when paired with a petticoat it is enough to make you feel cute as heck! If you're already considering it, this is definitely a dress I would recommend.

The one and only down side to me is the cleaning requirements for this dress. When it arrived in the mail the tag said "dry clean" (but not "dry clean only"), which as a starving college student was almost a deal breaker for me. Still I was so in love with the style that, after reading more of the reviews, I decided to try hand washing the dress in cold water and- voila! It worked perfectly without any color loss, stretching, or shrinking, and even when put through a cold cycle in the washing machine it works perfectly so long as you lay it flat to dry rather than tumble drying it. It means that a little more time goes into cleaning the dress than usual, but it honestly IS worth…

reviews.title: My favorite flannels.
reviews.text: I've been buying these for the last few years. They don't pill in the wash and are long enough to cover my back side while wearing leggings. The fabric isn't too heavy or too light. I feel like I need to talk about sizing though as it's changed. If you are buying the US sizing buy your normal size if you want it to fit right. I personally like my flannel a little longer to wear with leggings so I buy it one size bigger. I am a 5'5" 145lbs 34D normally a size medium in shirts. With the way the sizing is now I buy a large for the oversized look a medium for a normal fit. If you go with the old Asian sizing you need to go way up in size I buy US10/12-5XL and it fits the same as the Large US sizing. I hope that helps some that are confused about the sizing. If you buy an 5XL that doesn't say US-10/12 5XL you will get a 5XL shirt.

reviews.title: FYI I'm petite, sm bust, light weight & short
reviews.text:
So I read other reviews and a lot of people ordered a size up. I am 96lbs abd 5.1 and would normally wear a small.
I ordered a medium and it fits like a large meds t-shirt. Probably my own fault, but as far as the shirt itself. The quality and durability is actually much better than I expected. I will keep it anyways, even if it's a but big. Good purchase. May want to just stick with the regular sizing when ordering this product.

reviews.title: It's a men's flannel.
reviews.text: It's a men's flannel shirt. Heavy and thick. It is not contoured as the image indicated. It is wide and large, but not long like a tunic at all. Terrible. Returning.

reviews.title: Perfect Fit- Misleading Reviews
reviews.text:
I'm not sure if they've updated the size chart since some of the past reviews but my shirt fit perfectly. I am 5'4" and 140 pounds with an athletic build and I ordered a Medium, which couldn't fit better. When I purchased this I didn't even read the reviews. It wasn't until I went back to look at it as I was waiting for it to arrive that I started to get nervous that it wouldn't fit, based on a lot of the reviews, but that wasn't the case at all! If you are normally a size medium, get the medium!
The material is very nice too! Which I was surprised by considering it's very cheap. It's a very tick flannel. I ordered the green one and love the colors. The shirt is also long too which I really wanted to that I could wear it with leggings and boots and have it cover my butt and it definitely does.
There is an option to pin it open too so that it's form fitting along your waistline or button it all the way up, both of which look great. I am very very happy with this shirt and ordering another in a different color! I would definitely recommend, great material, great coloring and very true to size.

reviews.title: way too long
reviews.text:
WAY too long. It still didn't look right when as long as a dress. It was closer to my knees than hips. Would have been perfect if it wasn't so long.

**Please help and select if this review was helpful!

reviews.title: Flannel is the color of my energy!
reviews.text:
This is clearly a dude that bought a woman’s flannel. I’m thin, so this method works quite well a lot of the time.

Shirt fits great! It’s longer than the typical male flannel fit, but it’s great for me. The arms are slim and not baggy at all, the collar is great. The chest pocket buttons aren’t actually functional, but that’s not a problem.

My only complaint would be the color was a little more pink than I was anticipating. But it still looks and feels great. I’ll be picking up more colors for sure!

reviews.title: Cute shoes, but didn't last long.
reviews.text: I really liked these shoes when I got them. Unfortunately, the rubber at the bottom of the sole started separating after the second wear and then one of the straps ripped at about the fifth wear.

reviews.title: Pleased with my purchase
reviews.text: [[VIDEOID:a49595f3fc0a38cfff4bf38541fe85bc]] I ordered an XL after reading through the reviews. In total I ordered 8 for work. I’m 6ft tall and curvy I needed something that was business casual, comfortable, and something that covered my butt being that I wear leggings to work and I’m the only female in my department. I’m pleased with this purchase and the quality is good the shirts material is thick and seems like it will last a long time.

reviews.title: Product arrived timely and fits as expected. However, ...
reviews.text: Product arrived timely and fits as expected. However, the image displayed it as a square bottom shirt and it was listed under the square bottom category, it is NOT a square bottom shirt - it is a standard shirt with a curved tail.

reviews.title: Wrangler Authentics Men's Short Sleeve Shirt
reviews.text: This shirt was supposed to be 100% cotton, some are and some are not, depends on the color. The pumice stone colored shirts are 100% cotton. The green colored shirt were 60% cotton and 40% polyester. I try to buy only 100% cotton shirts and these are sold as that. I have purchased these shirts in the past and the ones I received then were all 60% cotton, 40% percent polyester. I thought the material problem might have been corrected since it has been over a year, but is has not. I like the shirt but since I cannot rely on the material I might receive I cannot give it more then 3 stars.

reviews.title: Nice Cut and Quality Material
reviews.text: I marked the fit as "Somewhat Large" because it has more room in it than most of the work shirts on the market right now, but I'm gonna blame that on the "skinny jeans" craze that seems to be hanging around and creeping it's way into shirts as well. It's not overly huge, just nicely proportioned and roomy so it's not tight and clingy which is something I can't stand. I typically wear an XL and this fits just a tad bigger than most of my other XL work shirts, but not to where a L would have been a better choice. It's super soft and comfortable and made of quality fabric so it's going to hold up well. It's my new fave shirt!

reviews.title: A nice enough shirt, but not a 'work' shirt
reviews.text: Meh. This is an OK shirt, but since they market it as a 'work' shirt, I'm going to quibble a little. The XL that I bought fits closer to a Large than most of the other work shirts I own - work clothing should be cut so that you can layer a t-shirt underneath. The material is a little on the flimsy side for workwear, in my humble opinion. The biggest failing of this shirt, however, are the pockets. They're much too petite to be suitable for a work shirt, where you need to be able to actually put things in them and then maybe button the pocket closed. You can't even fit an iPhone 5 in these pockets and then button them, so it's hardly even a suitable work shirt for a hipster. 'Authentic'? Not even close, Wrangler, sorry.

reviews.title: Easy-To-Care, Attractive, Stylish Burgundy 100% Cotton Short-Sleeve Shirt that Coordinates Well with Jeans!
reviews.text:
I love this Wrangler Men’s Authentics Short-Sleeve Classic Woven Shirt. I wear large T-shirts, polos, henleys, etc., and this short-sleeve shirt fit me perfectly. It felt as though it was tailor-made for my physique. I am a 52-year-old, nonathletic Caucasian male who stands barely 5’ 8” and weighs approximately 180 pounds. (I’m pudgy.) The shirt is comfortable around my shoulders and arms; there is ample room for me to move them around; I don’t feel as though I am in bondage because the shirt is too tight. Also, the shirt hangs well around my bulging paunch.

 The shirt is not fitted for athletically built men. It is for the everyday guy. I’ve worn it to church and work and received compliments. My coworker, Eric, laughed and said, “You’re dressed like a GS-15.” (A GS-15 is a department supervisor who normally makes over $100,000 a year.) I usually wear novelty T-shirts such as “Hard Rock Café” or “Life is Good.” This Wrangler shirt is burgundy, which is my favorite color. Every car I’ve owned has been burgundy. I have quite a few burgundy shirts. The Wrangler shirt coordinates well with my dark blue jeans and my black jeans.

 I wore it to my church where we dress casually.…

reviews.title: My new favorite shirt. The only downside is the size of ...
reviews.text: My new favorite shirt. The only downside is the size of the two pockets. Big enough for a pack of smokes, but not quite tall/deep enough to hold my eyeglasses and button the pocket. Fabric is comfortable, size was right on for me, and the shirt is real comfortable to wear. I'll be getting a couple more in other colors, too. Good price.

reviews.title: Runs large, good value
reviews.text: Fit is large and very casual; very impressed with the quality of the shirt for the price. I've been wearing this weekly for several months, and it shows no signs of wear. The only negative is the fit is incongruous with the materials and style of the shirt; it fits like breezy beach wear, but is made from a heavy cotton and has an outdoorsy/work-wear look.

reviews.title: My new favorite shirt
reviews.text: This shirt is awesome. It's a little bit TOO casual for work, but I like it. I think i'll wear it anyway, maybe after I get a couple more to match. I have a casual button up shirt that was a 4X and it fit me well and another that's a 2X and doesn't fit. For this one, I decided to try 3X and I was really uncertain about it... but it was much larger than expected. It doesn't feel like a 3X at all, it feels much larger. I'm a heavy guy with a fairly big belly and the shirt fits me really nicely in that round area where most other shirts don't. It's length seems perfect. However, the top of the shirt kind of hangs -- there's a lot of extra fabric there, like it was made for a bigger muscle-bound guy or something. It still looks good though. I'm probably going to have it altered to remove the extra fabric at the top, which I'm hoping will make it look even better. This is my new favorite shirt now. Highly recommended. But if you're the type who is tempted to go a size or two bigger "just in case", just be aware that you probably shouldn't do that with these Wrangler shirts. I'm definitely going to be buying more of these.

reviews.title: OMG LOVE THIS; PERFECT FIT!
reviews.text: OMG I LOVE THIS JACKET! Totally surprised and the look, fit and feel! Seems like so many times things are super small or tight, etc but this jacket was PERFECT! I browsed many, many moto jackets on Amazon and settled on this one. I am beyond excited with this purchase. I normally wear a Medium to Large shirt and a Large jacket (I'm broad-shouldered) so for this I ordered one size up to XL and the fit is perfect with either a cami or a light to medium weight sweater underneath. I know I'm raving...but I really must say again, LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this jacket!

reviews.title: Good looking jacket, great customer service
reviews.text:
**UPDATE**
I was not impressed with the original jacket I received and made it clear in my review. Today I received a replacement jacket free of charge from the seller. They improved the size and materials and I am very happy with the new jacket, and I am very impressed with the seller's above-and-beyond customer service. I am 5'7'' 140lbs and ordered a Large. It fits perfectly and looks great! Thank you!!!

reviews.title: Great purchase
reviews.text: I usually wear medium and i ordered a medium.. it perfectly! I adore it! Wonderful quality

reviews.title: 5’10” 200 lbs, 42” bust - 2x fits with a bit of room!
reviews.text:
I’m 5’10” and about 210 lbs. I usually fit 1x but I ordered a 2x based on the reviews. This jacket fits nicely! I’m 42 inches in the bust and I usually buy clothing according to that. The 2x says it fits up to 44” bust so, as expected this jacket is a bit roomy. I prefer a tighter fit for something like this but considering the season, I’m okay with this jacket being a bit big as it’s chilly in the Bay Area this time of year so there’s enough room under this coat to wear a cozy sweater. Overall, I’m pleased with the fit.

The actual *look* of this jacket is fine. I’m not crazy about it but I’m not disappointed at all. For $40, you get what you pay for. The fabric is a bit stiff, I feel that after continued use it will eventually peel in the way that faux leathers tend to do, but only time will tell! The zippers are smooth and there’s actual pockets on this jacket! Yay!

Since getting this jacket last week, I’ve actually worn it nearly every day. It’s a great staple and makes any outfit chic while maintaining practicality.

Overall, I say buy it. I’m probably going to order a few more jackets from this company in different styles based on the fit alone myself!

reviews.title: Unexpected wardrobe staple.
reviews.text: The jacket is small, Asian size. Even after ordering a size up, it's still hard to close over my boobs (34DDD). However, I must say, I love the way this looks. I originally got it for a Jessica Jones cosplay, but I wear it regularly when I go out. It's lightweight, so it's comfortable to wear to a restaurant or bar. I get compliments on it all of the time. It was also a good price so I am pleasantly surprised!

reviews.title: Runs small
reviews.text:
Cute as can be, but it runs small. Had to return.

Edited: I’m changing my review based on the seller’s amazing customer service. The seller contacted me and asked if they could do something to improve my experience. They offered to replace the coat with a larger size. I was leery, but I agreed. The XXL fits like an XL, but it looks amazing. It fits well. I’ve gotten so many great compliments while wearing it. And it’s all thanks to this great seller.

reviews.title: I love this jacket
reviews.text: I love this jacket! I got an XL and I usually wear an XL in my shirts. It can zip up with some room to spare. I'm only giving 4 stars because I wish the top pockets were actually pockets. The bottom pockets are true pockets, not too deep, but deep enough. The jacket is well made and all the zippers work! I do like all the zippers and buttons. Plus, I like that this style also had the belt on the bottom, as I was looking for one with a belt. You just have to pick a different "color". I think this one was black 2 or 6, I can't remember. So just look through the different colors to see different styles. Nice and warm too! I really love it!

reviews.title: A much needed fashion staple!
reviews.text: I’m so glad I purchased this jacket; got a MED. Had been on the lookout for a nice black leather jacket that wouldn’t break the bank. When I first opened the package, I thought it would be too small—I’m 5’7, 145lbs, but it’s seriously a perfect & comfortable fit. I had no issues moving around in it & had enough length in the arms (thought it would be tight). Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: The fit is a little snug, but I can deal with that. My problem is that it isn't the same skirt. The cut, print and even fabric seems different than the pic. Will not purchase from the same vendor again.

reviews.title: Some flaws and mixed feelings
reviews.text:
Packaging: The skirt came inside a bubble pack in a neat clear little zippered plastic pouch, clean and with zero wrinkles.

Size: I am 5'6" and about 34" at the stomach area, and the Large fits comfortably with no constricting. It is a long skirt, but since I am folding over the top panel (more on that below) it becomes about 4" shorter. Otherwise I would have needed to hem this for sure.

Material: This seems like a low-maintenance garment, although the tag recommends dry cleaning. It is 100% polyester, so it feels thick and isn't very breathable. At the same time it's very stretchy. While this is forgiving on curves, it also means even a dark patterned skirt becomes somewhat transparent across stretched areas of the fabric. (AKA a dark or patterned panty might show through, and you may want to wear a slip.)

Pattern/Colors: The pattern itself is a little different than I expected. In person, the "green leaves" fabric is a little more greenish/yellow tinted, with blues that aren't as rich as they look in the manufacturer's photo. I attached my own picture for reference. It's still an attractive print, but not as vibrant as I thought it would be.

Fit: The…

reviews.title: Five Stars
reviews.text: I love these skirts! I now have about 5 of them and have come back to look for more. The "Leave" and "Flower 2" are my favorites so far. they are soft and comfortable and make me feel good. I have gotten a few compliments on them too.

reviews.title: See through, cheap material.
reviews.text: The pattern is pretty, however the skirt is really see through. The material is thin and transparent, and I don't know who wears a hot slip underneath anymore. Besides that, the material shows every bump in your body (I'm slender and am ok with that) and a slip would add bulkiness and it wouldn't fit right. I plan on returning as it's just not wearable, a waste of money.

reviews.title: Love this dress
reviews.text: Sooooooo gorgeous. I plan on buying more colors. I'm 5'7", 155lbs and got a size medium. Fits perfect. Materialis really soft and a beautiful color

reviews.title: Comes off as cheap
reviews.text: I know this is a "maxi" skirt, but I am 5'9" and it is STILL too long!!! I am not used to that so in one way it is nice but in another it means that I don't feel like I look very good in this skirt. It comes off cheap, too. The colors and the style when it is "live" don't look so good.

reviews.title: I do love the skirt
reviews.text: So I have purchased 4 skirts total from this seller the other three fit as expected but for some reason the red leaves skirt is larger than the rest. I do love the skirt. I am 5'3" roughly 165lbs so the skirt is long BUT length can be adjusted with the fold down waist. I am satisfied with the skirts I have purchased. I am not going to send it back, I will just tack the side with a needle and thread and call it a day.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text:
Multiple things I don't love about this skirt.
1st, it is more of a clingy, thin, practically see through, performance material. I was expecting more of a soft knit/tshirt-like material.
2nd, it is more of a mermaid fit than I realized. I didn't really notice that in the pic until after I tried it on myself.
3rd, the craftsmanship isn't the greatest. The stitching itself isn't bad, but they could have matched up the stripes. I was honestly on the fence on keeping it or not until I notice this point.
I'm pretty disappointed because really wanted a striped maxi skirt. This was really close to what I had in mind, but I will be sending it back.

reviews.title: Pretty Summer Dress
reviews.text:
I love the dress, fits little tight in the mid section. However, will be keeping. Love the flowy fabric which is quite soft. Does show a little cleavage, but nothing wearing a tank with it wouldn't fix. Love the print!
Also for reference I am 5'2 and normally wear a size 14 or XL and I purchased the XL dress.

reviews.title: So in love with this dress
reviews.text: So in love with this dress. The fabric is super soft and flowy and completely flattering, plus it has POCKETS!!!! I'm only 5'5" and it was not too long at all, ordered the XL.

reviews.title: Runs a little small, order a size up.
reviews.text:
I am a dress size US14 and would normally wear an extra large. I've learned to order a size up from most of these retailers so I got an XXL and it fits perfectly.

It's a lovely print and it drapes beautifully. I had a baby 3 months ago and I'm working on getting my body back. This dress falls just right to disguise all the lumps and bumps. ;)

reviews.title: Caveat Emptor - beautify dress, but poor quality control and different patterns use different fabric
reviews.text:
I currently own 7 of these dresses - they are what I live in during the 6 months of the year that is summer in Arizona.
THAT BEING SAID....
When you order this dress, it is a gamble if you'll get the 1) beautiful stretchy, forgiving, easy wear fabric with a hem length of just at ankle (I'm 5'7), or 2) cheaper, less stretchy, scratchy, wrinkles like a devil and fits about 1/2 size too small, hits almost mid-calf dress but in a "poor quality control" not "modest hem" way. This particular pattern (Floral-03) falls in the second category, much to my annoyance.
If I didn't love these dresses, I wouldn't keep ordering them - it's such a disappointment and hassle to return it to Amazon and try again.
For what it's worth, Floral-04, Floral-6, & Floral-7 all fit as expected, wash and wear well, and are (IMHO) very worth their space in a carry on or weekend getaway bag. The dresses I have in those patterns get 5 STARS.

reviews.title: Great plus size/nursing dress!!
reviews.text:
Purchased two different sizes because I wasn’t sure which would fit best. The blue is XXL and tan is XXXL. For reference, I’m 230lbs. I am 5’4, carry my weight in my stomach & normally wear a size 20/22 pants.

Pros:

They both fit great and I loved the more closed neckline of the tan one. The blue was a little low cut for me and I think it is because the size. Can add a cami for more coverage.

The length was wonderful and hit me perfectly (I was wearing booties with a small heel on them)

The fabric was a silky material which is normally something I do not Iike but it was nice on this dress! Felt every soft and the colors were vibrant and beautiful. The tan didn’t mesh with my skin tone (too similar to my skin tone I think) but the bright colors were gorgeous.

Great nursing dress! Was able to pull the fabric over easily to nurse.

Cons:

Felt the seams rip a little while putting on. I was stretching it and they were still poping with a tiny pull. Also there was lots of loose string hanging from edges. But quality was great for price!

While I liked the fabric, it did a funny thing when it was stretched. the design would almost fade because it was getting stretched and I noticed…

reviews.title: Favorite dress. LOVE IT!!!!
reviews.text: Best dress I have ever purchased. It is very comfortable and soft. I am 5'2 so it is a little bit long on me, but that is not the dress problem hahaha. Anyways, the dress is of great quality fabric and very well made. I was surprised to see it has a zipper and side pockets. I put on the dress easily without knowing it had a zipper, once it was on I realized it had a zipper. Makes it that much better. So in love with it!!!!

reviews.title: The dress fits well and looks great. It is comfortable and is thick enough to ...
reviews.text: The dress fits well and looks great. It is comfortable and is thick enough to not need a slip under it. I am 5'5'' and 200lbs and bought the xxl, I love it but the length just brushes the ground while wearing flats, heels would fix that. Also, I wish the side zipper had material to cover it when it was zipped, because it rubs on my underarms.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Love it! I'm 145lbs and I got a small and it works great!

reviews.title: Nice hoodie
reviews.text: I was looking for a basic white zip up and this one definitely meets the mark. It's very comfortable with a nice stretch. Only downside was how long the ties were, but I pulled them out so it's great now. I am five foot eight and 141 pounds and I ordered my usual size small. I have attached a photo for reference as well.

reviews.title: Order a size below
reviews.text: The hoodie is casual and can be used as an active wear. The material and thickness is not suitable for winters or temperatures below 50F. I usually wear L in hoodies but L was really large on me. I had to exchange it with a MEDIUM. I ordered one in black and one in coral. I’m a 5’7” tall woman with 36DD bust, 30 waist and 38 hip for reference. You can find the look in the pictures. Excuse the background :D.. After three washes the coral color faded a bit but i’m fine with it.

reviews.title: Good, basic light jacket.
reviews.text:
This is a good, basic, light jacket and what I was going for. My body measurements are:
5’4, 135lbs
Shoulders: 14.5” across
Bust: 32” (B cup on a good day)
Waist: 26.5”
Hip: 35”/ “40 at butt

I ordered the medium and it fits comfortably loose, I think I could’ve gotten away with ordering the small for a more snug and fitted appearance. It has looooooong ties but you could easily trim and tie them to a shorter length. Material is fairly soft with some stretch, I can pull the sleeves over my knuckles. Overall, no complaints so far. If it holds up well I will definitely consider buying more!

I snapped some quick pictures for reference. It’s a bit wrinkly from the packaging, nothing a wash or stint in the dryer wouldn’t fix :)

reviews.title: First bought a L, then a M, and settled on a S
reviews.text:
I now love this hoodie. It is so soft and the grey is a lovely color that goes with so much. I am a large framed person (5'10", size 10) and these sleeves are long enough for me and the hood doesn't look too stupid.
That being said, I think the sizing is way off (or maybe I'm just weird). I normally wear a large, so I bought that at first and it was waaay too big. Then I bought a medium, and it too was too big. I ended up with a small, and that seems to fit great. I should say that I like my hoodies touching my hips, so if you hate that then order your size.

reviews.title: Love this! I love that it is thin
reviews.text: Love this! I love that it is thin, perfect for our warmer climate and working out. Some reviews did not like that it was so thin, but it's perfect if you don't want to look too bulky. The fabric is cotton and it has spandex in it, so it moves with your body. For the price, it's just perfect! I bought the black one and now I'm going to purchase the white one as well. Absolutely love it!

reviews.title: Comfy, stretchy, nice colors
reviews.text:
Very comfortable and I love the turquoise color I got it in. Soft, stretchy material-- I ordered the Small which is my usual size in tops and it is not too form fitting at all. It's actually a bit loose throughout the torso. I'm not a huge fan of the metal/plastic zipper combo and the hood strings were really long, so I cut them and re-knotted, which worked well enough. I love that it is made out of cotton and not polyester, and also how lightweight it is! It won't keep you warm in cold temperatures by any means but it is great for summer nights, lounging around, or wearing in slightly chilly air conditioned spaces.

I would have rated it 4 stars but it developed a small hole after washing the first time (cold, on delicate cycle). Not a huge deal, but I don't think that should have happened so soon. Can't complain too much for the price, though.
