reviews.title: Soft and true to size!
reviews.text: This is the perfect lightweight hoodie for me! It is just enough to wear to the gym, a cold movie theater, in the evenings before bed, or to lounge around the house! The material is thin and soft! It is sized just right, but originally in the item description it said it ran small. IT DOES NOT RUN SMALL. It is true to size. I wear a size 10 and I ordered 3 of these for myself and my daughters. I ordered the Large for myself thinking it ran small and really it doesn't. One of my daughters will like the Large size because she wears things loose and so it will work but the Medium fits me perfectly. This is truly the perfect little hoodie that you would take with you everywhere, especially in California where it isn't very cold. I love the coral color. I recommend it! I haven't washed it yet so if it doesn't wash well I will return and update my review. It also has a weird smell out of the package but I am sure that will go away as soon as you wash or let it air out of the packaging. The zipper was a little tricky when I first tried on the medium but as soon as I zipped it up with my left hand instead of my right hand it worked fine. Kinda strange but I tried it a few times. The other…

reviews.title: Runs big & very loose fit
reviews.text: I had to return the shirt because it is too big and it is a loose fit. I was hoping for a tighter fit. Pretty thin fabric and a little see through. I ordered a small and I am 5’3 and 130 pounds.

reviews.title: Big squarely built woman!
reviews.text: Got the XXL. I am 169 pounds 5’4” AND HAVE A 44” chest AND a 44” waist. The xxl fit perfect! Though I don’t think I will be putting it in the dryer! I didn’t find the sleeves too tight BUT my arms are on pretty good shape. Quality seems good for the price!

reviews.title: No Thank You
reviews.text: I read a lot of the reviews about this shirt before I purchased them. Most were positive and I the ones bordering on negative did not bother me too much. Boy, was that a mistake. I was shocked at the hardness and harshness of the fabric. Not enough fabric softener in the world to soften this sackcloth. Worst Cotton Ever ! I am shocked that this is a Hanes product. Save your money or buy burlap if you want to be uncomfortable.

reviews.title: L fits as expected, XL was way too big
reviews.text: I am 5'4", 150 lbs with broad shoulders. I ordered a L and an XL based on other reviewers that said the shirt ran small, but for me, the XL was huge - swimming on me. The L fit nicely. I haven't worn or washed it yet, so I can't comment on the durability, comfort or possible shrinkage. The fabric seems thick enough to also wear as a regular shirt, though I purchased this one for a sleeping shirt so for $7, it was a good deal.

reviews.title: It fit great! I thought this year I would pick up ...
reviews.text: I had bought one of these last year for the month of October since we're allowed to wear pink for that month. It fit great! I thought this year I would pick up one more, so I bought it from the exact same seller and the exact same brand. The shirt is completely different and no longer fits how my old one did. I'm very disappointed in this. The shirt has a very short torso area, it was required for me to wear a shirt underneath so my stomach did not show. The sleeves were also a great length shorter than the previous purchase. I will not be purchasing this shirt again. To reference, I am 5'5" and 126 pounds, ordered a medium at first and it was too big to wear, then ordered a small and it was too small. There was no in between. Do not recommend purchasing this.

reviews.title: Lovely!
reviews.text: I was very pleased with this product. it is a beautiful piece and it's hard to beleive it for the price! I received many compliments at my salsa studio's Gatsby themed party. Reviews said go up one size so I did and I had some wiggle room and wondered if I shouldn't have stayed at large. Either way, I was very pleased

reviews.title: Not quite long enough and not true to size for me
reviews.text:
I normally buy cotton t's in a X-Large. I first bought these in X-Large. They were too tight for me, personally. I like mine a little loose, but not baggy. I was also disappointed in that they are not quite long enough. :-( I have a longer body than most women and am 5'6" tall. These appeared to be longer body, but the size Large ended up showing my tummy. I decided to keep them for winter as under shirts, though.

Then I reordered size 2XL - these were a bit too boxy for me. I am a bit heavy but still have a definite hour-glass shape and used to buy t-shirts like this from Target that catered to my body style and were long enough. They no longer sell them and I thought these would be the right style replacement. Disappointed.

They fit better in the length than the XL, but still not great and my belly shows if I lift my arms. I also noticed that after two washings, the hem folds up to the front and now they need to be pressed before wearing or the hem seems to be "inside out." As a shirt to wear UNDER another shirt, they are great, but for just wearing alone, I will keep searching.

reviews.title: GREAT BASIC AND FLATTERING!!
reviews.text: I read lots of reviews and it was clear that this shirt ran small. I decided to order the Large and X-Large. I am usually a medium. I'm 5'7" and weigh 137 lbs. I very have broad shoulders and a broad back, but wear an AA cup. The Large is perfect for me. I have long arms and the sleeve length is great. The cut of the shirts hem is very flattering. If I had found this shirt sooner, I would have purchased more colors. I got the white too. The X-Large was perfect for my mom, who has a similiar shape, but is taller than I am. I hope they make this style again, it's a great and flattering basic. I can wear the XL too. I love this shirt so much I got the wine/port color in XL because it wasn't available in L. I wish they made the same cut in short sleeve.

reviews.title: Awkward fit
reviews.text: I purchased this because I was looking for a lightweight long sleeve shirt to wear under my scrubs. I usually wear a size small, but will order a size medium if I'm looking for a looser fit (for reference I'm 5'6 125 pounds.) I purchased the size small in pink and found this to be too big but also too short in the torso and arms. When compared to my size small Cherokee shirt, it is larger but the torso and arms are shorter. The arms from the wrist are 23" to the seam, 27" to the collar, and width from under the armpits is 18", and the length from the front collar to bottom is 21". It was soft and lightweight without being see through, but unfortunately the fit wasn't right for me. If you have a shorter torso and arms, this shirt is for you!

reviews.title: Lovely. Medium
reviews.text:
True to size. I took a medium based on review but a small which is my size would have been perfect.
 I was going for a right work out fit

I was also going for a good length to cover my assets as I will be wearing it with tights.
Could have been longer but good enough.
140lbs. 5" 6" 34-36D

reviews.title: Great no frills black long sleeved tee
reviews.text: I wear a lot of black and with the upcoming cold weather, needed to stock up on long sleeved black shirts. These Hanes tees are perfect for my needs. The sleeves and torso are both the perfect length. The cotton fabric is thick, warm, soft and comfortable. It washes perfectly. No shrinking and no color bleed onto other clothes at all. No fading so far, and I have had these for a few months now. Because they are Hanes, they are very high quality and the price was great.

reviews.title: I like to wear shirts under tees
reviews.text:
I like to wear shirts under tees, as I'm always cold. I used to buy all my shirts from Victoria's Secret, but they've discontinued the nice crew necks they used to sell, and I'm running out of the stock I have.

I like a fitted tee, not too tight, and definitely not too see-through. I thought I'd try the Hanes version.

The colors I've bought are not see-through. They definitely are dense. They have some great colors to choose from, and the bright colors really pop.

Since reviews said they run a little small, I tried Large at first. I'm usually a Medium (8-10), and the larges were way too big. They were baggy, so I can't wear shirts on top. Then I tried the Medium, and the Medium is still not as fitted as I'd like, but I can wear tee shirts on top.

There's one thing I've found with the Hanes shirt, though, that makes me not want to buy anymore (I have four right now). They're itchy. I've washed them several different ways, and no way I've tried has changed the result. They scratch against my chest, and I have been a bit hive-y after wearing them.

They're a good price for what they are, but I'll be looking elsewhere next time.

reviews.title: Shirt is lightweight cotton and very comfortable. Washed well with minimal shrinkage
reviews.text: The sizing is accurate. Shirt is lightweight cotton and very comfortable. Washed well with minimal shrinkage. Flattering casual cut.

reviews.title: Runs Small and Very Fitted
reviews.text:
Purchased several of these for my mom in an assisted care facility. She's 4'10" about 115 pounds - very petite but curvy. I ordered large sizes because of her body shape and because anything cotton will shrink. (Even when it says pre-shrunk!) What arrived looks more like a medium - definitely for people without many curves. These fit so-so. I'll probably resort to buying things off clearance racks from now on and doing alterations myself. Laid flat, the shirt measures 20" across just under the arms. Sleeves from the top shoulder seam are 25".

Hanes is one of the few companies with clothes that sometimes work for petite women. The only other one is Land's End, but they're expensive. These are thin shirts, not necessarily see-thru, and very fitted for women's clothing. As in, not only does it run small but it really does the hourglass shape if you want to show off your figure. At least the sleeves won't have to be rolled up. I'm praying they really don't shrink because there's not much give to the fabric. It's very stiff. Purple is true to color shown by seller despite my bad pics.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: I have these in 3 colors. I'm a RN and wear them under my scrubs during the colder months. They keep me warm but I don't get sweaty when I'm running around the floor.

reviews.title: MAJOR SHRINKAGE!
reviews.text:
When these shirts (I bought 4) first arrived, they fit great. After washing, they seemed a bit stiff but, were still 'ok'... not great but, would serve the purpose. Once washed again, the shrinkage became obvious. Even stretching and line drying didn't help. With each wash, they get smaller and smaller. Now, after only 3 washes, they're considerably too short, tight in the sleeves and snug in the mid-section. The colors are accurate and they're well sewn but, that's hardly helpful when they're now too small to wear!
Luckily, I just found some nicer long-sleeve crew-neck shirts (for less than $5) at Walmart and will stick with them. Softer, warmer, longer body and nicer color choices. Wish I'd have tried there first!

reviews.title: Great jacket at a great price!
reviews.text: Really love this jacket!!!! Bought an XXL because I read they run small, but it was too big, so I returned it and got the XL. I wear an 18 short in old Navy jeans, for size reference in the photos. I love everything about this jacket. Enough room to wear a light sweater underneath, warm in cold weather but not too bulky that you're hot when you go into a store or are in the car. Love love love.

reviews.title: True to size and beautiful color
reviews.text: Fits wonderful and is true to size. Rich, mustard color with darker, brassy hardware. Looks expensive and has nice pockets and details.

reviews.title: Frustrating fit issue
reviews.text: I wear a Large, but several reviews have said this jackets runs small so I ordered XL. It arrived, and XL is actually 1X, which anyone who knows how women's clothing sizes work, knows is not the same as an XL. I tried it on and it was too big. I figured I could just pull the ties tight to make it tighter in the waist. That probably would have been fine except on one side I guess the lining is detached from the outer layer and the tie,so when I pulled it tight the lining was tighter but the outer material didn't move. Plus it was very baggy in the bag and just looked too big. I thought, no big deal, I'll get the Large. Well the Large just arrived today and it's too small! It fits more like a medium. The shoulders were tight and it couldn't quite zip. I like the jacket itself. It's a cute style, and perfect color for what I wanted. Not the best quality but I didn't expect that so that's fine. But it's very frustrating that I have 2 jackets, 1 size apart from each other and one is way too big while the other is too small. There's no size in between, so they just don't make a size that fits me. Very annoying. So if you wear a small or medium you'll like this. But if you typically wear…

Perfect! It is just what I wanted and expected. I didn't think it would be as soft inside or as warm as it is. And the length is perfect… I was worried that it would be too short but it's not! Love everything about it. Pics included...excuse my messy closet.

reviews.title: Better than I expected!!
reviews.text:
I usually wear a 2X but I purchased a 3X and it fit PERFECTLY!! I'm in LOVE with this coat! If you're considering buying, you MUST purchase it! It's the best rainy/cool weather coat, probably not the best for winter weather though.

**Update**
-April 2020-
This is still one of my favorite go to jackets!

reviews.title: This is a great light jacket
reviews.text: This is a great light jacket. Definitely needs layering for real warmth but I love the look of it. Sleeves are slightly short but I make it work. I’m 5’7 145lbs and I got a medium.

reviews.title: Five Stars
reviews.text: This fits and looks really well! I'm 5ft, 110lbs and ordered a small, and it fit me.

reviews.title: I love my new jaket it's a little big on the ...
reviews.text: I love my new jaket it's a little big on the sleeves are little longer but it fits perfectly I normally am L and I Shoshone XL but they send me 1XL maybe that's way the sleeves are little longer the good thing it brings the strings to tight in the middle because with out that the jaket would fit me a little bigger. But anyway I loved it thank you

reviews.title: Loved this dress!!
reviews.text: Beautiful dress!!! I never post reviews but I had too. I was a little scared to purchase and when I opened the package i was so upset. The material looked a different, for lack of a better word, and the dress initially appeared to look cheap. But it was cute when I tried it on but I still wasn't satiafied. I wanted to be super cute for my birthday and the all White party & i didn't think this dress was "The One". I even considered getting another dress but once I put on my accessories and shoes and got dolled up, it was beautiful. I got soooo many compliments and people asking where i got my dress from. I'm a big girl 5'2 and 173 lbs and full figured but this dress hides everything. I attached a pic because it was gorgeous!! I will be ordering other colors!

reviews.title: love
reviews.text: I love this dress! I have a bit of a baby belly from five kids, so I was looking for something that helped flatter/hide that area, and I feel like this does. I feel really feminine and pretty in the dress and think it's great for all body types. I love the different ways you can wear it too - over both shoulders, off both shoulders, or under one arm. The skirt's length adjusts pretty easily so you can wear it longer or a lot shorter. It's not a mini-skirt. It's like a sleeveless dress with the drape attached to it at the top. The material is giving and super comfortable! When I was looking to buy it, I really wanted to see the red dress on someone, so I'll post photos of me in it in case anyone else wants to see the color, as well as what the dress looks like under the top. (I am wearing shape wear cause I always do for my belly and had it on when I put this on, but I think this dress would do fine without it the way the belly is covered). It's a really flexible dress that I think can probably adjust to almost all body types. I'm 5' 3.5" and 125 lbs and got a small.

reviews.title: I love it, but I did a detail tie the ...
reviews.text: I love it, but I did a detail tie the shoulders and really work because it looks different and more youthful, it was very easy: just tie a string to tie it on the shoulders and look like another style.

reviews.title: Perfect fit!
reviews.text: Im 5'4, 185. Bought this dress for a white party. I ordered a large and It fits perfect! I had a baby 4 months ago so I'm still working off the weight. This dress is sexy, yet covers the mid section. I store my weight in my legs, hips and thighs but If you store weight in the tummy, you may wanna go up a size. Anywho, im Loving this dress!

reviews.title: Nice dress
reviews.text: Top is is a little big and lays flat but overall happy with this dress! Fits really well..bought a large I'm 5'8 175lbs

reviews.title: Quality is great if it is fantastic
reviews.text: It was everything I pictured and everything I am Magent! Quality is great if it is fantastic! I weigh 150 pounds and I'm 5 feet tall and I got a medium. It was perfect for Easter and I bought it in white black pink and red because I loved it's so much! I wore the pink one for Easter and I even doubled it as a shirt for the crawfish boil after church it was perfect! I got so many compliments both at church and at the crawfish boil!!

reviews.title: A Winner!!
reviews.text: Read the reviews for this dress & kept going back & forth trying to decided whether or not to order it. So glad that I decided to take a chance! Tried the dress on & instantly fell in LOVE! This dress has a very classy look, is figure flattering & hid areas that I didn't want to be seen. I dressed it up w/some turquoise & green accents & received compliments all night. Great price, great look, great buy! Buy the dress! You'll be glad you did.

reviews.title: Buy it!!!
reviews.text: I'm 177lbs and I purchased a large in red and white. You can wear spanxs if you want to but it covers your tummy well.

reviews.title: PERFECT FOR SHORTIES!
reviews.text: I am barely 5’3 , and most of it is my long torso; so it’s difficult finding maxi skirts or dresses that I’m not tripping over or flat out flaring onto the floor. I also have a big booty and thick, muscular legs; so another problem is finding garments that don’t become transparent from the knees up. That being said, I LOVE this skirt! I wish it came in 46 colors and I’d buy them all!

reviews.title: Loved it so much I bought two more
reviews.text:
I originally bought this skirt because I was traveling to a country with sometimes strict modesty requirements for women and I wanted a maxi-skirt I could keep rolled up in my bag to pull on over my pants if I needed to. It stayed rolled up in my bag for over two weeks without wrinkling and still looked nice. I did not have the problem some reviewers noted with it stretching out and slipping down, but I have a curvy figure so this might be less of a concern for me. It also withstood being hand washed/wrung out in the sink and hung over the back of a chair to dry and still looked great.

The material is smooth and very comfortable. I've also machine washed it since and the hems/seams are still flat (not doing that bunching/rolling thing some cheaper garments do or twisting off the bias). Really a good quality for the price.

The fold-over waist gives a lot of flexibility for length and more/less midriff coverage. I usually wear a US 10/12 and bought the large. I'm pretty short so I can fold the waist band in half to have it sit at my natural waist and the hem comes to my ankle (29 inch inseam). Someone with less booty would probably find it to be longer.

I did buy two more when I…

reviews.title: Most comfortable skirt ever! And not a foot too long!
reviews.text: I am 5.3, 148 pounds with a belly and no butt. I bought color #6 in a large and if fits perfectly! The skirt is very soft and not too tight around the belly area. You can fold the top down to make the length of the skirt shorter if you want, but it was a perfect length for me. Love the colors - I could see wearing it in the spring, summer and fall. I have been looking for a maxi skirt that wasn't made for a giant for years and finally found it. This skirt definitely won't hide my pouchy belly, but I will wear it with a blousy tank, t-shirt or 3/4 length shirt and it will be fine. You can dress it up or go for a more comfy/casual look. Absolutely perfect in my opinion!

reviews.title: Comfy with plenty of stretch
reviews.text: I love maxi skirts, I wear them year round and even when pregnant. This brand is perfect as it great quality, has a nice thick waist band and has good stretch without losing shape. Normal wear, maternity wear and post baby wear!

reviews.title: SO cute and fits true to size
reviews.text: I bought the black and white Urban CoCo maxi skirt in a size small and it fit great. I am 5’8 and 138lbs. The length came right to my ankles and waist fit perfect. It looks good in both the full high waist style and folded over; in fact one “plus” is you can fold over the top of the skirt a little or a lot to get the length you want and it lays perfectly. Nice quality material (not too sheer and not so much fabric that makes you look wide) and it doesnt bunch up. It is so cute, stylish and comfy that I decided to order another one. If you’re on the fence, buy this!

reviews.title: Well made.
reviews.text: Light weight yet hides lumps. Cute pattern and well made. Has fair amount of stretch. You can fold down a lot to make it shorter or a little for floor length. I generally wear between a medium or large and with this I ordered a large and it fits perfect. I'm 5'4 and 160. I also bought it in black and can dress up with sparkly shirt and heels and go semi formal.

reviews.title: Worth It
reviews.text: Very comfortable and surprisingly well made for the price. I was half expecting wonky hemming and poor fabric quality. I live where it's ridiculously hot and humid, and these make summer (which is like 3/4 of the year) more stylish and bearable. Order a size up- I'm usually a large and ordered XL in all four colors that I chose & they fit perfectly. Also, they can be dressed up or down- they look cute with a Mickey Mouse T for lunch with a friend or with a blazer for a day in the office.

reviews.title: THIS NEEEEEEEEEDS TO BE ADDED TO YOUR CLOSET!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: So I’m in the process of rebuilding my wardrobe, because I have recently changed my career and I can’t do pants, because I can’t get dress pants over my calves or my thighs and fit my waist, lifter problems! So I thought I’ll get maxi skirts for my new wardrobe, but then I have short people problems, I’m 5 foot 1.5 inches, so for me to find a CUTE & FITTING MAXI skirt is like next to impossible!!!!!!!!!!!! BUT LET ME TELL YOU THIS IS THE ONE!!! So I bought the olive green one and I am about to buy it in every other color!!! I SWEAR EVERYONE NEEDS THESE IN THEIR LIVES!!!!

reviews.title: This is my third one!!
reviews.text:
**THIRD UPDATE: I will finally admit that I'm obsessed with the shirt. This is the third that I've gotten and I love it. I decided to get a size small because I wanted to wear it with jeans and not have it quite so long and I kind a wish I would've gotten a small with the other two that I bought. The black one is similar to the gray, not quite as soft as the blue but it's comfortable and looks really cute with leggings or jeans. The only downsides to them is the sleeve length is a little shorter than I like, hitting right at the wrist when my arms are down, and the puffiness at the hips that makes me look a little bigger there than I am. I'm 5 foot 6 inches and about 125 lbs (I was around 130 when I ordered the last two, but I still think I should have gotten a small).

**UPDATE: I bought the gray one because, despite the frump factor, the blue one is seriously the coziest shirt I've ever owned. It's the first thing I want to grab when I go to my closet. Like the kind of shirt you'd want to wear on a 12 hour flight kind of cozy. The gray one feels totally different, it's almost scratchy, even with a tank top under it and not quite as stretchy (the blue bounces back and doesn't stay…

reviews.title: Love this shirt but wish I would have bought large ...
reviews.text: Love this shirt but wish I would have bought large instead of medium. I always wear an 8/10 which is why i bought the medium but again, no room for shrinking. I am 5'6" 160lbs. The shirt fits perfect now but I'm afraid once i wash and dry, it is going to shrink a bit. It is a little more snug than I like in the shoulders and sleeves (my arms are long though). Otherwise, it is super comfortable and cute. The collar can probably be worn slouched down (which I prefer to show off the buttons) or folded down. Love this shirt.

reviews.title: The BEST top!!!
reviews.text:
2021 UPDATE: 4 years later and I'm still purchasing this shirt lol, I came back for the green, navy and white. I still own and wear the first bunch of shirts I purchased back in 2017 if you can believe it and they still look brand new. I seriously can't find one bad thing to say. The size, material, fit, style...everything is perfect. If you are unsure about sizing then I would say order up one size. This shirt will still be ok even if it ends up being a little big because of the style and cut. Remember you can work with a little big, you can't do anything with a shirt that's too small.
 Let me just say this is the first top I've ever ordered from Amazon that actually fit and is good quality! Past experiences has made me quit purchasing clothes from here but when I came across this top and saw all the good reviews I had to try it. So glad I did. This top is awesome. Good quality and figure flattering. Can be worn with leggings or skinny jeans. The material is comfortable, soft and not heavy at all. The cowl drapes nicely but I'm a little confused as to why they put the decorative buttons underneath it?? You want that detail to show. You could get some of the buttons to show but…

reviews.title: Beautiful color!
reviews.text:
Love the color, comfortable shirt can be dressed up or down. Long enough to wear over leggings, butt is covered.
Runs true to size maybe even a tad bigger. I'm 5'2, ordered the M and it comes down past my hips. I'm an average M/size 6-8 in almost everything

reviews.title: ... 115 lbs 34a I ordered small 4-6 and fits perfect for me 😊 I love the material so soft ...

reviews.title: Comfy shirt, good fabric
reviews.text:
I havent worn this shirt longer than a few minutes yet, but so far it seems very comfy. Soft fabric, very stretchy without getting stretched out. It holds it shape, good fabric. The buttons seem to be in a weird location but I don't think they'll bother me.

I ordered a large and probably should have gone for an XL just because I wish the stomach area was baggier. I tend to want to hide that part of my body. I really like the length too. The waist is slightly tighter so it doesn't ride up at all and it covers just enough.

I ordered one for my sister and I'm sure she'll love it.

reviews.title: Excellent quality, super soft!
reviews.text:
These sweaters are so soft and comfy! It's a really nice light sweater material, but still warm. You can dress it up or down.They are not as loose fitting as the model in the picture, but if you want it super loose like that then it's going to take away any shape you might have and the pockets will be saggy. I read the reviews and looked at all the pics and decided to get a Medium. I love they way it fits. It's not super baggy but not so tight you can see every nook and cranny. It goes about half down the bum so if you are looking to fully cover your butt and are super tall, these might not be for you. The buttons are sewn in a silly place...the inside of the cowl, but if you fold it right you can get them to show. If you are inclined and able you could even take them off and re-sew them to the outside easily which I may do. Overall I love them.

I am 5'6, 150 lbs, bust, 36', waist, 34', hips 40'

reviews.title: Absolutely perfect!
reviews.text: This shirt is amazing! The material is a thinner cotton and so soft and comfy. I'm not a big turtle neck kind of person but this one doesn't bother me because it's loose on the neck and not bulky. I'm 5'4 between 135-140 lbs and decided to get medium so that it would be long enough for leggings. I'm pear shape. I just ordered two more. I got a small in black though so I can wear with jeans!

reviews.title: Fit like a glove
reviews.text:
Love this skirt!! It hugs all the right curves.
I'm 5 11 .. 180 lbs I ordered the large!
I want to order more of these in different colors!!

reviews.title: DRY CLEAN ONLY!
reviews.text:
It's super cute. I got an extra large and it fits perfect and it's knee length! the only thig i recommend is to steam iron it; I tried to iron it and i was scared for a second that i had burned it even with the iron on low because it gave the fabric a weird texture and didn't glide over it like it should. So just hold the iron over it and let the steam knock out the wrinkles.

UPDATE: I’m pretty sure this is dry clean only but there’s no tag to say. I said not to iron it before but ever since I first washed it it has started falling apart and little elastic fuzzies have been popping up around the seem! The picture doesn’t do justice to what it looked like before it started picking them off

reviews.title: One Star

reviews.title: A bit too big.
reviews.text: Based on the other reviews and the tendency for Chinese-made clothing to be a bit small for American standards I ordered up to an extra large and it’s too big. I’m 5 foot 6.5 and 150lbs. It’s not too big to wear, luckily it has a belt that kept it from falling down, but it was a little bit bunchy. I wore this for my wedding. It was cute.

reviews.title: A great purchase! Stretchy belt comes separately.
reviews.text: I'm 5'4 and 170lbs with an athletic figure. This skirt was sized just a tad big but in reviewing it I put "fit as expected" because I do think if it were any tighter it would not be as adjustable and good as hiding weight in middle section. Needless to say I do love it. Because I am short and the skirt is slightly big, it allows me to adjust it how I want and make it high waisted or sit right at my hips. I really do suggest you size up! The belt that it comes with is very cute too and perfect for other outfits (belt is detachable and has stretch to it!). I'll be wearing this skirt with the "long sleeve scoop neck pleated blouse top" also found on Amazon. I do see some reviewers have noted the skirt falling apart after wearing.. But I'll only post an update if it turns out to be a bad purchase after I start wearing it!

reviews.title: I liked the fit and the length
reviews.text: I liked the fit and the length. I am a 44in hip and a 34 in waist and it looked great. However, the fabric was extremely thin and i really wish it was thiscker and or heavier. Overall, I am happy with my purchase and still use the skirt to bring a little class to my day!

reviews.title: Comfy and quality, I suggest a different belt

reviews.title: Super cute!

BUT I was pleasantly surprised at how flattering this skirt is! I think the fit is as it says, I bought a size up because I was so worried about the belly area, but I can see how the size it suggested would have been perfect.

reviews.title: Beautiful Dress for a Beautiful Occassion
reviews.text: Beautiful dress! I ordered for a wedding and I looked like a million bucks! I am 5,3, 168 lbs and a 36 D chest. I ordered bothe the L and XL. The L fit tailored and the XL gave my tummy area a little more room. Hope this helps!

reviews.title: More Mistress Than Housewife. Love it tho...
reviews.text: So I bought this dress for a funeral because in the pic it stops at the knee. Wellll if you factor in your 'ass-ets' if youre overly blessed like myself youre probably going to revive the dead. Too short. Definitely sexy. More for cocktails. Awesome fit. True to size. Just short on curvy women

reviews.title: Perfect dress that fits a mom bod.
reviews.text:
I am highly skeptical of form fitting dresses. All the people leaving reviews seem to be skinny minis and I am far from it. I am 5'9 and can weight anywhere between 205 to 215 depending on bloat and how I've been eating.

This dress is great! It fits better than I expected, has some "give" to it in case I am on the heavier end of my weight and is absolutely beautiful. I am not fit, toned, or even skinny fat. I am a mother of 3 that has the mom belly. You know, the one that makes you constantly look 4 months pregnant? Yeah that one. This dress fits me without being too tight. I bought an XL and while it is form fitting it doesn't make me look like I am busting out of sausage casing. Do not dry! It will shrink but not a ton :( Also know that if you have junk in the trunk, when you sit down it rides up mid thigh. I thought the lace would be itchy but it isn't. The lining is soft but will cling if there is any static in the air. It is a kittle big in the top area as I am a C so bustier girls should be fine. Like I said, there is give so it will accommodate more blessed girls.

reviews.title: Lovely (but @ 5’8 do not bend over)!
reviews.text:
I am so sad. I love the design of the dress, but it’s going back.

I’m 5’8 &128 athletic lbs & the small was a little snug on my lower half, but way too loose in a medium (see pics). However the cut may not be best for somebody who is my height. The under slip is just under my butt and I would not feel comfortable wearing it to a work Christmas party as I intended - too much potential for (unintentional) flashing! (I did NOT include the pic from the back because it was too revealing to post online, “butt” you get the idea from the side view).

The medium had a flaw around the neckline or I might have had it altered, so alas, it was just not meant to be! But if you do have a shorter torso and/or don’t mind flashing hiney - go for it! It is beautiful & comfortable and I really wish it fit me better.

reviews.title: Beautiful dress

reviews.title: MY ABSOLUTE FAVORITE DRESS HANDS DOWN!!
reviews.text:
I LOVE THIS DRESS! I gained a bit of weight during quarantine and none of my nice dresses fit me anymore. After plans changed due to Covid, I had less than a week to find a dress for a small wedding we were attending. With no stores having dressing rooms open, and it being too short notice to order from my usual dress sites, I turned to amazon and crossed my fingers!

And dang did amazon deliver! (pun intended 😂)

I ordered a size large after reading many reviews and I’m really glad I did. Many people had commented that the middle section was a bit loose and I found this to be true as well. I have larger hips and a decently round booty so there was a bit of extra fabric around my lower back that I didn’t love. Luckily I know how to sew and just added two darts to that area to take it in a bit and then it was like absolute magic! The chest area fit perfectly for me, but that being said, I have a rather small chest unlike most people who tend to wear a size large. I can see how any one with a larger bust might feel a bit snug. The length of the dress was perfect for me which is usually another concern of mine. I am rather tall with a long torso (5’9), but the lace hit right at the…

reviews.title: Love the dress

reviews.title: World's hardest working dress - Best Ever
reviews.text:
Where do I begin?
This dress removes all doubt when I head to the closet.
It has been appropriate for these occasions: airport, pre-hot yoga, post-hot yoga, lounging in my house, grocery pick up, date night.
This thing is a work horse. I have worn sports bra, regular bra, boy shorts, thongs, basically a variety of under garments under the dress. And it doesn't show. All kinds of shoes work with it too: flops, boots, sneakers, heels, kitten heels...the list goes on. The rouching makes it very forgiving. And the midi Length adds a touch of class. This dress truly brings me joy (MarieKon). All other clothing will be judged against this dress!

I will be buying the long sleeve version soon. And I will probably buy at least one more in the shirt sleeve.
Bravo, job exceptionally well done on this dress. Simple, classic, and very affordable. Thank you!

reviews.title: Petite/short ladies, this review is for you!
reviews.text:

 Overall I’m very pleased & hope this helps!

reviews.title: not flattering and not as expected.
reviews.text:

Basically I’m getting ready for a tsunami in the middle of the desert in AZ. So that’s cool.
-1 star- if you want people to see through your soul as you bend over then this is the dress for you. It’s SEE THROUGH! The fabric is soft, but you definitely can’t go without a slip or underwear if that’s your thing.
-1 star- the slit is not as pictured either! I was hoping to have a very cute dress for family photos with just a little slit to show off my cute booties, but NOOOOO this slit goes about halfway up my thigh! The slit in the dress pictured is clearly right below the knee. So now if I plan…

reviews.title: Had Potential, But a Fit Nightmare
reviews.text: This dress was not what I expected. It was a very heavy material rather than being flowy. I normally wear a size 6 (5'9" 150lbs), but i ordered the medium rather than small (what the manufacturer sizing chart put me in) because I like my dresses on the longer side. Fit-wise, the dress was a disaster for me. Because the fabric is so thick and stiff, I was completely shapeless and it gave off a boxy feel. I could have gone a size down, but the dress was already too short for me (hard to tell from the photos but hit mid shin), so that would have made it even shorter. I ended up returning the dress, but I think if you're shorter than I am and stick with the sizing guide, this could be a nice dress.

reviews.title: Not the dress pictured
reviews.text: I did not receive the dress pictured. I received a sleeveless red dress similar to the one pictured only w/out the sleeves and there is a seam between the “tank style” top and the long bottom half of the dress which makes it more of an empire waist dress than a loose hanging T-shirt style maxi dress. It was decent quality but is probably a size smaller than the measurements listed for the size I ordered.

reviews.title: nice fabric, loose fit, good buy
reviews.text:
Read bunches of reviews for this and for similarly described products, decided to go with this item despite some very negative reviews, and I’m so glad I did! Some of the scary reviews must have been (hopefully) flukes or freak defective items; my dress had no weird smell, fits like a dream, and is the correct fabric composition (95% rayon, 5% spandex). If you like rayon, you know there’s the really light/thin version and the heavier/thicker version; this is the heavy one. It drapes nicely and moves well.

I had a hard time deciding what size to get, so for those in the same boat, here are my specs:
90/69/96 cm (35/27/38 in), 138 lb, long torso with a lean build (my bust is mostly breadth, not boob). I prefer my clothes looser rather than tighter; the size S in this product fits just a little more snugly on me than on the model in the picture. 5’8” tall and the bottom hem brushes a scant 3” above my ankle. Side slits come up to mid-thigh.

The color is true to the picture, and the v at the front and back aren’t too deep!

Not sure how it’ll wash since I just got it today, but I’m pretty sure cold wash and hang dry will keep it in good condition.

reviews.title: So glad I ordered two!
reviews.text: The material in this is SOOO soft - I bought a Medium based on reviews that it runs large, which I'm not sure I agree with. I am a 12/14, and the Medium fits great; I just wish I'd gotten a Large instead. I'm not returning it tho, because I can't wait to wear it! When I wear it in public, I will definitely put pants or leggings underneath because it's very flowy, and I don't want to flash everybody.

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: I bought two (red and navy). I didn't expect much from these skirts since they were less than $20. I thought they'd be way too small and made of cheap fabric. I thought they'd be flimsy and made poorly. I fully expected to have to return them. I am happy to say my expectations were not met. These skirts are comparable to something you'd buy at Target. The material is not too thin, they fit as expected, and they are well made. The cut is flattering for my shape (juicy hips and booty) and the detail at the waist gives the skirt a fashionable look without the bulk of the folder over waists that most skirts like this have. I wouldn't hesitate to buy a third.

I went up to a large for the over size look. I normally roll up the sleeve once for a cute cuffed look. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND.

reviews.title: Warm sweater but OMG the pockets!!!
reviews.text: The size runs a little small but that is not my major issue with the product. What I realized is that there is reason that every photo of this product either hides the pockets or has hands in the pockets. I really like the idea but this is just not executed well! The pockets jut out from the hip area AND they are uneven! I hope the return process is painless.

reviews.title: high quality & comfortable
reviews.text:
I’m 5’ 3” and about 125 lbs and ordered a small. I could’ve gone with an XS if they offered that, but unfortunately it’s not an option. As you can see, it hits me about an inch above the knee. If you are any more petite than I am, I don’t think this would fit well.
I subtracted a star because the neck is not as oversized as the picture and it fits more like a traditional turtleneck. The material is very soft and hasn’t gotten itchy after wearing for a few hours. It feels really well made and like it will last.
By the way, the pockets are great! They are big enough to fit my phone.

reviews.title: Order the XL - I promise!
reviews.text: Great oversized sweater but definitely order the XL, I took that advice from another review before i purchased it. It’s cute, short...best with leggings or tights but i guess I could wear it as a dress. I’m 5’5” 135lbs and normally a small or size4/6 if that helps!

reviews.title: The best winter cozy dress
reviews.text: Omg where do I start. I’m 5’10 and around 190 pounds. I’m usually a L, but I ordered an XL because I was worried about the length. I love this dress. It’s so big and chunky and cozy but also super sexy!!! The pockets are amazing and the material isn’t itchy at all. It looks great paired with tall boots, but I’m sure you could rock some leggings and ankle boots and it would look just as amazing. Totally worth the price, it is baggy for sure but I anticipated that when I ordered one size up so I could get the length I wanted. I want one in EVERY COLOR. Another amazon win!

reviews.title: but I absolutely love it and it’s exactly what I was hoping for
reviews.text: After reading all the reviews I almost didn’t get this sweater, but I absolutely love it and it’s exactly what I was hoping for. One review said the material was bad, but it feels soft to me, it’s not like I was expecting a cashmere sweater! The bottom tightens a bit which is what I wanted so that it can be worn as a dress or with leggings. I am 5,1, 160 lbs and got a large. Another review said the pockets were bad, again...it’s a 30 dollar sweater, I think they are fine but I also don’t use pockets much anyways. And lastly one other person said you can’t tell the front from the back, this is true in the sense that there is no tag, but the front and the back look exactly the same so it shouldn’t be a bother. Get it, you’ll be stoked!

reviews.title: Feel so comfortable when I wear this.
reviews.text: [[VIDEOID:31606e4a4543b41af2542022d7cf7c5f]] I wished little more loose turtleneck. And pocket is too low area. If pocket was sewn to the dress, it’ll make dress look more slimming. This is little advice. Anything else pretty good.

reviews.title: True to size
reviews.text: I bought the mustard looking one because the price was much lower than the others and I like the color. I would call it a dark mustard. I am 5' 4" 200 lbs and bought a XXL. It fits great. Not small, not large. If I was going to wear it over a thick shirt such as a sweat shirt or sweater it would be to small but this jacket is lined and very warm so you wouldn't want to wear it over a thick shirt anyway. It will be great for walking the dog in cooler weather. The sleeves are a bit long as you can see in the photos. It covers the rear end, even with arm raised.

reviews.title: In love!! Buy this one!!
reviews.text:
STOP SEARCHING! This is THE one!!

Love this!! I researched for a lined, button and zip up sweater for a week and finally decided on this one and it was worth it! I must have looked at at least 100 different, reading reviews, but this one had the best. But I didn't see any photos of curvy chicks, so I am posting a couple. I wear a 14/16 and have that hour glass shape so I was worried about the bottom fitting but I was brave and ordered the xxl. I also have long arms. This one easily zips up and buttons over my curves and comes over my wrists. Beautiful, warm, good quality. Worth way more than what I paid. Order this in your size and you will love it.

reviews.title: It’s beautiful! Don’t order up in size
reviews.text: It’s beautiful! Don’t order up in size. I’m a 14, and the large is a little loose on me. Would have exchanged for a medium if I wasn’t going to out of town!

reviews.title: I recommend sizing down for sure
reviews.text: After reading the reviews I decided to purchase a size small. I am usually a size medium in shirt ( height 5'7'', 155 lbs) and this sweater was still a bit too big. I recommend sizing down for sure! Otherwise, nice sweater!

reviews.title: If heaven is a sweater, this is it.
reviews.text:
I love this sweater. I am so in love with this sweater. It is amazing. It's warm, it's cozy... I could just die and be buried in this sweater and be happy for all eternity. (Ok maybe that's pushing it a bit..)

If I have a complaint about it, it would be that the snaps are poorly sewn. There are snaps by the toggles, to help keep the sweater closed. These are a good idea, but the snaps aren't stitched well and one was falling off when I took it out of the package. It's a pretty minor deal, all in all, I can use a needle & thread and put the snap back... but it is what it is. Toggles work fine, the snaps really aren't necessary anyways.

It fits as expected, I ordered up a size so I would have a nice, roomy, cozy, loose fit. If you want a typical snug fit, order your regular size. I wear a L in knit shirts, I bought an XL in this sweater, and it's nice & roomy with room for a long sleeve shirt underneath and to fasten without it being tight. Buy for the fit you want.

UPDATE: When I washed this, in cold water and line dry, it shrunk up like 2 inches on the bottom and the cuffs... so it was no longer the long, loose fit that it was when it was right out of the package. It's not…

reviews.title: Amazing Sweater
reviews.text: Luckily I love oversized sweaters. I normally wear an xl so I ordered it. Fits a bit bigger than expected but not too bad. For a more form fitting sweater I would order a size down. It's extremely cozy and warm I love it. Will definitely buy again.

reviews.title: Nice warm sweater.
reviews.text:
I am setisfied with a purchase. Sweater is really nice and feels very warm. Has a zipper and buttons, which is awesome.
The only thing bothers me that I already found a couple spots where threads started loosing up and “unknit” themselves. I fixed that. I hope it would last long enough to be worth the money I paid.

reviews.title: Lovely, warm, delightful coat
reviews.text: I love this jacket/coat. Being broad shouldered, finding a coat that I can comfortably drive in is nearly impossible. This coat has been a life saver. I feel free to move in it, yet it is warm and cute to boot. The inner lining keeps me warm but doesn't overheat me. You do need to both zip and button for a more professional/clean cut look, but even open it does the job well. The sleeves are not lined like the body of the coat, which I think it perfect since you are most likely wearing long sleeves anyway. I bought the black, and really love it. It is cable knit so on the sleeve if it is pulled taught you can see color through it. It doesn't bother me but I thought I would let those of you reading reviews know, in case it is a deal breaker for you. It is also long. Not so much that you look goofy (depending on your height), but enough that it can pretty much cover my bum while standing. I think it is nice when it is cold, but if that isn't something you like, now you know it does do that. I'm 5'9 and around 150 and I purchased a Large for size reference. Hope this review helps, as I looked and debated about this coat forever, and I'm glad I finally bought it!

reviews.title: Super cute! Loving the pockets!!
reviews.text: I usually wear a size 12/14 pants, my waist is 33", and I bought the large. If it had a little elastic piece it would have fit perfectly. However it's a tad loose and sits a little lower than where I want and gets even more loose throughout the day. Its not too bad, may try a medium next time. Would recommend based on quality of material and stitching. Will be buying more!

reviews.title: Fits well, arrived fast, has a zipper and pockets
reviews.text: Cute skirt! I am 205 lbs. and wear size 18 jeans and the XXL fits me with a bit of room to spare. The zipper helps make it easy to put on, too. It does have pockets and the colors are true to what the pictures showed. As other reviewers have stated, it does need to be ironed after removing it from the clear plastic packaging, but it did arrive fast and safely. I might order another pattern in the future since so many cute designs are available.

reviews.title: TOO MUCH TO IRON.
reviews.text:
I’ve bought 4 of these skirts because I really like the designs. They’re fun and chic. If you like to Iron these will be great to Iron for a good 5 min or more. If you’re always rushing out of the house....These are definitely NOT for you.
If it wasn’t too hard and annoying to iron them I would’ve given 5 stars.

Other than that the price is quite reasonable and the colors are as bright as the pictures.

reviews.title: Lovely skirt
reviews.text: Such a beautiful skirt! I bought this skirt for wearing to dog shows. I got a lot of compliments on it! Pockets worked perfectly for a small comb and brush and treats as well as cash.

reviews.title: Order your size
reviews.text: I bought this skirt for myself and my daughter. I ordered a large I have a 34" waist and a small for my daughter. Who is a 30 " waist.

reviews.title: It Has Pockets.
reviews.text: Very cute skirt and has pockets! I ordered a small and had a bit of extra room in the waist when I wore the skirt at my true waist. I hemmed the skirt to make it a mini skirt otherwise the skirt was below my knee at 5'3". In the photo I am wearing a crinoline underneath to make the skirt a bit more poofy. I would recommend this skirt. Very comfortable.

reviews.title: Lovely skirt, excellent price!
reviews.text: Love this skirt so much. I have a similar skirt (from another seller) in a different pattern. I deducted one star as the skirt's fabric is a little see-through on the white part. That said, it will be an excellent summer skirt, I will just have to make sure to wear a slip or nude undergarments. While the pleats are annoying to iron, it wasn't as miserable as some reviewers let on (and this was my first time ironing pleats!). As for the fit, a medium fit be wonderfully. I don't know my exact measurements, but I am 5'6", and fluctuate between 140-150lbs, with a somewhat athletic build. The medium fits me very comfortably as a high-waist skirt (as it is intended to be). If I lose weight, I could see where a medium may be a smidge too big, but think it would still fit nicely if paired with a cinch-waist belt. Plus, it comes with two different buttons at the top of the zipper closure, allowing you to make it a tiny bit tighter if need be.

reviews.title: Love the Skirt!
reviews.text: I actually ordered a 3XL, but they sent a 2XL. It worked to my benefit because the 2XL fit perfectly. The 3XL would have been too big. I love, love, love the way the skirt hangs. It flares out a bit and hits me at the center of my knees. I am 5'9. Love the pockets. I will say that the skirt has no give or stretch in the waist band so make sure you order the right size. I am 227 pounds so like I said the 2XL fit just right.

reviews.title: Gave it a shot as the pants are gorgeous and I'm in love. Wish they had more colours
reviews.text: I was very hesitant to purchase this pants especially with the fact that I'm on the plus side and very curvy. Gave it a shot as the pants are gorgeous and I'm in love. Wish they had more colours . It has stretch in it and is true to size.

reviews.title: Perfect Paperbag Pant
reviews.text: Goodness was I pleased when I received this! The pant and belt came in a Grace Karin plastic product bag along with a Grace Karin thank you note! I am 5'1 and 128 lbs (pear shape) - I ordered the MEDIUM in Black. I wear this pant around my natural waist, and the length hits right around my ankles. There are no zippers or buttons - stretchy material (almost like dry-fit). Elastic cinched at waist where belt goes, looks very well seamed and remains classic looking. 98% Polyester and 2% Viscose. Super comfortable, and very breathable. Belt came with the pant and is a perfect length, plenty of room for a bow. I highly recommend this pant for anyone looking for an affordable paperbag pant that needs to move around a lot (very forgiving because of the stretch). I can wear this to the office, to the park, or to a nice dinner. Dress this up or down! Perfection!

reviews.title: Pockets for multiple needs!
reviews.text: These pants are sooo cute, and they have pockets! I am an event planner and wore them to a corporate conference with booties, and received so many compliments (even an email asking where to buy)! For reference, I am 5’2” at 125lbs and ordered a small

reviews.title: Comfortable & Perfect for work
reviews.text: So comfortable! I’m 5’1” 150lbs ordered a large & these fit perfectly! The material texture is great & doesn’t feel cheap at all. I could’ve ordered a medium but wanted them to fit a little baggy and below the ankle bone. I also purchased the shorts version this way & they fit the same way. Probably going to order the pants in every color for work.

reviews.title: Flattering and well made
reviews.text:
5'7" with 25" waist and 36" hips. Purchased size small.

Super cute. I ordered the light blue color and it's true to color (I'm standing in direct sunlight by my window). Waist band is elastic with removable belt. Pockets are deep. Didn't flatten my booty as I feared. Plenty of room for my ankles despite the skinny style silhouette. Material is lighter weight with stretch. Seams and finishing look great. Unless it spontaneously falls apart on me in the wash, I'm calling these a win.

reviews.title: Very flattering for a curvy bum.
reviews.text: I dont wear pants EVER, because I dont like my buttcrack hanging out. Not an issue with these pants! I'm a bigger girl, I'm very curvy (smaller waist and very thick thighs and bum) and 5'10", 190 lbs, and these pants (xxl) fit AMAZING! They are very classy and modern. I really like the length, they will be super cute with a pair of ballet flats. I'm not a huge fan of the material, though. I imagine they will be way too hot to wear in the summer, but come fall they will be a staple piece. They're very thick, and polyester in 100 degree heat is NOT a good idea. All in all, I'm very satisfied and happy I bought these. You turned a strictly skirt/dress wearing girl into a pants wearing girl! Thanks!!

reviews.title: two different styles fit differently at waist
reviews.text:
I'm 5'4 and somewhere about 135-140 pounds. I carry more weight in my middle than my legs or hips. I bought the medium based on measurements and found the ruched waist too snug for comfort. I'm returning my medium to try a large instead. The hips weren't overly roomy, so I think I'll be good with the large. Will try to update! I bought these for an international flight hoping they'll be super comfy.

EDIT : 5'4, 140lbs, size 6/8. I ordered a medium in the style without bows at the ankles. The waist was just too fitted for me for comfort, so I returned them for a large. I switched to the bows at the ankle style. What I didn't notice in photos, is that the ones with bows are only half ruched at the waist and the ones without have a fully ruched waist. Had I recognized that, I would have stuck with the original style, because going up one size was more like going up two with that variation. (see photos-- yellow is large, green is medium). The legs were too baggy now and I had ample room in the waist

Ultimately, I'm returning both. The pants are soft and nice quality, but given what I just explained, neither fits. I bet a large in the bow-less ones would, but my trip is in 7 days and…

reviews.title: AMAZING!!!
reviews.text:
All I can say is seriously, what the heck took me so long?!?! I am obsessed with these pants. Vertically challenged over here at 5’ tall and the length is perfect for me. I ordered size small, normally wear a size 4 or 27 in bottoms and they fit comfortably well. They’re lightweight and just feel good. Very flattering and easily can be dressed up or worn casually.

Highly recommend! Thanks for taking the time to read my review. Please click below if you’ve found my review helpful. Should you have further questions, feel free to post above in the appropriate area.

As always, Happy Shopping
Miss Kelly @misskelly.xo

reviews.title: Perfect fit
reviews.text: This is a super comfortable, easily worn either casual or even dressed up if you want. The button detail on the side really is well-placed and helps to move attention away from the center of your core if that happens to be a self-conscious place of yours. The button detail also makes a slight ruching in the fabric covering any areas you might not enjoy seeing if this were form-fitted or of a different material. I see no reason this should not receive less than five stars. It's made very well, it's a good medium weight and very true to the size. It looks great, and I'm very excited that my purchase here turned out to exceed my expectations. I love the design overall from the pictures on the product. But after wearing this to work even as I do work in an office, and then making the transition after work to home life, I couldn't be any happier. It's one of those shirts that I can wear to work, and afterward not feel the need to go home and have to change to be comfortable if I have any plans in mind for the rest of the evening no matter what they may be. Will definitely be recommending this to anyone interested. I've already received many compliments on it.By the way，I change the…

reviews.title: Cute top, order your regular size!
reviews.text:
Adorable top. I am a bust size 36C and I usually wear a medium-large in tops and ordered a medium. I'd say to order your usual size Feel free to watch my full review on the product but I will try to summarize it here.

Pros
-love the color
-soft and comfortable
-can be dressed up or dressed down

reviews.title: sizing (was) off  but soft material and great customer service
reviews.text:
Super soft material but runs large. Wine color was accurate. Sizing seems off. I am normally a M but went with the sizing chart which showed a L. It was way big and did not see m to have much shape to it. Kind of just hung on me. Wanted to love it but was just too large and did not flatter. The neck was also very wide ( more so than I expected). Very long and would work better with leggings as compared to jeans I think.

updated review: seller contacted me and sent me a replacement shirt in a smaller size for the sizing issues I had. The new one fit perfectly and as expected. They were very helpful and had superb customer service! I would buy again from them for that reason alone. Shirt really is adorable and comfortable!

reviews.title: Worked for a Maternity Photoshoot
reviews.text: Actually used it as a maternity shirt since it had extra in the front. Works out so nicely

reviews.title: Color safe???
reviews.text: I washed this shirt on delicate with no additives (bleach, fabric softeners, etc.) along with some other items. Unfortunately, the shirt came out looking like a tie dyed shirt. No one uses the washer but me, and I do not use bleach, so I do not understand the outcome. The style itself and color are attractive and the fit was great....Update on purchase: I was contacted by the seller and am pleased with them and their response. This company is great to deal with and I would not hesitate to purchase from them again.

reviews.title: Quality and Comfortable
reviews.text: Quality made and comfy. Very cute - received compliments right away. Fits as expected. Ordered an XL for 5' 6" - 160 lbs - DD chest as I don't like shirts too tight. I could have ordered a Large and it would fit just right, the XL is slightly big on my frame. I would recommend this shirt to others.

reviews.title: Great shirt.
reviews.text: I love this shirt. I got the blue with buttons on the bottom side. I got a Medium, I am 5’4 and 140 for size reference and it fits perfectly. Gonna buy some of this sellers other styles today!

reviews.title: Comfortable, fit and look as expected.
reviews.text: I now have 4 shirts from Molerani. They were very affordable, fit as expected, look as pictured, are very comfortable, and have held up well after multiple washings. I will buy more in the future!

reviews.title: Not Quite But Good Enough
reviews.text: Okay, I am 6'2 210 lbs and when I bought my last shirt like this a decade ago I purchased it at a local army / navy surplus store. It has lasted great and is getting thread bare :). I read the reviews before buying this one, I normally get XL in every shirt I buy but went with the Large after reading the reviews. I also will buy Longs when available but also opted out of that decision. This shirt fits perfect in the shoulders, the sleeves are plently long and so is the length. If it helps or matters mine was made in Honduras, I would have given this product a 5 star rating but is does not seem to be made with the same weighted material as my original that was made in the USA so long ago. Hope this helps ya all......

reviews.title: Awesome product.
reviews.text: I've worn these shirts year round for 20 years (of course, I live in the Bay area of California where the temperatures are moderate). During the summer, I wear them alone, and during the winter, I put on a shirt over top of them. They wear forever (almost :-)). I will warn you of one thing. Buy one size smaller than you wear anything else (shirt, jacket, vest, etc..). They tend to run large. For example, I normally buy all my shirts, jackets and vests size large. Medium on this Carhartt fits exactly like large on anything else.

reviews.title: Jumbo Sized Shirts - Find a Sizing Chart Somewhere because these are enormous
reviews.text: My career is focused on apparel, especially big & tall athletic apparel, so I really know my stuff on sizing and the fact that no one anywhere in the fashion world agrees on what this size or that size is supposed to mean. However, the HUGE difference usually come at the extremes, the smallest and biggest sizes. I am 6" tall, 215 pounds, 44 inch chest, and I have worn XL in North American shirts for three decades. This Carhartt XL (I double-checked" fits like I borrowed my grandpas pajamas - too long and too wide by a mile. I love Carhartt products and this particular shirt, so I'll send it back and ask for a Large instead. It will be the only large in my wardrobe. Love the shirt - hate the sizing. Sizing can be fixed so I say this is a four-star because Carhartt's sizing model is too far away from the range of industry sizing norms.

reviews.title: All I know is that the medium port long-sleeved Henley fit like an XL
reviews.text: Huge. Giant. Gargantuan. I shouldn't surprised by Carhartt's sizing anymore after owning a few of their shirts, but it's still truly shocking how huge they are. Is this vanity sizing for obese blue collar men or something? No idea. All I know is that the medium port long-sleeved Henley fit like an XL. I'm 5'11"-6', 175 pounds, broad shouldered, not a small guy, and was absolutely swallowed up in this "medium" shirt. Looked like a dress almost. I've read that different colors fit differently which makes it a little complicated, but for sure I'd recommend anyone size down at least one size, probably two, if they're looking at the port color. That said it seemed like a nice heavy, rugged shirt if that's what you're after.

reviews.title: Sizing is hit or miss!
reviews.text: I ordered 2 shirts. Both were the same size. The shirts were different colors, but that was supposed to be the only difference. When they arrived one was too large and the other too small! The product tags printed on the inside of the shirts indicated that they were the same size but were different in design. I then noticed that the shirts were made in different countries. I understand that Carhartt uses many different sources, but they should have consistent sizing regardless of where the shirt was made. If they cannot standardize their sizing I will probably not purchase any more items from them!

reviews.title: 6'3" 195 lbs. and Regular Large fits great.
reviews.text: I love the shirts. They are made out of fairly heavy material and will last a long time. I am 6'3" 195 lbs.. The first two I ordered several months ago in large tall, due to the reviews here saying they run long and large. That turned out to be true. I would normally order at least x-large tall but these fit just fine. I decided to order two more in different colors last week and the large tall were no longer available. I went ahead and ordered the regular Large but not in tall. I really can't see a lot of difference in the large/tall and the large/regular. The regular are also long in the sleeves and the body just like the Tall size. Unless you are the Jolly Green Giant don't worry about these shirts being long enough in the body and sleeves. Regular Large fits me well where I would normally require x-large tall in any other shirt. The Talls are really almost too long so regular is fine.

reviews.title: nice quality, but extremely long shirt
reviews.text: The shirt fits true to size every where, but is much longer than a standard shirt. In the picture, it appears to fall 2 inches below the waist which is normal. However this shirt is about 2 inches longer than it appears. I am wondering if it was mismarked and should be from the big and tall line? So if you are purchasing for a smaller stature, you may want to look for a differerent shirt, or plan on tucking the shirt in. But the quality is very nice and washes well.

reviews.title: Good quality but terrible sizing.
reviews.text: After hinting to my wife that I was needing some long sleeves shirts she decided to surprise me with this Carhartt shirt since its normally the brand of clothes I prefer to buy. When I opened my gift, we were surprised to see that the large size in black was really around an XXL! After being dissapointed about a ruined gift, she requested an exchange as the shirt apart from the extremley large size was great quality. She went ahead and ordered a medium size in the navy blue and even paid the extra couple of dolars for the color of the shirt. The shirt did not arrive in the two day shipping and when we opened up the package, we were again surprised to see how big the medium was. We are returning the shirt as their sizing is nowhere accurate to what it should be.

reviews.title: MEDIUM FOR THICK GIRLS
reviews.text: Well I searched through all the reviews because I had a hard time deciding if I was to get a Medium or a Large. I'm 5'3 and struggle. Between 155 and 159. I did purchase the medium and let me tell you I love it!!! Will be getting more:)

reviews.title: Excellent purchase!
reviews.text: I'm 5'2 and I have a bigger chest, normally a size 8/10 pants from American eagle. A medium fit perfect! Hits just above the knees so it's not too short. Super soft and can't wait to buy more colors!

reviews.title: Black dress fabric is too thin
reviews.text: I ordered the short sleeve dress in red wine and black. Both are made from thin fabric, are very comfortable to wear, and fit great... fitted (but not too tight) in the arms and bust and flows away from the midsection - gives me an hourglass silhouette, which I love! (For reference, I'm about 5'5"/160 lbs/38C) I give the red dress 5 stars, but unfortunately the black one is practically see-through so I'll be returning it, hence the 3-star review. The picture I'm including shows the black dress hanging in front of a window with natural sunlight - as you can see, it is VERY sheer...

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Super comfortable and decent quality fabric. I am 5'9" and 138 ponds and a small fits perfectly. I would order this dress again.

reviews.title: Another great dress!
reviews.text: This is a great dress! It is long enough that you wouldn't need to wear leggings with it if you didn't want too. The fabric is thick enough, so not too see through which is great! I am 5'7" and 150 lbs. and the medium fit me perfectly! If it is any indication on how well I liked it, I bought another one in a different color after receiving this one! It washed up perfectly too! Looks like a new go to dress with flip-flops etc. One more note -- the neck line and sleeves are nice too. The neck fits a little closer so it isn't too wide, nice dress!

reviews.title: Great buy!
reviews.text: Love love love this dress. Very flowy and super comfy. Ordered a large and I am a size 8 usually, large hips and chest.

reviews.title: Love this dress!!
reviews.text: Love love love this dress!! Can be dressed up easily. I'm 5'8 and athletic figure with a tummy. This dress flaunts your figure without being too short or too tight.

reviews.title: This dress is super comfortable! I'm 5'9 and the dress hits a ...
reviews.text: This dress is super comfortable! I'm 5'9 and the dress hits a little before my knees. I plan to order more colors soon.

reviews.title: Everything it says it is
reviews.text: First let me say as a 5'6 220lb gal who wears a size 16 stretch usually, I can never find anything that fits except maybe leggings, sweats and dresses. This skirt is amazing!! I ordered it in a size 16 and not only does it fit but it is also super stretchy so yes it still feels great even after you've been snacking all day and I can even spread my legs shoulder length comfortably lol. This skirt was exactly as described plus more. Sorry I couldn't get better pics, I remembered last minute as I was getting undressed that I needed to write a review.

reviews.title: Be wary about this purchase
reviews.text: Be aware that the seller charges a 20% restocking fee if you are returning the garment because it's the wrong size or color or otherwise not to your taste. How do you find out if an article of clothing is to your taste? You try it on--the cost for trying it on in this case is 1/5 of the purchase price. Also, if you prefer "working" pockets in your garments, be aware that the pockets in this skirt are unbelievably skimpy. They probably could hold a tissue, or a credit card, or a key or two, but not your cell phone or typical key ring or other common pocket items. Compared to other places where I shop (such as Penney's), the sizing on this skirt for me would be one size larger than the other places.

reviews.title: Best Denim Skirts Ever!!!
reviews.text: I ordered three of these skirts in gray, indigo, and medium blue. As for fit, I am 5'3 and weigh 145 pounds. The skirts fit like pencil skirts which I absolutely love, and hit just below my knees. I normally wear a size 6 or 8 depending on the brand. If you want a looser look you will need to size up. Right out the package these skirts feel like your favorite broken in denim jeans. The amount of stretch is perfect as it does not take away from the denim look and feel. After having two kids my tummy can sometimes be my trouble area if the clothes are not well made or if clothes sits too high on my waist. This is not the case with these skirts. The skirts sit at my natural waist and when I sit down I don't feel the need to unbutton them. When standing the skirts give a very flat appearance in the tummy area, which is just what I was looking for. Some denim skirts can look bulky in the tummy area due to the weight of the denim, but these skirts do not have that problem. I just purchased a similar style stretch denim skirt from Banana Republic that was on sale and I still paid twice the cost of the price of one of these skirts. Needless to say, I will be returning the Banana Republic…

reviews.title: If in doubt, order a size down.
reviews.text: If in doubt....order a size down. I'm 5'8" 135lbs. and ordered a 6. It fits great, but is still roomy (the waist is VERY stretchy). I love this skirt! It hits just right in the middle of my knee cap, and I have long legs. Slit in back is not too high. Yay!!

reviews.title: True To Size
reviews.text: I ordered this in a size 6 even though I wear a size 4 because of the reviews that stated this skirt runs small. I was swimming in the size 6. It was much too big. Now I'll return it to get my correct size that I should've ordered in the first place. It's a very nice skirt. Well stitched. No odor. Stylish. I like the length. I didn't want a mini skirt. I'm 5"1, 110 lbs, 27 inch waist, 35 inch hips. I've never tried on a size 6 that has ever fit me. The skirt is true to size. I just think people's butts run fat. A measuring tape to take accurate measurements would help a great deal.

reviews.title: Love these skirts!!
reviews.text: LOVE these skirts! I have 3 now (black denim, grey and light blue). I get compliments every time I wear them. I am 5'4" weigh 175 lbs I have hips and a not too shabby round behind. I purchased a size 12. The skirt fits a bit snug but it has some stretch in it, but the snugness adds to the pencil skirt look and I believe that is the look us ladies are trying to pull off so that is the perfect size I was looking for. Looks cute in flats and super cute in heels! You can dress it down or up... multi-look skirt!

reviews.title: This is the perfect denim skirt
reviews.text: This is the perfect denim skirt! Because of my pear-shaped figure (27 inch waist, 41 inch hips), I often have trouble finding skirts that fit properly. Especially when shopping online. I bought a 10, and it is perfect. Not skin tight, but fitted enough to have the true pencil skirt shape. There is a lot of stretch to the skirt, but the material is nice and thick. One thing - the black looks more like a navy blue to me. But it's not enough to bother me, considering how fabulous this skirt is. Great price too!

reviews.title: Great jacket, but make sure you order a larger size!
reviews.text: I love these blazers! I bought two of them, a royal blue one and a red one. The colors are exactly as they appear. I typically wear an X-Large in tops/jackets/dresses, so after reading the other reviews I ordered a few sizes up. I got them both in 3X and they fit perfectly. If you look at the measurement chart, you can pretty much figure out which size you need to order. They are really soft and flexible, but they still have great structure. You can wear these to work and look professional without your movement being restricted. Great purchase, I seriously recommend. Just watch the sizing!

reviews.title: Fit great. Love the color
reviews.text: I wear a size 16 and I bought a 2X in hot pink. Fit great. Love the color.

reviews.title: PAY ATTENTION TO THE STRANGE SIZING
reviews.text:
First of all, I have to say that it took me a couple of orders with free shipping each way, to figure my sizing out on this blazer. For reference, I am 5' 8" and weigh an athletic 143. My bust is 36", waist is 29" and hips are 38". I normally wear a 6 or sometimes an 8 in U.S. sizing. That is a Small or Medium.

Having read loads of reviews, I ordered this first in both a Medium and Large. The large worked, but was maybe a bit more fitted then I wanted (it was VERY fitted). I like a blazer with some shape to it, but I don't want my bra lines to show right through it. So I next ordered it in XL. This was perfect for me. And the larger size is a bit longer too, which is nice for me because I'm fairly tall.

It's worth commenting here that an item of clothing at this price is not going to be of Designer quality...so be sure your expectations are in the right place. The blazers are quite nice though, flattering and they are unlined and stretchy. I show dogs and need to look nice, but also need to be comfortable and able to move all around, so the stretchy fabric is perfect for me. You can dress these up...or dress them down with jeans. VERY cute.

After finally…

reviews.title: Perfect Fit!!!
reviews.text: I love this jacket. I ordered it in blue and it came rather quickly. I normally wear a size 12 but reading the reviews,I thought I would go up in size. I ordered a 1X. It was a perfect fit. It fit so well that I reordered the red and light green. The red one was not what I expected. It was a little dull but I can make do with it. Nice blazer for the price your paying.

reviews.title: Read all reviews before ordering any product
reviews.text: Love the material. It is kind of stretchy so you have room to move your arms and not feel uncomfortable. Before ordering I read as many reviews as possible and ordered as they said. I am giving the product 5 stars and I am saying it fits as expected only because I researched before buying. According to the size chart I could have ordered a M (8-10) or a L (12-14). I wear a size 10 so I would have ordered the L being it is a jacket. The majority of the reviews said the jacket runs small so I ordered the XL (16-18). I received the jacket and sure enough the reviews were right and the jacket fits perfect just like a 12-14 jacket would fit.

reviews.title: Makes a great uniform jacket.
reviews.text:
This is an inexpensive, and reasonably well made garment. Perfect for use as part of a uniform for my photobooth company, where I hire primarily young women as booth attendants. They all feel comfortable and stylish in this jacket, so I am very happy with this purchase.

*** UPDATE ***

I have since purchased this item many times. I must say that in addition to the quality of the garment, the responsiveness of the company I'm purchasing from: "Kleebon International" has been outstanding. When I needed a blazer in a size that was unavailable, they made it available. When I had a shipping issue, they fixed it immediately, and offered me a free blazer. I am 110% satisfied with this company. Great job!

reviews.title: cute blazer
