reviews.title: Great for Work
reviews.text: Very cute blazer. Definitely fits a tad small. I wear a 34C or Medium in shirts and the Large was a perfect fit. These are cheap and unlined but they do the job as needed. I ordered the Teal and Mint colors and the colors are great. I'll be back for the Burgandy as well.

reviews.title: Warm Sherpa lined Hoodie Jacket
reviews.text: This hoodie jacket is awesome! the sherpa lining is really warm, with the hood up keeps my torso, neck and head perfectly toasty. The sleeves are lined with a slick material with padding, warm.

reviews.title: Good hoody. Zipper sucks!
reviews.text: As other reviewers have mentioned, this is a nice hoody and the zipper is of inferior quality making it both difficult to use and makes me leery as to how long it will last. It's a shame that the company chose to cut corners on an inexpensive component of the garment!

reviews.title: Very pleased with the thickness and feel of this hoodie
reviews.text: Very pleased with the thickness and feel of this hoodie. Hard to find really thick sweat clothes like this. The sleeves are lined with a slick cloth, not just the fleece material, and at first, I was not sure I would like that. But now I find it helps me not overheat. The only potential issue I see is the zipper end. It's small, and if you're not careful, it won't seat properly, and then the zipper quickly comes undone.

reviews.title: Perfect! Beyond expectation!!
reviews.text: This cloth is super warm with plenty of fur inside. And the outer layer is very soft and comfortable. Most importantly, I thought such kind of cloth would be somehow heavy but indeed it is very light! Really satisfied with it and recommend you buy it!

reviews.title: Fits Somewhat Large But Nice
reviews.text: This is a very nice item and pretty comfortable to wear. It fits slightly larger than most items that size that I buy so I would probably recommend one size smaller than you are use to for a normal fit. I took one star off just because of the sleeves...yes from reading the reviews I already knew they didn't have the fleece lining in them ( you should reconsider this really ) but I took off because of how long they are...My goodness when I let them hang they are at leas a half inch past my finger tips...maybe a full inch. Were these things designed for humans or an ET type species? It could be because of the somewhat large size as well but wow was I shocked by the arm length. Overall though not a bad sweatshirt...I would buy again...in a smaller size.

reviews.title: Can't go wrong with Sherpa!
reviews.text: First I want to acknowledge the Amazon representative for helping me out with this order due to a miss communication before it shipped. Thanks again! Onto the product itself, this is the first time I've ordered through this company and as of now, I'm pretty impressed. I wear it to go to work; with that said, anyone that lives in the northeast knows how brutally cold winter gets here! After many back and forth trips to the mall due to size/quality issues I finally took to amazon and scoped this one out. The sherpa material is sooo comfortable and the hoody itself fits just right. I'm giving it a few weeks yet just to make sure it doesn't fall apart at random but as of now I will say it's a keeper!

reviews.title: get a larger size

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
It's a beautiful hoodie. Looks nice on and is fairly warm. My son could feel a breeze through the sleeves when wearing short sleeves but was otherwise warm in it. He's a size medium and it fit well.
It just didn't hold up to wear. Both sides of pockets started tearing at the corners shortly after getting. Zipper was fussy and flimsy. It actually just came off in wash. He wore it for about a month with weekly washings. So disappointing. My son liked it and I thought it looked great on him. It just seemed poorly made. I could have sewn the pockets but I'm not going to replace a zipper.

reviews.title: Best Amazon Purchase
reviews.text: I love love love this dress. I wore it for Easter this year and got so many compliments. My ONLY complaint is the boob area. However, this was only a complaint on Easter when I would have like to have been more modest. I had to pin the dress in the cleavage area to make sure the girls were covered. Since then I have bought another dress in a different color and excited to wear them this summer! BUY THIS DRESS. if you’re second guessing whether or not to buy it.. BUY IT.

reviews.title: Above Expectations!
reviews.text: I love this dress! I wore it when I went to Mexico with my friends and I received a lot of compliments. It’s constructed as a wrap dress, there is no zipper or button. I did have to retie the dress a few times throughout the day but it wasn’t a hassle. You can make it as tight or as loose depending on your body type. I am 5’2, 124lbs, 32B bra size and it fit me perfectly.

reviews.title: Cute and Comfortable
reviews.text: A few flaws with this dress, but overall super cute and comfortable. It doesn't have a button to secure the inside of the dress, but luckily that's an easy fix. From far away polka dots looked white, but up close, they're pink. Still dress is totally worth it. The cuteness and comfortable factor kind of outweighed everything. I'm about to buy it in different colors.

reviews.title: Too short! Only works for petite ladies
reviews.text: For the price, this is an adorable dress. I paid less than 20 for it. It’s very flattering. You will need to pin the bust area closed unless you are very small chested. I am 5,6” and wear size 8 pants, 36DD bust. This dress is way too short, and I actually really like shorter length dresses. I will be returning. Looks ok in my photos but in reality it barely covers my rear. Very cute dress for shorter ladies.

reviews.title: LOVE THIS DRESS

reviews.title: Be aware if you’re 5’7 & up! SHORT.
reviews.text: I so wish this dress was a tad bit longer. I’m 5’7, 143lbs, A cup & I got the medium. I spent a lot of time going through reviews & thought maybe the large would be too loose on me at the waist, so I took a chance on the med. *The pics where I’m wearing sandals were taken right out of the bag (hence the wrinkles). I steamed out the wrinkles & as you can see, it’s pretty darn short—**I HAD to wear shorts underneath & could not bend over/down without showing my ladybits. I still decided to wear the dress to my friend’s wedding bc I knew I wouldn’t be moving too much. The tie at the waist was okay & I used boob tape to keep the cleavage area secure. I’ll likely give this dress to one of my shorter friends. Dress would’ve been a 10/10 if the length supported taller women (loved the red floral dress design). Go for it if you don’t mind super short dresses.

reviews.title: Cute but a tad smaller than expected
reviews.text: This dress is super cute! I order dresses on amazon often and am always a size small. I am 5'5" and 125 lbs. I got a small but the bust area is a bit tight. I am small chested so it isn't a huge deal but for someone larger than a B cup it would definitely be too tight. I would probably order a medium in the future. We will see after I wash it if it shrinks and then doesn't fit at all. Hopefully that is not the case. Overall it is a cute dress and I really like it. The buttons are just for show which are nice so you don't have to worry about anything showing through gaps. They are wood look buttons but seam to be made out of some sort of resin so It has the potential to crack if it gets hit with something, although I don't see that really being a problem. As far as style I would definitely order this dress again! I will just be ordering a size up next time!

reviews.title: hand wash green size small short pockets
reviews.text:
size small, green skirt with pockets, zipper, flat front, elastic back:
wash=hand wash, i have not washed it yet
pockets= hurray but they are a little bit short, i will need to open them and add cloth to make a useful size. i had bought another skirt (different maker) in the same style that really had useful pockets and i actually LOVE useful pockets...not too big of a deal because it is fixable but a phone or change would explode out as is
color=wow a very beautiful green dancing between emerald and forest, really a good green!
cloth= pretty good, cottonesque, not too shiny (ordered another skirt from another maker that was very surprisingly glam shiny..whoah oh)... but this can be worn at night or in the day without being out of place, very good
size=small is just a little big, just a little but not droopy...come on they are trying...i typically wear between a 2&4, depending on maker, and a size small ...so this is pretty much in line...right now i am a little puffy and might need to take it in a touch but not too big of a deal
length=below my knee, very useful! i am short for an american though, average woman is 5’7” and i am 5’4”...so judge accordingly
so why 4 stars and not…

reviews.text: I’m a size 6. I ordered a small and it was perfect! Great pockets & length.

reviews.title: Perfect dress!

I probably could have done a small but didn’t want it to be too short for work. Perfect dress to dress up with wedges or heels or dress down with booties or sandals.

reviews.title: Comfy & Cute
reviews.text: I just had a baby 2 months ago and my belly is still so chonky. This dress makes the chonk easy to hide, while not swallowing me in fabric or having to wear a shaper. The burnt orange shade is perfect for Thanksgiving and you can stuff as much dressing and gravy down your gullet as you want without your clothing restraining you from living your best life. 10/10 WOULD recommend.

reviews.title: So cute on! Flattering and forgiving shape!
reviews.text: Based on others reviews of it being very wide, I sized down to a small (I usually wear a medium, 6/8, have a small B bra size and like to hide my post baby tummy). I like the slimmer look of the small but if my bra size were any larger, it wouldn’t fit in the chest. Keep that in mind when you choose your size. The fabric is probably going to keep me battling static but nothing static guard or a dryer sheet in my purse can’t handle. The sleeve has an elastic band at the wrist and it flattering, not too long either. The length is appropriate for church or work and is slightly longer in the back. (I’m 5’ 4”) I think it’s very cute!

reviews.title: JUST BUY IT ALREADY!!!
reviews.text: Ok so.... I am 5'9, 260 in weight, 40DD. I have had 3 c-sections so I have a huge belly. I have already purchased the multicolor 1, super excited to get it...knowing this works for my body type.

reviews.title: Very Versatile & Comfortable
reviews.text:
This dress is very versatile. You can dress it up or down. The material is lightweight and not see through. It is very comfortable. The reason I didn't give this a 5 out of 5 is the top portion. If you have larger breasts I would not purchase this. I can only wear this with a sport bra. If I wear a normal bra the material stretches and compacts the girls. I am 5'8 roughly 170lbs for reference. If this was helpful please give it a like.

reviews.title: A good jacket!!

reviews.title: Perfect for the NY fall weather
reviews.text: I ordered medium and I’m actually a very petite person. Fits perfectly a little oversized. Doesn’t have a lining. Very warm.

reviews.title: Very Warm and Comfy Jacket!
reviews.text: I really love this jacket It is so soft and warm. This one does not have a lining which is good. I purchased a similar one that had a cheap lining. It wasn't as plush and soft as this coat, so it was returned. I wanted an over sized look, so I sized up. I am usually a M, but ordered the XL. I also purchased this in another color and got a L. Both sizes work for me. There isn't much difference in the L and XL, but the XL is a little roomier. I have worn this in 20 degree weather, and it still keeps me warm. Great jacket!!

reviews.title: My granddaughter is in love with this coat
reviews.text: My 17 year old granddaughter sent me the link to this coat as a suggestion for Xmas. I ordered it early and it was there in 4 days!! Since she got it, every single picture she sends me has this coat in it. She said she never takes it off - that its so comfy and warm. So - possibly the best $40 I've spent in a while!!

reviews.title: Not over sized
reviews.text: My daughter loved the color and the softness of the jacket, however it fit to sized and was not over sized at all. she always wears a XS or small. I ordered the small because I thought that the style was over sized and that i didn't need to order up for the fit in the pictures. I will be reordering, I just need to order her 2 sizes up to get the same look as pictured.

reviews.title: So cozy!
reviews.text: Love this coat! Ordered in black too! I went with medium, i didn’t want it too baggy. I’m 5’6 and 115 pounds. Medium was the perfect. Large would have been wayyyyy to big. Can still layer things under he medium. Idk why the reviews say the sleeves are super short, they’re pretty normal.

reviews.title: So soft and great quality

I usually wear a 2X to 3X or a US size 20 (EU Size 52 for jackets) and as the material is wuite stretchy the 2X is absolutely sufficient! Very happy with this product and a great price too!

reviews.title: Great Cardigan!

reviews.text: Love this sweater. Great quality. I might even order in another color. I am 5'5" and 160lbs. I normally wear a medium and that is what I ordered and it fits great. I love the long sleeves too.

reviews.title: Love This Sweater
reviews.text: This sweater is well made, I ordered a size or two up ONLY because I love my sweaters loose. If you like it snug, order your regular size. These are nice looking, nicely made, soft to the touch, and are well made. I recommend this purchase. I have ordered 4 of them already.

reviews.title: Thick but not too thick
reviews.text: This is the perfect basic cardigan! I got a medium because I wanted it to fit a little looser. It’s thick but not too thick + it’s not itchy! I wouldn’t wear it with a long sleeve underneath because I’d probably be way too hot a short sleeve or tank top is perfect. But I’m suprised with how much I like the material.

reviews.title: Great for sweater weather
reviews.text:
I own 5 different sweaters from this brand and I love 4 out of 5 of them. They make great quality sweaters. I wish they were a little cheaper but I'm ok paying $40 for a high quality sweaters. This one is made of very warm and cozy material. The yellow color is perplexing. In natural light it's a beautiful golden rod yellow...but indoors, to my eyes it looks like a putrid yellow. I still love it and will likely buy another next payroll.

I sized up because I'm tall & long sleeves are always a problem for me. I like the sleeve to come down past my wrist to the base of my hand at the very least.

Sleeves are great length. The sweater itself is pretty long. I think I could probably size down and be ok with the sleeves length. It looks quite oversized on me, which is completely fune by me as I like that look. It's good to throw on over whatever I'm wearing when I get cold.

reviews.title: Beautiful, soft, long...highly recommend!!
reviews.text:
I REALLY like this sweater! It is very soft (no itch whatsoever) and LONG, which I am picky about because I am on the taller side. I am almost 5’9”/155-ish lbs. and ordered an XL because I wanted a less fitted look and more baggy. It looks great with leggings! I like that it can be worn out or simply be a comfy home sweater. Also the teal/blue color is gorgeous.

The only minor thing is the bottom button seems slightly out of place, so when it’s buttoned, it puckers (as seen in my second photo). But I just leave it undone and it’s fine. It’s not worth getting mad about when overall the sweater is fantastic. 😊

reviews.title: Don’t underestimate this coat
reviews.text: So before I talk about the coat, I want to address something that I have seen in some of the reviews: This Teddy Coat does not look like the product picture with the model. If you scroll down to the details, they look more like those. Now, they are “robe like” but that’s what they are suppose to be. They are plush like (like a stuffed animal or teddy bear), so I can see why people think it looks more like a robe, but it has a noticeable lapel and more structured than a robe. They are actually pretty well made and super soft for the price! This look is not for everyone, but if you keep your outfit minimal with some cute boots and fashionable crossbody bag, you can make it look chic. This is me show the lapel so you can see the collar and material in natural sunlight. The thing I recommend is to try it first dressed as you would, makeup done etc, and see if you like the look. If not you can always return it and if you do like it, just wash it before you use it because it sheds a little bit. I got a medium which fits right, but i think I should have gotten a Large to give it that “oversized “ look I was going for. I’m tall so it works out for me, but if you’re shorter, you might want…

reviews.title: Warm, cozy, cute despite construction issues (updated review)
reviews.text: Updating my original 1-star review below to reflect a couple of things. 1. The seller is wonderful. When I contacted them for a return they were quick to respond, apologetic for the issues and offered a large discount in lieu of a return since return shipping would be more than the credit. I opted to keep the item and take the discount. 2. I have worn this all “winter” in Charleston and lent it to several friends when they just had to try it. Not only do I get lots of compliments and “oh! I want one!” It is so incredibly soft and warm! It even kept my poor mother warm at a hospital visit when the ER blankets couldn’t. I stand by my concerns with the overall cut and sewing of the jacket but find that people say it is flattering, fun and comfy anyway. I am tempted to order more as gifts just to make friends and family happy and cozy. ORIGNAL REVIEW: Having read reviews I ordered this coat expecting a soft, oversized item that could be construed as a bath robe or just a cool, fluffy outer layer. The product that arrived is fluffy and oversized but is sewn in such a way that it never quite falls into place as a coat or robe. The back panel is too narrow so that the pockets fall…

reviews.title: This coat is JUST what I wanted!!
reviews.text: So - I don't normally leave reviews but there were so many conflicting reviews on this coat so I wanted to share my experience. For those looking for a traditional "thicker" teddy bear coat - this isn't it. And, that's fine by me. For me - a thicker coat would make me look like a linebacker, which is why I never bought any of the ones in the stores. However, it is a nice, thinner, teddy-bear coat - and for me it does not feel like a "blanket". It DOES have a lining. I also find it true to size. I ordered a XXL which fit perfectly. The arm length was also good for me, and it stops right at my knee - which is what I wanted. It arrives in a vacuum-sealed package, however I did not experience a "smell" upon unpacking, as other reviews indicated. Hope this helps:)

reviews.title: Not what the picture shows
reviews.text: I am so tired of this happening. The picture shows one thing, you get something else. This is the case with everything I have ordered that comes from China. The coat is not as pictured. It is a different fabric and ill fitting. it is longer than pictured. it is entirely different. When I ordered this I did not realize it came from China. It costs more to ship something back than I paid for it. BEWARE!!!!

reviews.title: Nice cardigans!
reviews.text:
I bought two of these cardigans on a lightning deal in different colors. I wasn't sure which size would fit better based on reviews and the size chart, so I got a L and XL. The teal was an XL and the fuchsia was L. They both fit about the same! I guess the teal is slightly larger, but it's not enough difference to really be noticeable since the material is so stretchy and the front is drapes. The material is nice, very soft and comfortable. I removed one star because the hem is on the outside for some reason. It's designed that way, but it looks funny because it looks like an unfinished edge on the outside of your cardigan instead of sewed inside like it should be.

Size reference: 5'4, 180lbs., 36DD. Both sizes worked fine for me!

reviews.title: Kept me warm all week!!
reviews.text: [[VIDEOID:ce23c94cef44d99055cc3c0c77befaa4]] Ordered for a trip i was taking to Yellowstone National Park where it was between -9° to 18°. I only wore a Long John top and a t shirt underneath my jacket and I was warm.

reviews.title: Warm but snug
reviews.text:
I'm 6'2", and weight 240 with a belly and bought a XXL. I needed a XXXL. Note it runs small if you have more to love. While it does keep me warm, very much so in fact, when its zipped up there is no room inside, my belly presses against the front of the jacket.

Seems it's full of pockets. It's not. It's got an inner left breast pocket, two outer chest pockets (with NO closure to the pockets, meaning what you put in these outer chest pockets WILL fall out), two front outer pockets at waist level with zippers and a outer left arm/elbow area pocket with zipper.

Thick and warm! The sleeves have a "sweatshirt" style wrist collar which keeps drafts out of your arm area in the jacket. When wearing this jacket dont wear gloves which go way past your wrists. You can. But will find the jacket arms will have to be pulled back possibly exposing your arm to cold temperatures. Best just to wear wrist length gloves.

I've noticed odd placement of decorations on the jacket. Such as a strip of rubber along the main zipper flap down the middle of the jacket. It serves absolutely no purpose. And why rubber? Also the pull tab for the same zipper is made of rubber. Again, why?

And if you want a…

reviews.title: Wanted to love it....but was too small
reviews.text:
Seemed like a nice enough coat. Not sure how warm it would have kept me as I didn't get a chance to test it because of the size. Seemed rather thin to me [insulation].

I'm 5'11", 200lbs and I ordered the XL. Fit okay with just a t-shirt on, but if I put any other layers on, I would have been too restricted. The ole arms stretch test [bend arms at elbows and flex forward] failed as well. Just fit me too snug all the way around. Sleeve length was fine [normally a 35 1/2 for me] and the wrist bands were comfortable and not itchy like some coats I've tried. Length was just below my rear end, which is what I was looking for.

The one thing that really drives me nuts, is the zipper on the left rather than the right. I know it's that way for many women's clothes and I believe it may be a European thing as well but not sure. I just can't get used to it. Returning was not a problem and that's why I'm a Prime member.

I only docked it one star for it being thin IMO and the zipper reversed. Otherwise, it was a good looking jacket.

reviews.title: Great parka but runs small; pocket wasn't sewn completely
reviews.text: I ordered two of these Parkas; one XL for myself (5'10" 216 pounds) and one XXL for my husband (6'4" 220 pounds). Unfortunately, both of these fit us but the underarm area felt too small. It made the jacket a bit uncomfortable. I tried his XXL parka on - and it fit great, if not a bit big (but I like the extra room for my sweatshirts I wear in the winter). I ended up returning the XL and ordered a XXXL for my husband. We are hoping it fits as well as the XXL did for me. The material is very comfortable and we both LOVE the fur around the hat. It's a great jacket for just being out in the cold or it's dressy enough to wear to an event in the winter. I did find a hole in the left pocket of my jacket (the one I am keeping). It appears it was missed when the garment was made. I was able to get is sewn together (but the pocket feels a little strange). But for the price of the jacket, it wasn't worth it to send it back. Overall, a great purchase.

reviews.title: Great purchase!
reviews.text:
There are so many great reviews here that helped me decide on my purchase, so I only have a little bit of info to add. I ordered the Aqua and the Mint, as I could not tell from the images here or searched online which one I would prefer. I'm attaching 3 pictures that I hope will help future buyers who may have the same dilemma! They're both very pretty and bright! For the record, I really liked the mint in person but it didn't go well with my rain boots and it is a much darker hue than I hoped, and I LOVED the aqua, so my decision was easy. For size reference, I am 5'3, about 140lbs and I'm wearing the size Small here with a relatively thin sweater underneath. It's comfortable and I can cross my arms across my chest pretty well considering the fabric has little give, if any. I would only size up had I planned to wear a heavy fleece under this jacket, but I do not, and sizing up may cause me to lose some of the flattering shape.
I love this jacket (finally, a hood with drawstrings on a rain jacket!) and my only complaint is the zipper, which sticks and seems very cheap/plasticky. It's not enough to make me return it, not by far. I've been looking for a great rain jacket for probably…

reviews.title: IN LOVE
reviews.text: This jacket is simply perfect! I live in Seattle and have been searching for a "girly" rain jacket for quit some time. This was exactly what I was looking for. The material is soft, flexible and very comfortable. The color is exactly as pictured! I wear a size 13/14 pant and L/XL t-shirts & sweaters. I was worried about the fit but to my surprise the XL fits perfect and I can comfortably wear a sweater underneath. So grateful to this company for making a wonderful product of good material and fashionable at the same time!

reviews.title: Plus Size Fits!
reviews.text:
*pictures not true to color. It is an actual bright coral.

For those wondering I'm 5'5" and normally wear a 2XL shirt. I bought a 3XL coat in coral to make sure I had room and I still would recommend this sizing up! For women worried about upper arms fitting, mine are pretty big and it fits comfortably. You don't have the problem here where they size up everywhere else BUT the arms. I have full range of mobility. I'm also bigger busted (42 DD) and have wide hips(size 22 pant). The jacket isn't tight on either place and ends just past my butt.

The coat fits perfectly and I even have some room to spare in case I wear a bulky sweater underneath! It's light with several spots to let air in to breathe. The fabric does make a crinkling sound BUT isn't thick and rubbery.

There are a few features I found that no one mentioned! I love all of them but to be better informed they are:
-zipped & fleece lined pockets
-holes under the armpits for breathable air
-a double front zipper
-a cord around the bottom of the jacket to make it fit closer to your body
-same type of clip on the hood

reviews.title: Excellent quality, perfect for camping/hiking, looks good
reviews.text:
I have tested this raincoat in two hiking trips in the last 4 months, and it has worked beautifully. It protects me from the wind (especially if I tighten the sleeves, zip up all the way, and put the hood on), and it stops the rain. I tested it in the rainy conditions while hiking in Peru (at the end of the wet season/ beginning of the dry season), and I can report back that it perfectly protects the clothes from getting wet, and keeps the warmth very well. Additionally, the pockets are very convenient, as they are big and they zip up all the way, so you can put anything you want to have on quick access there (like your phone) without being worried about losing it (or about it getting wet in the rain). Finally, it is also easy to clean: just wipe it with a wet cloth.
So my conclusion: it is highly functional in the camping environment, very well made, and cute. Excellent quality and a great look. I am very glad I bought it, and I would highly recommend it.

And I cinched one of the sleeves, because I'm a true pear shape with dainty wrists and ankles. I like how it fits, and can't wait to try it as a band booster parent during the rainy band competitions! I would have really liked a dark green or vegas gold for our school colors, but oh well. At least the kids can find me! Lol It is slightly crunchy sounding, but if it's waterproof I DON'T CARE if it makes noise! I'm just glad I don't look like I'm wearing a tent!

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: I love this jacket! I use it when I ride my bike to work, so the reflective parts are perfect. The material isn't the standard waterproof "swishy" material, but an almost semi-rubbery kind, which works incredibly well against the rain! One thing I wanted to point out though was that a couple people who reviewed this jacket said it ran small. They don't. I got a medium when I'm usually a small because of this and it is definately quite roomy. I don't mind because I don't care what I look like in the rain, but for those who do, get your size and save the return hassle.

reviews.title: Great Quality, Cute, & Comfortable
reviews.text: With the holidays coming I like to stock my wardrobe with clothes that are comfortable, warm, and easy to dress up as needed. This shirt turned out to be all three! I am almost 5'8" and weigh about 150lbs. I don't like to take my measurements every time I shop, so I ordered a large according to an estimate based on my height and weight. It fits exactly as I hoped. It has a flattering fit, not too long, not too tight. I was pleasantly surprised that the neck is a little wider than the listing picture shows. I love the way it fits! I can wear it with jeans or leggings and not feel self-conscious. The buttons are a cute detail and they don't get in the way or weight the shirt down at all. The best surprise about the shirt though was the material itself. I included a picture of me stretching the material to show how thick it is. It has a great thickness and comfortable weight. Overall I am thrilled with this purchase and am considering buying another one in another color.

Overall though, it has a nice feel and will be a comfortable top! I'm exchanging mine for a small rather than returning it if that tells you anything :)

I will be buying more and would encourage you to seriously consider these jeans. reviews.title: Good luck getting the color you order!
reviews.text: This review isn't so much about the jeans, but about the process of ordering jeans. This was my second attempt at ordering a pair of relaxed fit Wrangler jeans. I've been wearing relaxed fit Wrangler jeans for years. I normally buy them at Walmart, but now, for some reason, the shade of jeans I normally buy, the lighter, stone washed color, isn't available. So, where to turn? Amazon, right? So I thought. Not so much. This was my second attempt, I returned the first pair because they were straight leg. So I looked at the tag in the current pair that I own and punched in the number in the search box on Amazon. This listing came up. So, I'm looking for the lighter colored jeans and you'd think by looking at the picture and the fact that the color is STONE BLEACH that I'd be receiving a lighter colored pair of jeans. Nope. Strike two. So, I'm needing a pair of jeans as I've worn out a couple pair recently, so I've just decided to keep these. So, I guess, just a word of caution, if you're expecting a certain shade of blue jeans when you order from Amazon, don't be surprised if you have to send them back more than once or twice.

reviews.title: Great Fit, Great Price!
reviews.text:
I haven't bought jeans in years, and I'm so glad I got to try these Wrangler Relaxed Fit jeans. I am a 47-year old man who weighs in at 250. I carry all my excess weight right around the middle... my legs are sculpted from carrying my Santa Claus belly. And this generally causes problems with what pants.

Usually, in a size 38 or 40, the waist is quite snug and the material around the legs can flap like flags in the wind. That's the proportion issue, but in this case, everything works out nicely. I wish I had work pants for the office like this! The relaxed fit looks like it should be a normal relaxed fit, and they actually fit and look better than normal jeans. This means a lot to me, and I imagine a normally proportionate male would find these jeans to be comfortable relaxed fit jeans as well -- I don't see this as being a case of the perfect fit just for me.

And sporting a $20 price tag? Fantastic price for a good quality pair of jeans. I'm very happy with them and will be buying a couple more pairs soon or putting them on my wish list for Christmas. I highly recommend them!

reviews.text: I like it, doesn't look quite as slick as the picture but overall not that disappointed. Great bargain. I'm 6'3", 180 and appear rather thin. I bought the large which is a little looser than I would have hoped for, a little too wide in the chest. But I was hesitant to get a medium because the sleeves might have been too short. Sort of wish I would have taken a chance on the medium as I typically wear shirts and jackets in that size. I listened to the reviews saying "go a size up". But it's a nice jacket and I look forward to wearing it. I recommend not getting a size up from what you normally wear!

reviews.title: Do not buy this item Poor quality, buttons in the wrong places
reviews.text:
Do not buy this item
Poor quality, buttons in the wrong places, will not do up, thin material, feels cheap and nasty, short arms, wool is poor and thin, if it's even real wool

reviews.title: Five Stars
reviews.text: Perfect fit and great quality!

reviews.title: Fits Skinny people with ease!
reviews.text: Fits great!!! Great material used & is very warm! Now, living in California this is warm, I don't know how it'll hold up in colder places, but a great fitting coat. I'm a tiny man. Around 120lb, 5'10 and it fits wonderfully! (Size small of course)

reviews.title: Love this coat
reviews.text: The coat is very nice. I get a lot of compliments on it. Haven't had any problems with the buttons but at the same time, I haven't worn it for too long. The fit is good. I like my jackets to be snug rather than big. Form fitting if you will. I am a 6'1 195 lbs. with a 33 waist. My suit size is a 40 Regular with the jacket not needed to be taken in. I got the large and although it fit well, seeing as I like my clothing tailored to my body, I felt like I could've gotten away with the medium. Nothing $25 and my tailor cant fix for me. I was in contact with the seller and asked a few questions. I was met with a kind and swift response. Did I mention the price is amazing?! This jacket isn't the thickest but it's perfect for days that are chilly but not freezing. I have other pea coats for that. This is perfect with a scarf.

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text:
Very good looking jacket light weight then a normal pea coat. Nice color only reason it got 4 stars and not 5 is because the buttons are all lose and will eventual need to be sewed up or they must fall off and get lost also inside of jacket is black and it makes it look kinda cheap but all and all a good jacket after I fix the buttons. I ordered the XL and it fits pretty well I read in the description that it was a slim fit I usually wear L in slim fit but wanted to be safe that's why I went a size up I'm 5"6 210 pounds short and little heavy fits well

Update 1 day later: After only one day later I decided to return the coat 2 of the buttons fell off on their own and some of the stitching was already coming off not very good the color once I seen it in the sun light was not very good it looked like a carpet that would be in a medical office. So I'm returning it

reviews.title: True to size...photos and measurements listed below.
reviews.text:
UPDATE 11/1/18: This coat held up well last winter. I lived in a town center and walked everywhere to run errands--in wind, rain, sleet, fire and locusts. As it's starting to get chilly again, I've unpacked the coat and am looking forward to wearing it again this winter. Details below.

*****

12/14/17: I was looking for a longer down coat under $100 that is actually fitted and doesn't make me look like a marshmallow. I ordered a Small.

My stats: Age: 30s | Height: 5’ 3” | Weight: 135lbs | Bra size: 34D | Waist: 29” | Hips: 39” | Shape: lean pear

Quality - standard, good. No rips in the lining, snaps & zippers all worked well. Hood came slightly matted (top, center) where it was folded in half, but I expect it will fluff out with time.
Warmth - lightweight as expected (after reading the reviews), but definitely warm enough (I live in the US mid-atlantic region). I have room to layer when the weather is especially cold. But it's NOT puffy!
Sizing - THIS BRAND IMPROVED THEIR SIZING FOR 2018, and the Small that I ordered fits as expected. The length covers my butt. The shapely cut of the coat itself is awesome, and clearly the majority of buyers love this fit. If I'm being hyper…

reviews.title: 5’9”, 160lbs The Size Large fits just right
reviews.text:
[[VIDEOID:cda76993e32d8674b3445da8822cdeb]] For reference:
5’9”
160lbs
Bra size B
medium sized T-shirt
Size 6 jeans

I love this coat. The fit is great. I am wearing a size Large. I returned the medium because I found it to be too tight in the bust area, and shoulders. It is a very warm coat.

A negative would be the zipper. Because the teeth are large, it makes zipping more difficult.

reviews.title: California Gal to Boston - Tested and FREEZING Weather Approved
reviews.text:
I opened the package, tried on the coat, and I worriedly thought, "As LIGHTWEIGHT as this coat is, will I be warm?" … I was AMAZED! (and warm!)

I am a California gal who has never been to the East Coast. I live near the beach where the climate remains fairly warm throughout the year. The late evening, early morning low varies, and is currently a tolerable 50 F . Very rarely am I challenged by the elements. The most extreme being rain. During the "winter" season, I am the type of individual that runs cold, sets the heater to 70, walks around with my sweater and UGGS. When it's chilly outside, and I mean 60 degrees give or take, I leave the house at the most with a Ralph Lauren knit sweater.

I was notified by my employer that I would be traveling to Boston to complete training for two weeks, arriving January 3. That's right, California Gal to Boston in January, the coldest month of the year with an average low of 22 F. Being someone, who (runs cold) does not tolerate cold temperatures very well, and now I'm off to a freezing climate, and for two weeks?! I immediately panicked. What do I wear? I don't even own a pair of gloves, or clothing that supports such a cold…
