reviews.title: LOOK HERE FOR PLUS SIZE REVIEW.
reviews.text: This coat in regular sizes runs small. In plus sizes, it runs big. This caused me to buy and return this coat three times. First of all, it is confusing that there is a XXL and a 2X. I am a size 18, and I bought the XXL 1st. The XXL fit beautifully on my arms and in length, but the coat wouldn’t come together at the zipper. (I wear varying sizes 16/18/20 at lane Bryant and typically can wear any XXL. So I decided if it runs very small, and the XXL and 2x are probably the same, that a 3x would do? Wrong. The 3x was enormous on me at my size 18. I returned it and got 2x, which I am wearing now as I type this review. It is definitely big and kind of bulky looking because of its size. Like, I could probably cross my arms and zip this coat around me. Which is the last thing a plus size woman wants. So, I have ordered the 1x and I finally believe that this will fit. With that being said, I would never have gone through this trouble if the coat wasn’t absolutely beautiful. I love the pockets, I love the zipper, the hood... the pockets are deep and can easily fit my phone and keys etc and are soft inside. The coat is very warm, and a flattering length. Fingers crossed that my 1x fits well.…

reviews.title: NO LONGER RUNS SMALL!! Great coat!
reviews.text:
I'm 5'6" and 115lbs and an XS fits me perfectly. The company clearly did resizing for the 2017 season and this coat no longer runs small. I followed everyone's advice to order a size up only to find myself with two coats I had to return. If anything, the coat now runs a little large. I went to Eastern Europe with my XS and had enough room to wear a tank top, long sleeve shirt, and a sweater under my coat.
This is a great coat for the price! It is a bit thin so I was worried I would be cold but with layering my clothes and the hood I was great. The coat is super cute and the fur is of great quality, as everyone says. Def buy this coat but BUY YOUR REG SIZE.

reviews.title: 2 or 3) and this 2x fits beautifully with enough space to wear a sweater underneath
reviews.text: Just writing this bc I'm always grateful for the plus size reviewers on here. I'm 5' 4', 270 pounds, and typically wear a size 16/18 (Torrid/plus sizing: 2 or 3) and this 2x fits beautifully with enough space to wear a sweater underneath. Very warm, honestly the warmest coat I've ever owned. The fur is meh, it's super soft and looks nice, but there's a little bit of space between it and the hood that makes it pretty obviously detachable, but the coat looks fine without it. It's pretty long, it hits me just above the knee and I have to kind of wiggle it up to sit down in it. Overall, definitely worth the prize and true to size. Will try and update with a photo soon!

reviews.title: OMG!!!
reviews.text: I love this coat!! I'm 5' 4 and a size 8/10. I ordered the medium and it fits perfectly. I wore it today with a cardigan underneath....and the HOOD!!! I love it. Just buy it. Do it. Now.

reviews.title: Pockets NOW
reviews.text: These jeans fit well and I like the color and cut, but how am I supposed to carry around my seditious pamphlets about giving women the right to vote? Oh wait, we gained that nearly one hundred years ago! So why can't I have any gol-derned pockets, Levi? These stupid things are only TWO inches deep! I can carry a lighter, maybe some change, but I don't trust anything to stay in there. You lose one star, Levi Strauss and Co., for this nonsense.

reviews.title: Budget line of Levi...stop the hate.
reviews.text:
Okay folks did some research, because I WANTED to HATE on these. These are the WaterLess jeans of SIGNATURE by LEVI Strauss & Co. One of the main differences between Levi's and Levi Strauss Signature is the price. The Signature line was created to meet the needs of a more value-conscious consumer. It is considered a budget line available at a lower cost. Okay now that that is out of the way, and I understand the backstory, I will quit the hate. At least a major company is trying to help Main Street in some kind of way.
At 5'6" weight 185 with a 42 - 32 - 44, I also have "thunder thighs" and the jeans are 33x32 so that means they are a whole inch longer than necessary...pity they do not offer a short on this site.
Tag stats: 78% Cotton - 20% Polyester - 2% Elastic...for the record Spandex is just an anagram of the word "expands". Same stuff guys.
Back to business, these jeans cling...nawl strangulate my big ole thighs like jeggings.
Ladies you NEED a BELT. When you dip, they slip, and drip. It is not a total plumber feel, but you'll know it if "the Hawk" came whizzing through.
For my own personal dimensions it would serve me no good to get a larger size for my thighs because the…

reviews.title: Long enough and great fit.
reviews.text: Jeans in long sizes seem to be extremely hard to find locally unless you're looking at plus sizes. The pictured jeans are size 8 long and they fit me perfectly. I am currently 5'9" and weigh 158. My only problem with these is that I sort of expected a better fabric from Levis, but at this price point, it's acceptable to me and I'll take care to wash them gently. I think I look great in these jeans and I'll be buying another pair later this week.

reviews.title: Description
reviews.text: You should not advertise these jeans as being "Modern Bootcut". They are "Midrise Bootcut". BIG difference. Unfortunatley I attempted to shrink them with no luck so I can't return them. Not Happy. I have included a picture. The top pair is what I received from you "MIDRISE Bootcut" and the lower one is an actual pair of "MODERN Bootcut".

reviews.title: Good for curvy ladies.14L
reviews.text: I'm 5'6", hips 45, w 34. 31.5 inseam. Size 14/16 depending on brand. Stretchy jeans that still act and look like jeans. Medium rise but does go inward a little, feels less likely to slide without a belt. Inseam could be a hair longer on these 14L, but I like to wear 2-3" heels with jeans.

reviews.title: Super comfortable, love the length choices
reviews.text:
These are my go-to jeans! I’ve repurchased them repeatedly for years... and by that, you can probably guess that these do wear out! They’re decidedly NOT rugged. YMMV, but the inner thighs of the jeans eventually wear out for me. But this is true of ALL jeans for me, so it’s not a deal breaker. If your thighs don’t rub together much, this may not be an issue for you at all.

They are super comfortable and have just enough stretch to be a little bit fitted without looking or feeling tight. I also love that they come in various lengths because the “short” length is absolutely perfect for me as an almost-but-not-QUITE-petite woman (I’m 5’2”). I wish all pants came in multiple lengths!!!

Bonus points for the boot cut! I know that’s not considered the “in” cut right now, so I’m thankful Levi keeps making these with a boot cut.

reviews.title: Manufacturer defect TWICE, wrong sizes!
reviews.text: I have purchased these pants twice in the past and love them. Not sure if they have a new manufacturer but I ordered an 18L, never had a problem before, received them and they were TIGHT!! I know what size I wear, it's been the same for many a moon. So I checked the tag on the inside, as everything else said 18L, well the inside tag literally says 18L 34X34....A 34 is a size 14!! Thought it was a mistake, got a replacement sent, just received the second pair, SAME thing! Someone needs to so some quality control.

reviews.title: Love the rise on these jeans.
reviews.text: If you are like me and curvy, you know the struggle is real trying to find that pair of jeans that fits at your waste and doesn't gap because your curves are kicking at your hips and thighs. These are so comfortable. I am literally getting rid of my other jeans. I'm so happy that the rise of jeans is back to normal! My boyfriend thinks these my tush look great. The best part is even after wearing them all day, they don't get stretched out and still feel comfortable so I'm not tugging them up half way through the day. I already ordered other colors. I ordered short which works great when I wear tennis shoes and flats and regular length for when I wear heels. I'm 5'4" with a 31" inseam so it's kind of hard to find a perfect length without having to hem everything.

reviews.title: Perfect black shirt. Buy two. You will want them.
reviews.text: I was looking for a black shirt that I could pair with jeans and jackets to dress up or down for work or play. This shirt is indeed very flattering. I am 5'5" with a long torso, but carry almost all of my weight in my tummy and back, so generally I cannot wear anything fitted without getting a much larger size which then looks ridiculously large. I ordered the XL in this shirt and it fits great. It IS very flattering as others have noted and hits me right below my hip at the sides and curves down below my belly and ends about at crotch level in front and at the bottom of my bum in the back. I will note that it has a Nero collar, which I did not catch before ordering which was fine with me but may be a deal killer for someone else. The fabric is smooth and silky which gives it a nice flowy texture. Although fitted, there is still room to belt it and throw a sweater or jacket over for a dressier look. You can also pair it with a pencil skirt and belt it and throw on some tall boots and it looks great that way too. I am very happy with this top and would recommend it highly.

reviews.title: Very nice, comfortable shirt
reviews.text: I weigh 177 lbs and ordered an xxl, fit was roomy but super comfortable, would order again. Nice quality.

reviews.title: Great Work Shirt!
reviews.text: I bought this shirt with the intention to wear it to work (business casual setting) and was not disappointed! I am 5'6" and 130 lbs and it fit me great. It is very flattering and is not made of cheap, polyester material I am used to getting when I buy work shirts at a department store. I plan to buy a few more in different colors later.

reviews.title: Loved then Hated
reviews.text:
Loved and Hated
Great style, comfort and fit. fabulous color purple. I too wanted one in every color. Until the first wash. Total disaster as they recommend professional dry clean. Now I cannot wear it as there are stains that cannot be resolved. So sad. Oh, I didn't professionally dry clean. If I knew this fact before purchase, I would never have bought. Dry cleaning is harmful for our planet.

reviews.title: I should’ve sized down.
reviews.text: It somewhat looks like the photo but not as much. The color is more vibrant on the photo. But it’s still a good shirt. The fabric is a mixture between polyester and cotton. It’s not silky looking. It’s pretty long as well

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: It's a beautiful top. It was a little tight but I should have ordered the next size up, that's on me. It seems to be well made and I love the material. It has just the right amount of stretch. I'm 5'7", weigh 145lbs and my bust is 36DDD. I ordered a large and it was tight across the bust, enough that I won't wear it again. I will order again but in size XL.

reviews.title: Great top, runs large
reviews.text: Runs big, but is somehow still very flattering, so I decided to just keep it. I ordered my typical xl but I could definitely go down to a large and still have a relaxed fit. The neckline, overall shape and the curved hem at the bottom are very flattering. I have a belly and this hides it without swallowing my hourglass shape. Good classic staple piece. You can really dress this up or down depending on jewelry and what bottoms you wear. Material is on the thick side and stretchy. It drapes nicely with no clinging to any bumps or lumps. Just overall a very nice flattering basic top.

reviews.title: LOVE. 2nd purchase!
reviews.text: I hate polo shirts. This shirt is my version of a womens polo. I wear it for a business casual look. Best shirt I've bought recently. Fit is so perfect and comfortable. It covers the back side of arms nicely. The length is spot on. Not too long, and gives coverage. I did add a few stitches to cinch up the v cut. Active job and the shirt still allows me to raise arms without restriction or have the bottom of the shirt riding up. I weigh 230 and bought xxl.

reviews.title: Sexy Look
reviews.text: I love this sweater! It fits large but it is super sexy. I recieved many compliments. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: LOVE
reviews.text: I wanted a super oversized look. I’m typically a size medium but I got this in 2x! Very very comfortable and soft. Not itchy. I love it.

reviews.title: Disregard the haters. They’re confused.
reviews.text:
I just got it yesterday and I am already in love. I wore it to work. I wore it to bed. I am wearing it now.
The people who say it’s not as shown are confused. It’s not a turtle neck. You have to pull it down over the shoulders if you want the off the shoulder look—duh. It is exactly as pictured, if you know how to wear clothes. It doesn’t take a rocket scientist.

It fits magnificently as an oversized sweater. Take into account that I am 5’6/ 132lb. I my bra size is 31C, I am slightly above average height, somewhat broad, have no boobage, and can see my collar bones and ribs without sucking in, and I still ordered a 1X. People love the sweater. It’s comfortable. Not windproof at all, but the look is positively enchanting.

reviews.title: Better then expected!
reviews.text: I ordered the s/m/l size. I usually wear large or xl. It is large. But I think it’s cute. After reading bad reviews I was hesitant about buying this sweater but it was cheap enough to take the risk. It is a bit itchy but not anymore than other more pricier sweaters I own. I love that it’s large to cover any rolls. The shoulders sit a little higher then shown but I’m sure if I stretched it out, it would sit lower on my shoulders. I think the length is good. I’m 5’2 so some are too long. And if I much share.. I’m 175pd and it is very roomy on me.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: LOVE it. Used it for my boudior shoot & also I wear it with jeans. Oversized but comes in at the hips so it's not just huge and unflattering. Was literally exactly what I was going for.

reviews.title: Cute / Fun / Stylish
reviews.text: It’s a pretty cute lounge sweater. I was torn what size but M works well, as long as I roll the sleeve cuffs up once. 5’3” 115lbs Nothing really turns me off by it. I got the taupe color, love the color. Wash it in a lingerie bag or it’ll get fuzzy FAST.

reviews.title: Know your size
reviews.text:
So I read the review on this sweater and did what people said and ordered 2 sized up from my normal size. I range between a medium to large, so I tried to play it safe and ordered an XXL..
That was way to big! I look like a stole my friends sweater. I’m going to have to take it in a bit so it doesn’t look like I don’t know how to shop.
I probably would’ve been fine with a large or XL.
I still like the sweater. It’s great and really cute and comfortable

reviews.title: Awesome sweater
reviews.text: This sweater is so soft especially after it’s been washed! I’m 5’5 145lbs and it fits perfectly with just the right amount of extra room for that oversized look! I can tie it in a knot or do a bra tuck for the perfect look with skirts or high waisted jeans

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: It is heavier and feels better made than my $60 name brand flannel. I'm 6' and a lean 200lbs and the large fits perfect. I honestly can't believe how inexpensive this is for the quality. If it falls apart in a few weeks I'll update this, but based on initial impressions, it's going to last me quite awhile.

reviews.title: Size up and wash for a slim fit
reviews.text: I’m 6’2”, 190lbs. I try to get tall, slim fit shirts in Large. I tried the L but sent it back knowing it would shrink too much. Ordered an XL, washed it in hot water, dried in hot heat and it fits great. Not a true slim fit but I’m layering it in a cold shop and it looks and feels great. It’s as good as any shirt twice the price. I bought 3 already!

reviews.title: Good quality!
reviews.text: I ordered several colors of these shirts for my husband. They are very good quality and fit true to size. We did have an issue with two of the shirts being about an inch shorter in length than the others. Not an uncommon problem. My husband is fairly tall so the difference made them not work for him. I returned the two that didn’t work with no issue. The colors are all exactly as pictured. Overall we are both very happy with these shirts and will buy more in the future.

reviews.title: This is not a fully lined shirt jacket
reviews.text: The only thing that is corduroy lined is the neckline, manufactures tag, and the inside of the cuffs. It is nice material, The color is nearly olive drab which I was striving for, and a tad bit lighter than flannel. I also ordered one size larger and I’m glad I did

reviews.title: Wonderfully soft material, but runs a bit small.
reviews.text:
I appreciated the softness of the fabric. It came feeling like it had been washed a few times. It wasn't too terribly heavy - some flannels either feel like a broadcloth or like wearing a jacket, I've yet to find anything in between save for this shirt.

The shirt has a somewhat slim cut to it. Even at a size larger it was fitting just right. However, in the description it said that though the product was pre-shrunk, there's a chance it would shrink a bit more. If it had, It wouldn't be comfortable to wear. So, I'm returning and ordering a size larger. I really like the blue-green color in the "OCS" shirt.

reviews.title: Love the shirt!
reviews.text: I ordered two shirts, one for my boyfriend and one for myself as a part of a matching Halloween costume. As a petite female (5'2, 110lbs) I ordered XS and the top fits me exactly as I wanted it to, it's baggy but not too huge. For my boyfriend, who is 6' and 180 lbs, I ordered a Large, and while he hasn't tried it on yet, I think the fit will be perfect for him as well. I love the quality of the fabric, and especially the corduroy cuffs and collar. also, very amazing customer service which is difficult to find these days. Thank you :)

reviews.title: Super comfy, well-made
reviews.text:
Flannel shirts can be hard to buy online. Some are too thick, too stiff, they fit oddly, and so forth. I feel like I really lucked out with this one. The flannel is extremely soft after you wash it once. It's just the right thickness - thick enough to be cozy, but thin enough not to be bulky or stiff. It's not too hot to wear indoors. The collar and cuffs don't have thick interfacing that would make them stiff either. I'm pleased with this shirt, so much so that I ordered another one a day after receiving mine.

One note: when you get it, you might think it's a bit big. After one wash, it will shrink slightly and be true to size. I'm 6'1", 175# and I bought a large, which is perfect. I wasn't looking for an ultra-stylish, body-hugging shirt; I wanted something with a "comfort" fit. And comfort I got.

reviews.title: Solid Winter Office Shirt
reviews.text:
When dressing for winter in the Midwest I prefer to have heavier button-up shirts, and this was part of a few I purchased last year.

I'm not sure why the options for rating this shirt were "Comfort, Stretch, and Light Weight"
So... instead I'll just go with what I think of the brand/style:

I like the fit and cut of the shirt, it is also long enough that I can tuck it in well without it coming out when you reach for something.

It doesn't really "stretch" but I don't expect it to. I actually am very happy with the fit and that it didn't change much after washing. I also like the heavier more durable feel of the shirt as opposed to regular "dress shirts"

I would not recommend wearing it in the summer as it does a good job of retaining heat, which is exactly why I wanted it to begin with. For cold weather/winter wear, even in the office I find it very comfortable and stylish. After buying the first 2 I ended up buying 2 more because I liked this brand so much. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: It even looks pretty good on little old fat guys.
reviews.text:
[[VIDEOID:c920a687fcefbd2abac85334a3483167]] I'm happy with my purchase. When I bought mine (from amazon.com), it was about $12 cheaper for some reason. Even at the current price, though (about $35), it's a good buy.

Anyway, please see my video review.

Oh, just for reference, I'm about 5'5" = 165cm tall (or short, depending on how you view things).

reviews.title: Say It's Name. London Fog.
reviews.text:
[[VIDEOID:c44aa556defe8a8813aa13b9a72801c6]] I bought this specifically for impersonating the Walter White character. I am a medium to slim build guy, very average body type. This fits perfectly. The color is Camel. Washed and machine dried, no issues. Money well spent for the purpose I wanted it for.
I'm 6'0", 180 lbs. I take a 40 Long Sports coat or suit jacket. So you can see how this jacket fits me by comparison.
UPDATE: Bought my third one, in black this time. Heisenberg - "Breaking Bass"

reviews.title: Great Fit For My Body Size
reviews.text: Plenty of good things have already been said about this jacket which I agree with, so I won't bore you by repeating them here. My only concern isn't about the product so much, but about how descriptive reviews concerning the fit often fail to describe the person that's wearing the jacket. To say it's a "great fit", "too long", "too tight," etc., is worthless unless the reader knows more about the wearer's body. So here goes . . . I bought a Large size jacket. I'm 5'10", at 202 lbs, and have slightly long arms. (A 34" sleeve shirt sleeve ends the cuffs near perfectly, about 3/4 inch below my wrist.) I mention this because this Large size jacket also fits my arm length perfectly, which might make the sleeves a smidgen long for men with more average length arms. (Probably not a big deal tho, as the cuff's snaps should stop the sleeves from sliding into your hand.) Believe my shoulder and chest width is about average for my height, and the jacket fits well there too, with some jacket slack. Am happy with the general length of this Large size, but (alas!) I've got a fairly significant gut which makes zipping the jacket a tight fit in that area, so, I'll likely just wear it unzipped,…

reviews.title: Great price for the quality
reviews.text:
I was looking for a lightweight jacket for spring, fall and warmer winter days. I have lived in Boise, Id for 10 years and have not seen below zero yet.
The jacket is very well made, no loose stitches or threads hanging out. The style is quite nice, more than just a casual jacket. Very nice attention to detail and finish. It has partial elastic waist bands, shoulder expansion pleats, 7 pockets!!! (3 inside with Velcro closure, (4) outside, 2 with zippers and 2 open for quick access.
After seeing this jacket in person and wearing it, I ordered one in Brown. I have spent money on things that were well below my expectations but, this jacket has far exceeded my expectations. I have included a pic of the inside of the jacket.

reviews.title: pocket loader
reviews.text: This jacket is loaded with hidden pockets. It looks good worn casually or to step your dress up a notch with dress slacks and a leather shoe. It has all the good looks and workmanship you'd expect from London Fog; it's light weight enough for warm climates like Arizona and warm enough for those breezy mornings.

reviews.title: Great for Breaking Bad cosplay but horrible for regular use
reviews.text:
I bought this specifically to cosplay as Walter White/Heisenberg. The jacket is exactly what he wore many times, including the "Say My Name" opening scene. So, to that end, this jacket is absolutely perfect.

Some nice features:
- The jacket has dual side pockets; one on each side is open and the other nested with it can be closed with zippers.
- There are internal pockets, too, in case you feel the need to carry more small items.
- It's a great lightweight windbreaker but holds in plenty of heat (I get extremely warm in convention centers).

Issues:
- The liner in one of the pockets was split open and seems to be of fairly weak/poor quality construction. I discovered this when a few small items I put in that pocket wormed their way into the body/liner of the jacket. So that will need to be sewn shut (and with much better material than what was used during manufacture).

- The very small flaps along the zipper enclosures that is designed to conceal them for aesthetic purposes have a constant tendency to get caught in the zipper itself. This is exceptionally aggravating and has worried me more than a few times that I might have to tear the flaps in order to free the zipper…

reviews.title: Perfect But Pay Attention to the Sizing Comments
reviews.text:
First a BIG THANK YOU to all who wrote about the long sleeve length and fuller body fit. I am 6'3", 230lbs with a 34" waist and routinely wear an XL. Based on other's comments regarding the sleeves running long, I bought this in Large. It fits perfectly!! Plenty of great pockets, functional and well placed. The extra shoulder flexibility makes arm movement easier. The black I ordered sure looks as black as my other black coats.
This is exactly the light weight jacket I was looking for. I thought the price was great and could not be happier with the purchase.

reviews.title: Good As A Packable Jacket
reviews.text:
I needed a lightweight jacket that would pack well, had some rain resistance and would match up with a white shirt and black slacks (work attire). Although not perfect, this London Fog fills the need pretty well. It has sold well and has, at last glance, over 1700 reviews so lots of details are out there. Here are my pros and cons:
Pros:
True to size fit. I am 5'11' and 190lbs. The fit is very comfortable and even has some room for light layering.
Packs well and resists wrinkling.
Lots of pockets, including three inside that secure with hook and loop fasteners. Big enough to actually be useful.
Bi-swing back provides a wide and comfortable range of movement.
Quality workmanship throughout.

Cons:
Not a "true" black, I'd call it a dark, matte charcoal. Close enough but could be better.
Elastic around the waistband tends to cause the waist ride up with movement and stay there, giving a very "blousy" look.

For the price, fit and workmanship the jacket is five stars. The two "cons" knock it down one star.

reviews.title: PERFECT
reviews.text: EXCUSE ME WHILE I BUY THIS IN EVERY COLOR. The fabric is fantastic quality, silky but thick enough to hide undergarments. I absolutely love the way it drapes down in the front. It’s so flattering and comfortable. I get tons of compliments on this. Can be dressed up or down. Absolutely the best purchase I’ve made in quite some time. I am 5’3”, 145lbs and got a M.

reviews.title: Sizing is accurate for me
reviews.text: This skirt was just as expected. It was not right it was perfect I am 260 pounds and I’m 5’7 I got a 2x which is what I normally wear and it’s just right will be buying more

reviews.title: Excellent skirt
reviews.text: 5'3" 130 lbs, I really like this skirt. I ordered a small and it fits perfectly. I'll probably order more from this seller, cause I never shop for clothes online but due to the pandemic and being unable to try things on, I figured I'd give it a shot. I could wear this skirt all day and it's so comfortable and flattering, and I get compliments on it.

reviews.title: 5 star buy! Love this skirt.
reviews.text: I’m certainly going to be buying some more of these skirts! Very comfortable, nice fabric and great fit. I was so surprised at not only how fast they came in the mail but how sleek and good looking the skirt is itself. For a better gauge I am 5’9 155 pounds I bought a size Medium which fits like a glove and even hides my pooch :p 5 stars!

reviews.title: Beautiful fit!
reviews.text: This skirt fits beautifully!! I'm a size 12 and started to purchase the XL, based on the reviews, but I'm glad I bought a Large. I have 4 other faux leather skirts from designer stores but this one fits BEST! I have to get it in another color!

reviews.title: Try, try again - overall 4 stars
reviews.text: So I ordered this skirt in brown leather (xl) and black leather (2xl), because I have suddenly developed a liking for faux leather skirts. I opted for two different sizes as a means of trying them out but turns out they both fit fine though differently. The black I loved right off the bat and did air it out for a day (inside out, hanging in the laundry room) to let the vinyl glue smell dissipate. That worked fine and I wore it two days after I received it. The brown one though…. Well. How do I put this nicely? It smelled like someone spilled a bottle of fish sauce on top of three day old tuna salad and left it in the sun for another few days. I tried airing that one out - after a week my laundry room smelled like fish sauce/tuna combo. Extra strength febreeze (sprayed lightly on the inside of the faux leather fabric, since it was inside out) did nothing. I was NOT going to wear that on public transit then on my walk into the office, unless I wanted to be like paddington bear in the underground with a suitcase full of bacon. Though I suppose I would have appealed more to cats, not dogs. So I returned it for the stinky to go away from my zip code since it’s clearly defective but…

reviews.title: Love this skirt! Great purchase!
reviews.text: Absolutely love this skirt. Great material and very flattering fit. I purchased a small but should have gotten a medium just due to the waist not being stretchy. Great length right at your knees. Have received many compliments though! Will be purchasing in multiple colors. I'm 5'5 135lbs. Typically wear a size 6 in dresses and a 5 in pants. Brand is awesome, have purchased many things from them and have never been disappointed.

reviews.title: Classy and Sassy.
reviews.text: I was a little apprehensive about this skirt at first because I am not use to wearing such close fitting clothes, but my husband and teenagers gave it a thumbs-up, so I wore it to work. I got compliments from fellow co-workers and clients. The skirt is a little sexy but still classy. Has just the right stretch and is comfortable to wear all day.

reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.text: I was so excited to think we finally found a toy our dogs could enjoy for longer then 10 minutes.... well within 15 minutes, the stuffing was out of both pigs... SERIOUSLY?? They LOVED THEM for 15 minutes. I challenge this company to make a product our boxers can enjoy. So tired of wasted money on products which sound great but don't stand up to the true use of "real" dogs. How excited I was to see a picture of a Rottweiler holding the pig in its mouth. My thoughts were unrealistic. Do not spend your money

reviews.title: Great pull over, No problems with quality, And nice and warm!
reviews.text:
I'm not sure why some of the reviews here say this isn't warm. The weather where I live has been in the single digits for two weeks and I've been fine in this running inside and out. I was worried with the large cutout in the front that it wouldn't be as warm as some of my other hoodies but it is. I also don't understand the quality issues. I've worn this one for two week stretches and have washed it half a dozen times in the last 3 months I've had it and no wear spots yet. The size fits true and if anything it might run half a size larger than listed.

I will say that the sewing and backing of the buck on the front is a little rough but I didn't have anything come undone yet. I will warn you that the first time you wash this the backing is going to fall off (It's supposed to) and stick to the rest of the items in the washer . Just wash this on it's own the first time and hang dry it. Other than that, I'm ordering another one in a different color.

reviews.title: Not what was expected
reviews.text: (ORANGE COLOR) It was the right size as I expected as I was going to use it over my gear to go hunting. I got the XXL TALL I’m 6,4 264 pounds .The reason for the low stars is the color is not as vibrant as the picture shows it came very faded witch I think takes away from the safety use I need as the mountains here are light tan dirt and wearing a extremely faded orange might make me blend in more to the ground. Also the design on the front is barely stitched on and looks very fragile and will most likely fall off in one to two hunts. If I decide to wear doing a hunt I’ll update but most like going to return for safety issues.

reviews.title: So comfy!!!!
reviews.text: We ordered a women's and 2 mens sweatshirt! Perfect fit so so comfy. So much detail the pictures dont do it justice! We all love them, and will definitely continue shopping the brand.

reviews.title: Cheaply made.
reviews.text: This is so insanely cheaply made. I would keep it if I hadn’t paid so much for it. I expected a higher quality because of the price. Should’ve listened to the reviews. This thing won’t last one run through the washing machine. I can lift the front design right off the sweatshirt with a slight pull. Bought it for my husband for Christmas but it’s going right back.

reviews.title: SO MUCH LINT AFTER FIRST WASH
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed. For what I paid I expected better quality.

The item arrived quickly- next day- and looked great in the package. I wanted to wash it before my son wore it and that's where the trouble began. As I removed it from the machine I noticed little wads of...something... that was not in my washer before this hoodie. As it dried, I spent 20 minutes removing all the little wads, that upon closer inspection appeared to be paper,from my washer.

When the hoodie was finished drying it had tons of that dried paper on it. I used an entire roll of lint remover (those sticky sheets) and I still didnt get all off. I have never seen so much lint on a new piece of clothing.

Also, I thought the deer design was stitched or embroidered on it but it seems to be a black patch sewn on the inside that they cut out design through the fabric and then stitched the edges of the fabric. Now all around the edge design are jagged little pieces of fabric that will eventually continue to rip and end up causing the hoodie to look ragged.

If you choose to purchase this, please save yourself time by turning it inside out and seeing if you can remove the paper stuff before washing. Get a…

reviews.title: super comfy and looks sharp
reviews.text: I am retired. no more dressy casual clothes nor suits of any kind. This is my winter dressy sweatshirt. I dont eat in it. I dont fix things in it. it is a people sweatshirt. I always get compliments on how it looks. i come home and change immediately. no potty stop, no fridge stop, definately no garage...beeline to closet. change. hang in closet. I even hang it with one of my old wooden suit hangers to keep its shape....why all this...so I dont have to wear all that other stuff I wore before...well worth it!

reviews.title: Very Comfortable, good material, and size was perfect!
reviews.text: I read a lot of reviews before purchasing this, and am very pleased to try it on and have it slightly big so that layering is an option. The material is extremely comfortable, and I bought the "Hunters Orange", and love it. I didn't notice in the picture, but the "V" cut in the front at my neck is perfect to keep it from getting to tight on my neck. I ordered my typical size, and as I mentioned, it fits nice as it is (slightly big), and will still fit perfect with a shirt or two under it. I am pleased with this purchase, and will test its durability this fall.

reviews.title: great for girls too
reviews.text: i'm a girl, and i love this jacket. i was looking for something big and spacious and i want to sew patches on it. i ordered the xl like i do nearly everything else but it was ginormous. i love that there are free returns! i reordered the medium and it fits SO well. big still but not too baggy and i can roll the sleeves up or wear them down, both look good. im very happy with this jacket!

reviews.title: Great Denim Jacket...Here's What You Are Buying
reviews.text:
This Wrangler jacket exceeded our expectations. The first thing you notice is the weight. It really is made with heavy duty 100% cotton denim. The stitching is well done. It's a handsome demim jacket. Although it's made in Bangladesh, it's good quality and expected to last a reasonable time.

After trying an item on to make sure it fits properly and there are no defects, I always wash clothes before wearing them. Instructions are wash in cold water/dry on low setting/iron if needed. Be sure to wash this alone the first time unless you have a pair of faded blue jeans you want to add a little more color to. Just like their blue denim jeans, the blue dye does run during the first two washings so the wash water will be VERY blue the first time around. I took the jacket out of the dryer immediately so there were no wrinkles and no need to iron. Looked great. The sleeve length did shrink about half an inch which we were expecting. I suspect there might be another half inch shrinkage over time.

There are two front breast pockets which are wide enough to get your hand in. Compared to a Levi denim jacket hubby has, these two pockets are just a little larger. He says these pockets are nicer…

reviews.title: No BS light jacket
reviews.text: I've owned and worn the same Levi denim jacket for over 30 years (no, not all the time: that would be weird). It still looks great but occasionally shrinks up (usually after Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years...) and I wanted a larger version to wear during these odd times of unexplained shrinkening (oh shut up spell check: if I make up a word, I get to decide how it's spelled) . My wife is, even as I type, offering rather malicious theories on the unexplained shrinkening and I'm suggesting that she obviously does not know the meaning of unexplained. I apparently have no brand loyalty as I didn't even notice I'd ordered a different jacket until I held the 2 up side by side to compare. Meh: close enough. No pads, zippers, epaulets, or any other unnecessary adornments. Just a classic, clean, light jacket.

reviews.title: Very sturdy, wouldn't rip easily
reviews.text: Very sturdy, wouldn't rip easily. It's warm enough for winter but wouldn't be too hot for a breezy summer day. I put patches on it and it turned out exactly how I wanted. It has six pockets. Two pockets on the chest, two pockets down by your hands, and two pockets on the inside of the coat. The pockets are all good size. I've put bottles of water in the inside pockets before and it worked great (perfect jacket to sneak snacks into a movie theater with;D)

reviews.title: Tough jean jacket with a roomy fit for a man who works with his hands
reviews.text:
I have worn jean jackets over the years for actual work, not fashion. Thus, I look for my jean jackets to have room in the upper back, shoulder, armpit, and chest regions so that I can freely move, unrestrained. I also look for the denim to be thick and tough so that it won't easily tear if it snags on something.

I can no longer wear Levi's jean jackets because even the XXL size fits like a medium and has zero room in those regions that I listed above. I bought this Wrangler jean jacket and it is PERFECT. It has room everywhere, but isn't bulky, it's tough, the color is wonderful, it's warm, and it fits how a man's denim jacket should fit: stylish, but roomy and tough for real work. I usually wear XXL for my tops because I'm a muscular man with a broad back/chest and regular sizes don't fit and the typical companies like Levi make even their XL+ sizes super tiny. This XXL Wrangler, however, fits exactly how a XXL should and I love it.

I 100% recommend this Wrangler jean jacket!

reviews.title: Amazing jacket. Ladies size down!
reviews.text:
I am a girl and I bought this denim jacket because women's styles tend to be too tight, too thin, and too short. I wanted a roomier, more durable piece. I'm 5'4" and 135 lbs and I bought the Medium size because there was only one (ugly) color option for the Small size, and I figured that the Medium would shrink considerably from washing and drying in hot water. It did shrink a bit after two rounds, but this jacket is still feels ENORMOUS on me. There is more than enough room to wear thick sweaters under it. I definitely would have be better off with a Small. The more I wear it, though, the more I dig the roomy style—I'm sure this will become one of my staple jackets in the fall.

The material is super heavy--I can tell this jacket is going to last me many years, and I am excited to see how many different styles I can squeeze out of it. A huge positive is that I can fit my keys, wallet, and phone in just one of the pockets—something that would be impossible with a women's denim jacket. I gave this jacket 5 stars because the size issue was my own fault, and beyond that the make, color, and general style of the jacket are awesome.

reviews.title: 6' 1" tall and 310lbs = 3XL
reviews.text: I just received this jacket today and am very, very impressed. I was stuck between whether to get 2XL or 3XL and the latter is perfect. I carry most of my weight in my gut and this fits completely fine when buttoned. Generally, arm lengths are too short on me but these are perfect. I included a picture of the inside pocket since someone had asked in a previous comment. You can compare the height and width of the pocket to the buttons and get an idea of how big it is. Material appears rugged and ready for wear. From previous feedback, I have cold washed it to get the initial dye out and will update this comment if anything significant changes after the wash. I can't believe that I was able to find a denim jacket this good for this price!!

reviews.title: Heavy Demin
reviews.text: Hey I have looking for this jacket all over the place, in many different stores only to be let down! "MY SIZE NOT IN STOCK" And on the third hit at Amazon bam! Not only did I fine my size but the material of my wrangler jean jacket is a heavier than Levi! Thanks a million! Bear

reviews.title: Warm Winters ahead
reviews.text: Just received the jacket/hoodie. It is what I expected. Warm fleece inside. The sleeves are not fleece lined. I think they could have invested a bit more on the zipper. It is a metal zipper, just seems like it will be the first to go. I'm 5 foot 6 inch 125 pound male and ordered a large. It fits perfectly. The pictures of the jacket with the sleeves inside out to show the lining still as comfortable as can be.

reviews.title: Looks good for the first couple of days and then I was quickly disappointed
reviews.text: I originally purchased one sweatshirt in black to wear for work, once I received it I loved the way it looked and how warm and soft the fleece material felt. I immediately purchased a second one in dark blue to use around the house. Unfortunately two weeks after receiving the black sweatshirt I noticed fabric pills on the sweatshirt mainly on the arms after a few days they were also on the pockets as well as the back of the sweatshirt. I was extremely disappointed and was hoping that it was just a fluke, but a few days later I noticed the same thing happening to my blue sweatshirt. I did give the sweatshirts to stars because even though both sweatshirts had fabric pills they are very well constructed and as I said earlier the fleece is soft and warm. Next time I will not be so quick to purchase a second product until I have tested the first product out for longer than a day or two. I attached a few pictures to better explain the problem with the fabric. The pictures are of both the blue and the black sweatshirt

reviews.title: Quality garment
reviews.text: I have purchased two of these hoodies now, very much the best I ever owned. I own similar jackets that cost less (from Germany) but I can honestly say that the workmanship and the quality of the lining is superior and there is no smell or pilling or whatsoever. I just wished I had known about these jackets earlier.

reviews.title: Save your money!
reviews.text: I wish I would have read the reviews first. Very disappointed...the sleeves have pilled terribly and I've only had it a month...with very little wear.

reviews.title: Go elsewhere! Terrible quality for the price!!
reviews.text: I bought these for my Companies Service guys. I had them embroidered with the Company logo. The first day my guys wore them the fabric on the back and sleeves started to ball up, little knobs of fabric. It looked terrible. So disappointed in this product and i cant return them because there personalized. And i paid $40 for each one!!!! I bought 13 of them, every single one of them has done this. LOOK ELSEWHERE! Total waste of money

reviews.title: Very Warm and Comfortable
reviews.text:
Great for cold weather. Very warm (sometimes a little too warm!) and the inner lining is nice and soft.

I bought one of these and liked it so much that I bought another for myself (in a different color), and one for my wife (so she would stop stealing mine!)...

Only downside I would say is that it isn't very flattering...it is plain looking, and puffy (i.e. makes you look plump). It's much more functional than stylish...but it's a hoodie, so that's to be expected.

reviews.title: Arms are not lined. Fabric doesn't hold up well.
reviews.text: The hood and body of the hoodie is Sherpa lined but not the sleeves. Not a nice feeling when it's cold and you go to put it on and your arms are greeted by cold polyester lining. I have worn this many times since the original purchase November 2019 and already the inner arms are pilling (see picture). I gave this 3 stars because while it is absolutely warm. I can't wear this hoodie for anything other than errands or being at home. The fabric pilling makes it unattractive to wear otherwise.

reviews.title: Warm jacket
reviews.text:
First impressions:

I wasn't sure what to expect despite reading other reviews, however the reviews were pretty spot on about jacket.

Color: True to the color that I ordered. I ordered a black jacket and got a true black jacket, not charcoal or dark grey or even washed out black, but a new black jacket.

Zipper: Yes, the zipper is tricky and would probably be best if you're able to replace the zipper to ensure longevity. Also, candle wax, crayons or WD40 if your zipper ever gets stuck. Just Google for tips if need be, but the zipper does work, just might be a bit tricky for some.

Fleece: The jacket is fully fleece inside BESIDES the arms. The arms are nylon padded stitched to ensure an easier experience of putting the jacket on and off.

Pockets: These are large deep pockets. Eventually I want to add buttons or zippers to add a closing pickets to my jacket.

Overall: The jacket is a good length and fits well. I had to get a 5XL which fits like a regular 3xl. So if you normally wear a 3xl, definitely size up. This is not true to American standard sizes. These sizes are Chinese sizing which means size up! Obviously I don't fit into a 5xl in American sizes, but Chinese sizes are…

reviews.title: Happy
reviews.text: Very happy!!! I was worried about getting this shirt in the white floral because most white T-shirts are see-through. This is a very nice material and I am able to wear it without a tank top under my shirt! Huge bonus!!!

reviews.title: Great shirt
reviews.text: Super cute and seems well made. I’m 5’7” / 190 lbs and I bought the XL

reviews.title: Order a size down, and you’re good to go!
reviews.text: I read the reviews prior to purchase. I usually wear a large, but I ordered a small. I am 5’3, 138 pounds, 34b if that helps anyone. I definitely will be purchasing in more colors!

reviews.title: Love the fit, the sleeves, and the colors.
reviews.text: I LOVE these shirts! I bought 3 in different colors. I am 138lbs, 34D, 5’8, and typically wear a small/medium in Womens’s. I first ordered a Medium which for great. Although on my fat days I wished it was a tad longer around the waist. So, I recorded a Large and washed/dried on hot high to shrink and I love the way these fit! A little loosely around the waist and arms but still fitted to be flattering, which is perfectly comfy for our hot summer days. Today I paired them with Capri pants, heels, jewelers, and a blazer for work. But, i love them with just a pair of jeans and flats for the weekends. The other thing I LOVE is the sleeves! They’re not short like most t-shirts. They’re long enough to cover my bus drivers (arm fat) but not too long to make them hot! These shirts are soft, classy, and flow perfectly.

reviews.title: Looks great on.
reviews.text: Great shirt. I wear size 18 and ordered 2x. It fits correctly. If I ordered 1x it would be too tight. It looks great on and the colors are just right- not too bright, more subtle. Very good top. Will buy again.

reviews.title: A little baggy but I like the way it fits. Soft fabric too!
reviews.text: The fabric wasn’t thin, pretty decent yet airy fabric. Super soft. Doesn’t seem cheaply made. I’ll buy more in different colors. I’m 160lbs and 5’7” and at wearing a Large. I like the baggier fit after having four kiddos. I’d go for a size Medium but I feel like this type of fabric will show the imperfections slightly more than others if I went smaller.

reviews.title: Super top
reviews.text: When I ordered this top, I did not think it would look nice and be well made let alone fit. Well, was I surprised. Quality is super, fit is great. I wear a 12 or M to L top, I ordered the Large and it fits like a glove with plenty of room. Hangs below the waist and hip area. LOVE it and ordered three more different patterns, however, the other three, sent two back as not made as well. Overall would recommend this top.

reviews.title: Very comfortable to wear and love the sleeve length!
reviews.text: I love the shirt, however, I am giving it a 4 star for this reason.....the lace on the sleeve was not sewn down completely. I had bought this shirt in the navy floral, and liked it so much. I knew I liked the shirt, so just gave it a quick rinse before trying on. Then I noticed the lace was not stitched along the outer edges like my first shirt. It just stuck out and looked so unfinished. I don't have a sewing machine, so had to tack down the edges by hand. Other than that, I still love the shirt. I have machine washed both on low speed, cold water and hung to dry. I would even order another if they had a color I liked. My unsewn lace was probably the only shirt that passed, but I thought it worth noting for others to look out for.

reviews.title: It isn’t even the same dress as in the picture.
reviews.text: It isn’t the same fabric. Not the same color. It’s suppose to be short. It’s long. It isn’t firm fitting. It fits like a maternity dress. What a waste of time and money this was.

reviews.title: buy it!
reviews.text: I know this is the same dress that is listed on several other sites. Much cheaper here. This dress is great. Quality is very nice. Soft and even flattering on my straight frame. Im 5’8 130lbs ordered a small. If xs was available I might have tried that size.

reviews.title: Must get!
reviews.text:
Likes- MATERIAL; it is double lined with not that cheap thin fabric, stretchy, soft, quality, form fitting, color, length not to short not long, and comfortable.

Cons- so far none.

I am 5'4", normally 130lbs, 32C, waist 28 or size 4, petite/athletic build.

Right now I am 21 weeks pregnant at 145lbs and this dress is flattering!! It will fit me post baby for sure and purchased because of the extra lining, fabric, and the way it is formed to grow. I do not think i will need a Medium in my 3rd trimester thats how stretchy it is but not loose stretchy. It has great elasticity. Even so, I need dresses and if I do need to bump up a size because of my bump so be it. This is a keeper for after the baby either way. Great 2fer as a maternity dress.

Buying more in other colors, so far I have the sleeveless heathered pink/peach color, tomorrow the heathered blue with sleeves arrives tomorrow.

Def. Getting more colors and styles.

reviews.title: horrible
reviews.text:
I got green sleeveless dress - it is nothing like on the picture - different fabric (not heather green like on the picture), it is double layered (and it not supposed to be) and side rushing is not as cute as on the picture.
I have the same kind of dress from a different seller, short sleeve one with irregular hem, also in green color, and that dress looks exactly like on the pictures on that seller's page and here, too. However that other seller did not have this dress in sleeveless version, so I came here to buy one... but yeah what I got is nothing like it supposed to be! Returning!
On my pictures - short sleeve dress to the right is the real thing. Sleeveless dress to the left is what I got and I am returning it.

reviews.title: Absolutely PERFECT!
reviews.text:
This dress is more than perfect! It’s so true to size, double lined so it isn’t see through yet still so light and summery. The touching is extremely flattering as well.

I am 5’7”, 190 pounds, medium to large tops, and a size 12 in jeans (Maurice’s and Walmart Are my usual stores for size references,)

I ordered and am wearing a size large and it fits beautifully. Better than expected! The arm holes and neckline are flush to my skin and weren’t too big like some reviews.

I absolutely would recommend this dress! Can dress it up or down depending on occassion. I bought this for girls night and received so many compliments.

Shipping was extremely fast and on time. Definitely worth the buy!

reviews.title: Love the simplicity and style!
reviews.text: I ordered a medium and am 165lbs, 5'7" and a very hourglass shape and this dress looks FANTASTIC! I love that it can be dressed up with accessories or looks good on it's own for a casual night out, day at the beach, etc. I ordered the sleeveless navy and short sleeve steel blue and they are both great. I also tried the light pink but that color did not have the sheath inside and the material was a lot thinner.

reviews.title: Nice dress for the price
reviews.text: Nice dress. The ruching at the waist is flattering, the material is stretchy and soft. I got three colors to see which one I wanted. I decided to go with the light blue but the black was a close second! BEWARE OF THE NAVY! It looks purple. I took a picture of the dress inside out so you could really see. The inside of the dress is more of a true navy. The light blue dress is a cooler, light blue in person versus what you see in the display picture. True to size. I got a small, I am 5’7” 140lb 34B. I wore a black sports bra during the pictures.

reviews.title: Best amazon purchase yet
reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews so here goes......I struggle with dresses because I’m large chested and a small waist. 38DDD and 26inch waist. Good problem to have but finding fitted dresses that aren’t trashy has become a real issue. They are either trashy or flowy. And flowy looks like I’m in a maternity dress, which would be fine if I was pregnant.

This dress solves those problems for me. It is fitted without being trashy. I will pair it with a cardigan. The pic was taken as soon as it came in for a review because I loved it so much. I ordered a medium, I normally wear size 6 in pants. I 5’3”, 152 lbs, athletic build. I love the medium fit for a date night and ordered another medium in a different color. May order a large for a little looser fit for kids events/weddings.

reviews.title: If You Are Looking For A Blue In The Picture Be Prepared To Be Disappointed.
reviews.text: If You Are Looking For A Blue In The Picture Be Prepared To Be Disappointed. Amazon falsely advertises the colorway of these jackets and unfortunately is seen in other buyers photos. I received a denim colorway jacket that doesn't match the blue jacket in the picture. Not even the material matches what is shown in the picture. Although I spoke to a representative from Amazon and he/she did what they were supposed to do and delivered me a jacket the next business day the product color was still incorrect. The bottom line Amazon should portray colors that match their image. BUYERS BEWARE YOU MAY NOT GET COLORS YOU WILL PAY FOR.

reviews.title: Solid jacket purchase for cold weather
reviews.text:
A good jacket for cold weather. Though I wouldn't recommend it for heavy rain (the wrist cuffs are cloth), it's definitely something for wind, cold, and snow.

INSULATION: Extremely effective. You get a lot of heat retention for little bulk. Also if you get overheated, simply unzipping it will probably vent enough heat for comfort.

BULK: Very light. You get very good insulation for a lighter jacket.

HOOD: The hood is great. Adjustable, convenient, also light, and just stiff enough to lend it a useful shape.

SIZING: Size is good, but I recommend if you're on the edge of a larger size, get the larger size.

POCKETS: Two external, one internal. Wish it had a few more pockets, but that's me.

Overall, a good purchase at a good price. I use it to navigate colder weather (40's-50s) in a normally warm climate, and it not only works, but its lightness means I can easily unzip it to vent heat if it suddenly warms up.

reviews.title: Good basic shirt after the neccessary first wash
reviews.text:
I have an unfortunate case of the dreaded "dress code" at work so of course I pick the least dressy option possible: polos. After wearing them every day it's nice to see that Amazon has come out with their own version. That usually means a good value and no frills which is exactly what I want in a shirt. My usual complaints with polos wasn't an issue here as it was both long enough to tuck in without pulling out all day and has sleeves that went more than two inches down my arm.

I'm around an average (IT nerd) build and this shirt isn't too form fitting but it doesn't billow around me either; just sits comfortable whether walking or sitting. The arms are a reasonable length that doesn't ride up my arms unlike many other brands. You'd think a shirt is a shirt but there are some polos in my closet because they just have odd dimensions for their stated size. Good comfort too; material was fairly soft but I certainly wouldn't call it silky. Just the way I like it. There's also the color to consider and while I'm not a pastel/robin's egg blue kinda guy it's just dark enough that it doesn't bother me.

Honestly the only thing I didn't like about it was that it had an odd smell…

reviews.title: Excellent value, consistent fit, cool, comfortable and durable.
reviews.text:
I have purchased 20 plus of these shirts in the past six months. The first batch in spring, figuring if any inconsistencies or quality issues arose upon delivery, no problem. Amazon's return policy has always been hassle free. After trying on the fourth shirt and noticing no outstanding flaws or differences, all were simply opened, laundered and hung on a hanger. The material is 100 percent cotton, but assuming they are removed from the dryer immediately (medium heat) - no ironing necessary. No appreciable shrinking is observed and no outliers in the batch.

My sport shirt size is men's US large regular fit. Other relevant sizes - 17.5 inch neck, 46 inch shoulders, 34 inch sleeves and 36 inch waist. Overall fit of these shirts is of appropriate roominess without bagginess. Shirt tail length is spot on, work dress code requires tucked in, and they stay tucked in. Casual requires not tucked in, and unless I am reaching for the sky with both hands while on tip toes, the shirt tail/ belt line is not breached. The sleeve length could have been extended by an inch since they taper to an elastic cuff, requiring that the sleeves are pulled back to original position following an extended…

My husband wears an XL in all shirts and so many people said the shirts were sized way too big and they had to return them for a smaller size, so I bought a large. reviews.title: An Extinct Breed - Get before they are gone
reviews.text:
In my day polos used to be soft thick 100 % cotton with generous sleeves covering the upper arm till above the elbows and collars standing high and grand and covering the back of the neck till below the hairline. They had substantial structure/body (shape that held) and ultra comfortable soft cotton. This was my go to piece of clothing to step out in (as opposed to round neck collarless T-Shirts that I wore only at home or for sporting activities).

However, this simple good thing was not to be taken for granted. As time went by, I watched in horror this simple evergreen staple slowly vanish - being replaced by plastic, toxic, carcinogenic trash (synthetic, polyester, 'performance', 'hi-tech') being passed as clothing riding solely on deceptive/misleading/convincing marketing and rapidly transient 'fast fashion trends'. These pieces of junk being passed as 'performance polos'/'hi-tech' had no 'body', clung to your skin like plastic, caused my sensitive skin to itch, with arms so short as if there was shortage of clothing material in the world and were of such thin cheap uncomfortable material that I would wonder how in the world do people put these on their bodies.

The 'trend'…

I put a pair of sunglasses in one of them and just happened notice they fell out onto the floor a minute or so later which is how I found this out.

I ended up taking it to a local seamstress and having her put a series of stitches on each side to close them up and now all is good with no one knowing the difference save for me. Cost me an extra $10, but well worth it to have the security of knowing when I put something in one of those deep pockets it is going to stay there until I take it out ;-)

So so warm and by the afternoon it warmed up. I now roll up jacket and paxkage it small provided Carry bag and rhen on my back pack. I think I will purchase a second color.

reviews.title: Better quality than expected, no need to size up.
reviews.text: I am 5’7” 170lbs and ordered a large based on other reviews. It looks nice a bit loose, but I wish I’d ordered a medium. I have more of an hourglass shape and plenty (maybe a bit too much) room around the waist. It looks great tucked into a black skirt or jeans, but I wonder if I would like a medium even better. The sleeves are beautiful and I get compliments each time I wear it. So if you have a smaller waist bigger bust, no need to size up.

reviews.title: Great quality, especially for the price!!
reviews.text:
This shirt is perfect for the office but could also be dressed up for a night out with the girls. Great quality, especially for the price!!

I usually wear a XL comfortably in tshirts, I chose to size up to XXL in this blouse and love the fit!

reviews.title: Love this shirt!
reviews.text: So professional and cute! The stomach is a little tighter than I thought but I love it

reviews.title: Expensive looking and fashionable order 1-2 sizes up
reviews.text: wear 16/18 pants L/XL shirt ordered the 2X. Arms are bell bottom like, I have curvy torso/large chest and it fits snugly but good looking. If you want it loose, go two sizes up. very fashionable and expensive looking. Neck line is high and shows no cleave, perfect for office.

reviews.title: Great for work
reviews.text: The shirt is a little tight around my hips but that makes it perfect to tuck into work clothes. I love the baggy sleeves. So comfortable and unique

reviews.title: Nice quality blouse!
reviews.text: This blouse fits just as expected...I usually wear a size 14 or XL and I ordered an XL. It fit well but I could not have worn a large so I wouldn't suggest sizing down especially if you are busty. The fabric is nice quality and not scratchy at all. The v-neck hits at a nice place...not too low cut which is what I wanted since I will wear it to work. It washes well and steams out easily. I purchased the gold color which wasn't see through at all. I love the sheer accents on the sleeves and I received many compliments on this blouse. I would purchase it again!

reviews.title: Gorgeous blouse
reviews.text: This blouse presented much prettier than the photo. I’ve been searching for something like this and it was perfect. True to size, beautiful mesh in sleeves; when pressed, it was perfect. So many compliments when I wore it!!

reviews.title: Love this blouse.
reviews.text:
Absolutely love it. I just received it and threw it on yesterday, perfect to dress up or if you’re like me and need to look professional in your work space this blouse will fit your needs!
I bought a Large and Color Black. This fits well and so far it looks gorgeous with my high waisted blue jeans!
I can see why some people have written poor reviews. From some of the color options, it seems as though Red and/or Black are your best options. Also knowing what fits best for your height. I can see how this can end up being too large and sleeves too long for some people.
Nevertheless I’m thankful this works great with my height and size. I’m 5’4” and a Large fit is what I prefer and feel best in!

reviews.title: Inconsistent material and sizing
reviews.text:
Update: the return process has been a nightmare. They want all kinds of pictures proving that I purchased the item and that it is not as described. I provided everything they wanted... just when it seemed like I would get a refund, they said they needed a picture of the package it was shipped in. It was shipped in a plastic bag that I threw away. Return was denied. Don't waste your money on this garbage.

I purchased one of these a few months ago alf I loved it. Material wasn't too thick like some others said and the XL fit great. I recently ordered 2 more. This time I was not so lucky. The 2 new ones are different material and super thin. Also the zipper is on the left side on the new ones. As you can see from the pics, I wasn't so lucky with the sizing this time... both tags say XL. I guess it's a gamble when you purchase one of these hoodies. You might get a gem like I did the first time, or you might get garbage.

reviews.title: THINGS TO KNOW ABOUT PRODUCT!!! (Review by thin guy)
reviews.text:
This is a very nice hoodie but was a little different than I expected so here's a detailed description! :)
The main surprise was that this is a very light thin and soft hoodie. Not the kind that stands up. It slightly drapes. It doesn't hold much of it's own shape but I find it looks stylish and sexy. I'm not sure how this would work if you aren't crazy about your own body shape. Also, it won't do a ton to keep you warm, but will help.
I'm a thin slightly muscular guy just over six feet tall and seek shirts and hoodies that fit and are NOT baggy. This hoodie is the rare one that passes the test. I usually get a small but as recommended by other people's reviews I got a medium. The sleeves are long enough. I can't stand shorter sleeves, and love it when the sleeves can go slightly over my hands when I want... This hoodie does that on me, and I have somewhat long arms. :)
 The fit is pretty slim without being tight. I'll see if it's tighter after I wash it. Not sure how much smaller the small would have been.
I got the white and it's WHITE. like, it might sounds silly but this thing is super bright white. The whitest thing in the room. I don't wear white usually and so this thing…

reviews.title: 3stars which means it's ok
reviews.text:
Description says its Lightweight and yes trust me is very lightweight. Probably thinner than regular t-shirt which is not always good.
Quality of the material is very good, soft and nice to touch which is a plus. Unfortunately material is too thin even for lightweight which is easy to make a hole or rip it. Zipper is made from plastic but looks solid. But there are small details which are important and you can see on my pictures what im talking about. Im talking about rivets, small metal/plastic rings protecting holes in the hood for your pull string.
So overall 3 (3.5 stars) and if I would know all this before buying I would probably not buy this

reviews.title: Comfortable, lightweight
reviews.text:
I probably spent a dozen hours finding and comparing every hoodie <$30 on wish, ebay, amazon, and etsy. This is what I arrived at, and I'm glad I did. I just now put it on for the first time, so I can't speak to its longevity.

It's comfortable and warm, despite being lightweight. I wouldn't expect this hoodie to keep you dry or warm in stormy or cold weather, maybe suitable above 60, depending on personal tolerance. The hood is perfect. You know how some hoods have a pronounced point and it sucks? This isn't that way.
I'm a slender dude (5'9", 140) and the small fits me perfectly. I usually wear small or medium shirts.

Edit: after a couple months of wear, the hoodie is still not bad, but it now feels a bit small, particularly when it's zipped.

reviews.title: Different colors have different fabric blends; different textures; and different fits.
reviews.text:
I was browsing amazon recommendations and came across this sweatshirt which looked and sounded amazing. I ordered the navy (in large) and have worn it every day since I received it. The material feels amazing, kind of like a high quality undershirt before it's washed. Plus, the fabric is as thin as a t-shirt making it the perfect spring/fall extra layer.

Earlier this week I decided to order three more of be product- in dark green; light brown; and royal blue. I haven't received the dark green yet. However, I opened up the brown and blue ones and the fit and texture are nothing like the navy one. The fabric is not super soft and the fit is not flattering.

After skimming the reviews, I noticed ppl complaining that the item they received was not 80/20 cotton/polyester, but 50/50. Given my experience with the fit and texture, I decided to check the label of the navy (that I love) and the two new ones. As it turns out, the navy is 50/50, which gives it an amazing soft texture. The others I received are not.

Not cool. First, the item is advertised as 80/20. Second, they are selling the different colors as if they are the same product. Try clearly are not.

 Bottom line-- the navy is…

reviews.title: IMPORTANT CLEANING INFO IN MY REVIEW - Great Slimfit High Quality Zip Up Hoodie for Style not Warmth
reviews.text:
**IMPORTANT CLEANING INFO - ONLY WASH IN COLD WATER AND HANG TO DRY - DO NOT USE DRYER NOT EVEN ON LOWEST/DELICATE SETTING - If you wash in hot water or use dryer at all it will shrink and cause hoodie to lose its supersoft feeling and show signs of wear much quicker. I learned this the hardway and lost one cuz of it.

If you have a beer belley you probably dont want this "slimcut" hoody since they cut waist and belley/mid-section tighter and "V" out up to your chest & shoulders. (Tight around stomach, more space in chest area) I actually have a few of these in different colors and are for style not warmth but are worth every penny. These are way better then the thin fruit of the loom or hanes zip up hoodies for under 20$. & better quality then the slimcut H2H Hoodies which are around same price as these. They are made from a thin material but not in a cheap or bad way though just make sure you wash in cold and never use a dryer, hang them to dry. These are great high quality, well made slimcut hoodies which are meant for us skinny guys, especially tall and skinny guys like myself. All of my button down dress shirts are slimcut as well and I am 6'1" 170lbs and its extremely hard…

reviews.title: It's pretty decent. 4.5/5.
reviews.text:
I went off the reviews and took a shot on this hoodie since I needed something lightweight for the summer. The material is great, the zipper feels like it will hold up for at least a few months, and the fit is almost perfect but not quite. I was expecting it to be a bit more on the slim side but it's in between a slim and regular fit. For the record, I don't want slim fit to cut off circulation but brands like doublju have it perfected to where they sit on your skin but also allow your skin to breathe and really show off your figure. In this scenario, it's just a bit more loose than what I wanted it to be. It's not baggy lose but should be fine for the average person's taste. I ordered it in XL - black. I'm about 6'4", athletic build, and 200lbs. I normally alternate between L and XL depending on the brand. The hoodie extended down slightly lower below my waist so it won't ride up and expose my abdomen if I throw my hands in the air. There's also plenty of fabric extending up to your hands so the sleeves don't feel too short which is what us taller people hate.

Overall I would recommend it. It doesn't feel too cheap despite being $25. The material is stretchy and I have a…

reviews.title: I would not recommend this for cold weather
reviews.text:
This is a high quality lightweight hoodie. The material feels high quality, but it's thin. I would not recommend this for cold weather, just slightly cool. Mine had a few threads sticking out here and there, which I trimmed off with scissors.
I'm 5'9" 125 lbs, and I returned the medium and got a large. The medium was not long enough; it was similar in length to a typical medium t-shirt, which is too short if you want it to come down a bit lower than that. The large fits me well, but it's not as slim as shown in the photo.

Interestingly, the zipper on this hoodie is left-handed. Meaning that the part that slides into the puller thingy is on the right, while most zippers have it on the left.

reviews.title: Runs large so size down. Barely shrunk in the dryer :-)
reviews.text:
I'll be honest, I am skeptical of buying any clothing online, much less flannel that can shrink pretty drastically if it's made with cheap fabric. Without being able to feel the material and try it on for size, I don't like being bothered with the hassle of returning/exchanging. But I took a chance with this one and I'm glad I did. It fits perfect, even after washing! It barely shrank in the dryer. Using low heat, it retained almost all of its length.

SIZING: These shirts run large, so size down. I haven't been a small in anything in my adult life and I'm glad I read in the description that the model in the pictures is 6'2" and wearing a medium. I am 2" shorter so I ordered a small and it fits perfectly.

QUALITY: This is a soft medium weight flannel that seems to be made of higher quality material. As I said, it barely shrunk in the dryer so that leads me to believe the cotton isn't cheap. The patterns line up on the seams and on the chest pocket.

BOTTOM LINE: I would definitely recommend this shirt. For the price, you'll be hard pressed to find a better quality shirt than this. I was so happy with the fit after washing that I immediately went online and bought three more. When…

reviews.title: Perfect flannel .
reviews.text:
I wanted an oversized flannel and thought the small would be tight but it was perfect.

The material feels thick, soft and very comfortable. Happy with the purchase.

reviews.title: Comfortable and well made
reviews.text:
This is an excellent shirt. The texture is a brushed, soft finish that is very comfortable. I am 6 feet tall and weigh 190 pounds with a somewhat broad chest. A medium fit me well to provide a slim, well put together look without looking or feeling tight at all. The hem of the shirt hits just below the opening of my front pocket on my jeans. The armholes are tailored a bit higher than you would find on a "work" flannel and are more consistent with a dress shirt style. That isn't to say that this flannel is restrictive in any way. It is comfortable with enough room to move around and do any routine tasks. I probably wouldn't wear this if you plan on chopping wood or doing something really upper body intensive though. The stitching appears to be solid but I will have to wear it for a while to see how it holds up over time. I am a bit disappointed that Amazon doesn't provide a fit guide or sizing chart for their own products. Those are very common among other brands and it would certainly help others feel more confident in their purchase. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a casual flannel that doesn't want something overly baggy or super-slim.

***UPDATE***
The…

reviews.title: Winning Flannel!
reviews.text: The best flannels I have ever purchased, I purchased off Amazon this year for my brother for Christmas! It is difficult shopping online for flannel button ups because you can't see them and feel them in person (maybe I'm just super picky!). This is a perfect material--it is soft, thick and cozy without being too warm or being too thick that it is uncomfortable around the neck and under the armpits. It washes very well and stays soft. Looks great buttoned up or unbuttoned, it's a fantastic layering piece. The colors are vibrant & the plaid print stays sharp enough even after washing (sometimes after washing flannels, they end up becoming "fuzzy" from the cotton piling & the color and print fades, but have not had this issue with these). I love these flannels so much that I want to buy them in smaller sizes for myself!

reviews.title: soft & Thick quality!
reviews.text: I LOVE this flannel! i'm 5'6 I got a 2XL- wanted it to be loose and baggy. Its on the thicker side and soft! Feels like very good quality, worth every penny! will definitley be buying more!!

reviews.title: Not unqualified 5 star rating, but still a great deal
reviews.text:
The bottom line is that I plan to buy another in a couple of weeks. Also, I'll likely check out some of Amazon Essential's other offerings.

I just got the shirt and tried it on. I should note that it's 100% cotton, and that I've not washed it -- I don't know how much it is to shrink.

Pros
+ Very soft, great for cold winter days -- really great feel!
+ Sturdier than I expected
+ Nice looking ( - BUT color isn't exactly as I'd expected as there is some green, which I can live with, just sayin')
+ You can't beat the price

Cons
- I'm 6'1" and 190 lbs. I bought size large, and it seems just right. I do typically like shirts such as these to be a bit roomy (relative to dress shirts)

Word to the wise to check the color on another device or in another browser. Again, I will be getting another, and I'm happy enough to consider buying some of Amazon's other clothes offerings based upon this.

reviews.title: Nice quality shirt with small buttons and runs about a half size larger than expected.
reviews.text:
The combination of an Amazon Essentials branding and the price tag of $18, I was expecting a nice, low quality shirt. Nothing spectacular, but at least utilitarian. I was pleasantly surprised to find the quality of the shirt was better than expected. The wool is very soft to the touch, and a noticeable thickness that doesn't seem to add to the weight. The buttons aren't as nice and rather small in my opinion (3/8" wide). I ordered a medium (typically what I wear), and feel the overall size is larger than a medium. The sleeves are long and the shirt length is also rather long (obviously intended to be tucked in). I tried it on and then washed in. Hoping it might shrink a bit (I wash and rinse in cold water), but it didn't in my case.

All said and done, I'm like it and will be keeping it.

reviews.title: Much Looser fit than the non-flannel amazon shirts.
reviews.text: Soft flannel, so that's good. I like a boxy cut but this was too loose and too boxy. The shirt runs a bit long and I am six feet tall so must tuck it in.
