The non-flannel amazon men's shirts had a good fit but I think they went more baggy with the flannels. Would not buy more of them myself. Someone with a stockier frame might like these though

reviews.title: And the search continues.
reviews.text:
I have been on an endless hunt for old style.. meaning 100% cotton denim jeans. I mean, how hard could that be, right? Well, let me tell you I have a garden full of four-leaf clovers and a herd of unicorns that were easier to find than non-stretchy jeans. I’ll admit, I’m old and have been wearing jeans since I was a kid and borrowing my brother’s since there were none available for girls so I know that kind of jeans did exist.
When was it decided that women need jeans that are like leggings.. and why didn’t I get a vote? I’ve spent a lot of money on various Levi style types and sadly, I have yet to find my jeans. I really wanted to like these, and from the reviews, I had high hopes, but when I received them, they were just another iteration of stretch. Arrrgh! I mean, really?? I even bought the dark color since they seemed to have a higher cotton percentage, but they are thin and just creepy feeling… oh.. and stretchy.. did I mention stretchy??
So.. if you have no fond memories of 100% cotton denim jeans, these may be just what you are looking for, but my hunt continues and Goodwill will get another pair of brand new leggings.. I mean jeans.

reviews.title: These are not straight leg jeans.
reviews.text: Tiny front pockets, thin material, and poor stitching were bad, but the style isn't what they list. These are skinny legs not straight legs. If you're designing curvy jeans, then you need to increase the diameter on the legs for straight leg jeans. These cheap poorly made pants were loose on top and too tight in the leg. If I wanted jeggings then I would have bought jeggings. This material is jegging weight, not denim weight.

reviews.title: Great for tall, muscular, curvy figures
reviews.text: I’m 5’10” and wear 16T. These fit like a glove. I live in Texas, so I appreciate that they are thinner and I can therefore wear them for most of the year. My only quibble is a point that another reviewer also brought up: the seam on one leg turns in towards the front of the leg. This happens with the dark blue color, but not the black (I bought two pairs).

reviews.title: I'm in love with these jeans
reviews.text: I'm a long time fan of the Levi's 529 curvy fit. I have these a try when my 529 straight leg were no longer available. I'm in love with these jeans. Fair warning- they are really jeggings, not much denim feel to them. The comfort wins over denim for me. At $20- I immediately ordered another pair!

reviews.title: Modern and super comfortable
reviews.text:
I’m a chubby older lady. I have a big tummy, wide hips and a bubble butt. Most jeans gap on me or are too tight in the waist.

These jeans are fantastic ! The fabric is very thin and stretchy but NOT clingy! I love the curvy fit and highly reccomend it over the “ Slim shaping” fit.
I’m also a shorty at 5’2 and the short length option is perfect on me.
These look modern and not too trendy for an adult lady . They also do NOT look dated or out of style. Perfect neat casual look.
The fabric is thin. I like the thin fabric as the jeans are lightweight and super comfortable. Almost as comfortable as a yoga pant . I no longer have the legs for shorts so these are fine with the warmer weather.

reviews.title: Terribly Disappointed.
reviews.text: The fit was as expected, as I have rarely ever had a fit issue with Levi jeans; HOWEVER, this pair I am NOT happy with. The material was not cut properly so when I put them on the side seams angled to the front of my leg and despite supposedly having a 34" inseam, they barely come to the top of my shoes! Not a good thing to find when you just bought them, put them in a suitcase and discover the issues during a business trip. I hope this was just a manufacturing flaw.

reviews.title: Comfortable and Affordable
reviews.text: I love these jeans! I needed to get new jeans to replace some old ripped ones, and dreading the shopping nightmare that I usually face, I decided to look online. I'm pear-shaped, so I've always had a terrible time finding jeans that fit me right, and are comfortable and affordable. I'd say based on that criteria (as well as the convenience of buying online), these are the best pair of jeans I've ever owned. I'm 5'3", 145lbs, 28in waist, 40in hips, and bought the size 8. The jeans are light weight and very stretchy, making them easy to pull on and move around in, as well as breathable in these hot summer days. There is no gapping around my waist, but not tight around my hips or thighs either (hallelujah!). Because of the stretchiness, I think I would have actually done better with a size 6 (they tend to slide down my hips slightly as I wear them), but they still fit me fine, they're just a tad roomier than I usually like/am used to. I will most definitely be buying several more pairs of these - my fellow curvy girls will know you gotta stock up when you find a good pair of jeans!

reviews.title: Accents tummy not in a good way...
reviews.text: Umm, they are nice quality with a lot of stretch and the color is good. I do like the straight leg - just the right amount of flare. The only issue is they really, really need a tummy panel - which they do not have. I felt like it accented the tummy area. The waistband is nice and doesn't dig in, but it completely highlights where my tummy starts. I'll have to wear something underneath to help smooth the area...you definitely need to. I love Levi's and with my weight issues right now, I'll wear these if I have to...I'll just wear something to cover the tummy area like a flowy cardigan.

reviews.title: Perfect flannels for me!
reviews.text:
The borg-lining is very soft and warm.
The sleeves have inner-lining.
The colors and design are beautiful! Very traditional as I like it! So I bought 3 different ones.

Let me give it up for Wrangler!!!

reviews.title: Not as bulky as the photos, but still awesome
reviews.text:
Not as bulky as it looks in the photos.
I wore it under a denim jacket recently so I could have insulation while still having the look and it works well.
Just ordered another in plain charcoal.
The lining isn’t super bulky, but enough to feel the difference when out in the elements.
The sleeves are quilted lined and aren’t too short or too long.
The side pockets are nice, but not big enough for something like an iPhone.
Another review said something about the collar being flimsy, they are correct. It isn’t a super sturdy shirt collar, but if you’re okay with that, then you’re fine.

reviews.title: The very best insulated shirt IMO
reviews.text: I bought another Wrangler Sherpa Lined shirt in Denim color, and it was so nice, I bought this one in the plaid pattern. It is just as nice and comfortable as the first one I bought. I wear them everyday at home during the cold months with sweat pants, which gives me the ability to turn down my thermostat to 65 degrees and stay perfectly comfortable and save a bunch on my heating bill, and so the shirts have actually paid for themselves. Also, it's nice to be able to go out to the mailbox without having to put on a winter jacket for only a couple minutes use. And going from the house to car to go shopping, there's no need for a winter coat either. They've gone through several washings and are holding up quite well. I highly recommend them.

reviews.title: Warm and well made!
reviews.text: I am a female and I was looking for a lined, warm, well made flannel shirt. Since it is cut for a man, it fits me loose, longer and more boxy. However that is what I was looking for since I am using it as a fall jacket. The lining is soft and is what makes this shirt useful as a jacket. I am very happy with my purchase and am going to get another one in a different color. It will also come in handy when winter comes.

reviews.title: Runs big and just missed the mark on quality.
reviews.text: I’m 6’ 250lbs with a bit of a belly and the XXL was HUGE. The sleeves are very bulky and puffy. The wrist opening, however, has to be unbuttoned to allow enough room for your hand to get through — pretty odd for a shirt-jacket... The front of the shirt is oddly short. The side pockets are very shallow and do not have any droop so nothing would stay in there. The pattern on the front pockets is asymmetrical showing little care for quality. Pretty much the only good thing that I can say is that the lining is nice and soft. Really disappointed.

reviews.title: Real review on size here:
reviews.text: I hate reviewing items, however since so many people can't write an accurate review or they write one before opening the package, please know this is an honest review. I am 6'2, 195-200lbs, mostly flat tummy. I purchased a large on this item and it fits very nicely. The sleeve length is perfect (in a dress shirt I wear a 34-35 sleeve) and the body length of this shirt falls midway on my butt. I can button it up and still have room to move around without feeling pulling of the shirt. It does fit slightly bigger in the belly area than I prefer, but it would allow for men that have a small belly. Overall, buy the size you normally would! It hasn't shrunk in the wash, it is comfy, and it isn't tight, nor is it blousy. Regards.

reviews.title: Size up
reviews.text:
I was torn on whether to give 2 or 3 stars. Although it has flaws, it is well made.
Flaws:
I know it’s a shirt jacket, but it is cut exactly like a dress shirt. Then padding the inside only makes for a weird fit. It should’ve been given a relaxed design to accommodate for the padding. By the way, it’s cut like a dress shirt, but not the tails? They are modified to be jacket-esque. The front pockets are too small for modern cell phones which I see as a failure, dress shirt designing again. The side pockets are nice and not bulky, but not very deep.
The things I do like are that the sleeves are a quilted lining not Sherpa like the main body. The side pockets are also quilted a nice touch to keep bulk down. The color is very nice.
Overall, I’m a bit mixed on this purchase. I wanted to send it back, but my wife quickly adopted it. I wish I went XL instead of L. I’m leery to buy again in that size XL, going to think on it for a bit.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Great jacket for my boyfriend! He is 6’4, 250 pounds.

reviews.title: Comparing Gildan Thicknesses
reviews.text:
I ordered this shirt and also the "Gildan 5.3 oz. Heavy Cotton T-Shirt" to compare them. This
"Gildan Men's Ultra Cotton Tee" is definitely a heavier weight cotton than the "Gildan 5.3 oz. Heavy Cotton T-Shirt".

So basically the "heavy cotton" shirt is thinner.

I am guessing this "Gildan Men's Ultra Cotton Tee" is 6.0 oz. or more. It's better quality. The "Gildan 5.3 oz. Heavy Cotton T-Shirt" is getting returned.

reviews.title: Shrunk significantly in dryer
reviews.text: It's tough to review this. When I bought these shirts they fit as I liked, if a touch big, but I was satisfied. The let down for me was that after I washed them they shrank significantly, to the point I consider them too small. And I'm quite paranoid about shrinking clothes, I'm a big guy, so I always dry my laundry on the lowest heat available and do not overdry anything. I would not recommended these shirts.

reviews.title: What Happened?
reviews.text: I am so disappointed in the material of these shirts. I bought 4 of them in different colors than I had purchased in the past at Michaels, nice soft cotton. I thought they would be the same but contrare, the material of these shirts is so grainy and rough that I took it off after about 10 minutes and haven't put one on since. It feels like wearing a feed sack that horse grain comes in. They are likely bound for the trash. I suppose Gildan is like all companies now, just cheap, cheap, cheap it up so they can make more money!

reviews.title: Definitely not soft
reviews.text: The shirt is accurate size-wise, albeit a bit shorter than most t- shirts, but the material is like scratchy canvas- not soft at all! I purchased a couple similar looking t’s from another brand, paid a couple dollars more and got a much better quality, soft cotton. I’m not really complaining, as this one only cost 7 dollars but it will be relegated as a work shirt and probably just be thrown away soon.

reviews.title: Know your measurements
reviews.text:
My advice: Pick a few of your favorite fitting t-shirts, and get their relevant measurements to use as a guide. Then, buy the shirt size that comes closest to those ideal measurements.

I bought both the MEDIUM and LARGE sized shirts. For me, I preferred the MEDIUM, but some people might prefer a LARGE for a looser fit.

My current stats:

Height = 6 ft
Weight = 193 pounds
Chest = 41”
Biceps = 15”
Waist (around the love handles) = 36.5”

After washing in hot water and drying on high heat dryer settings, the length shrunk about 1 to 2 inches. The other measurements shrunk about .25 inches.

I've uploaded images showing measurements for the MEDIUM sized and the LARGE sized t-shirts:

reviews.title: Still true to size and thickness of material... good product for the the money.
reviews.text: In this global manufacturing economy, I have a hard time finding consistency in size and quality from order to order on any clothing. I was very pleased to find Gildan's Ultra Cotton Tee is still true to the size and quality of material they used three years ago. I now intend to order a 5 year supply.

reviews.title: Purple and pleased!
reviews.text: This shirt is very comfortable. It is soft and thick. The fabric is not see through at all. The material is heavy, but not rough or too heavy. The fit of the shirt is a little smaller than expected, and the only major negative is that the shirt is kind of shorter than I wish it was. The length of the sleeves is perfect. The sleeves are a longer cap sleeve, that extend about half way from the shoulder to the elbow. The color is rich and consistent, it is almost exactly the color of the purple in the picture. The shape and integrity of the shirt is great. It arrived in great shape, and after washing and drying and wearing several times it has maintained the same shape and hasn't gotten stretched out nor has it shrank. There were not holes, flaws or Anything abnormal about the shirt. I am over all very pleased with this item!

reviews.title: the Hanes' shirt is slightly more comfortable. I honestly don't think the
reviews.text:
The shirt is slightly smaller than I anticipated (in fabric allowance).

Although it's comparable to Hanes' Beefy T, I felt the Gildan was slightly thinner (to be fair, it is 6oz vs Hanes' 6.1oz). You can check by holding up the shirt to a light and seeing how much passes through. Obviously, use the same color shirt for both experiments.

Compared to fit vs the Hanes' Beefy T, the Hanes' shirt is slightly more comfortable. I honestly don't think the .1oz makes any significant difference, but it does sit differently on the body. I prefer the Hanes' shirt, but it doesn't make sense to return this Gildan which is available for only $2.95.

reviews.title: OH EM GEE!!
reviews.text: I ABSOLUTELY LOVVVVVVVE THIS SHIRT MORE THEN I EXPECTED TO I SWEAR!!! IM 5'4 187 AND IT STILL FITTED PERFECTLY I ORDERED THE LARGE 12-14 AND I LOVE IT ...IT ZIPPED VERY EASY ..WELL I PUT THE ZIPPER IN THE FRONT TO GIVE ME MORE CONTROL OF HOW I WANTED TO LOOK AND IT ACTUALLY LOOKS BETTER IN THE FRONT, ALSO THE STRAPS WERE A TAD BIT LOOSE SO I JUST CRISS CROSSED THEM WHICH TURNT THIS SKIRT INTO A TOTALLY DIFFERENT LOOK I LOVE EVERYTHING ABOUT IT THERE WASN'T ANY IMPERFECTIONS TO ME AT ALL!! IT WAS A SLIGHT LITTLE SMELL WHEN I FIRST OPENED BUT IT WENT AWAY AFTER I SPAYED FABREEZE AND PERFUME ON IT lol ITS NOT THAT SHORT ON ME MAYBE RIGHT AT MY KNEE BUT MY BUTT MAKES IT HIJACKED IN THE BACK SO I JUST WORE BLACK BOY SHORTS TO PREVENT ANY PROBLEMS. THE SHIPPING WAS SUPERB IT CAME SOOOOOOOOO FAST ION EVEN THK A FULL 24 HRS. LOVE LOVE LOVE

reviews.title: Happy Customer!
reviews.text:
My info: 5'4", 145lbs, size medium
I chose medium because of the past reviews about the length of the skirt. I could get away with small but medium is comfortable, and the length is that of all my other skirts so to me this is okay. The suspenders actually fit me quite well? Not sure if its just my build though. There is a bit of room so I can only guess it's really loose on others so just note that.
The cute little pearl on the back is a nice touch and there was no difficulty with the zipper.

reviews.title: Slightly big for small people
reviews.text: All the reviews said that it was a little loose on smaller ladies. I am 5'1 and weigh 105lbs. The reviews were correct just a little big. Only down side the straps are not adjustable so they kept falling odd my shoulders, will have to sew them to be smaller

reviews.title: I easily fixed this with a safety pin
reviews.text: After having this skirt in my shopping cart forever I finally decided to buy it. I'm 5'7 and ordered a medium, it fit perfectly! The only issue as mentioned by other buyers is that the straps are loose. I easily fixed this with a safety pin. The skirt was just long enough offering the perfect amount of coverage. I have long legs so sometimes skirts can be too short, so rest assured if you have long legs this will provide the necessary coverage! I was worried it would look/feel cheap but it doesn't. I bought it for a music festival and it was super comfy and I got loads of compliments!

reviews.title: I absolutely adore this skirt!
reviews.text:
This skirt is absolutely adorable and I love it!

I'm 5'5" and 165 pounds. I wear US pant sizes 10-15 short (depending on the brand). My thighs/hips are the largest part of my body and my legs are short. I love the fact that the bands are elastic so I don't have to worry about anything ripping! I got a Large to ensure the skirt wasn't too short (as other reviewers said), so it comes down mid-thigh. The zipper on the back is cute with a large pearl. When I first saw the skirt, I felt discouraged because the top seemed half my size, but the elastic endured everything without feeling like I was being squeezed! The only downside about it is the straps. They're not adjustable, so they're loose, but not too loose to bug me so much.

Here's some pictures. I don't have a full body mirror, so I can't show how long it is, but hope this helps anyone else interested in buying this!

reviews.title: Overall, I'm thrilled
reviews.text: I have a short torso, so the only real issue I had were that the suspender straps we a bit too long, but other than that it was exactly as pictured. So worth the money and it got me a lot of compliments. No damages and a total steal.

reviews.title: lovely skirt <3
reviews.text: This skirt is fire oml. Im fifteen years old, 5'2ish and around 155-160 pounds. I got the large and it fits like a glove! The suspenders are a bit loose but no too loose where it becomes a bother.

reviews.title: YESSSS. Extremely happy with this.
reviews.text: I'm 170 lbs and 5'5", but I have a flat tummy-ish. (I wear around 11 US size pants.) So, it actually fits perfectly! I bought a large. When I received this item, surprisingly, there were no any damage to it. No loose threads either. The pearl zipper looked prettier than I thought! While I was putting it on, of course, baggy shirts/etc wouldn't look good in it. The tops you wear has to be tight. You may need help with closing the zipper from your friends or families. Just be careful with it. However, most of the reviews were actually right; the straps are a bit loose, so keep your head and shoulders up or something. It falls off my shoulders sometimes. When I wore and showed it to everyone, they died from my cuteness apparently. I felt so much better wearing it. It'll be a bit too short from behind, but it's not a problem as long as you wear something under it like shorts. And I'm pretty sure the straps wouldn't be a problem if you have huge breasts. I also suggest purchasing over the knee socks/stockings for this outfit. [Of course!] The back is as pretty as the front! This one is my most favorite one ever, oml.

reviews.title: ISSA ❤️
reviews.text: [[VIDEOID:6d96fedc8ef5ff8c5df8717782b96417]] BBWs this one is a keeper.... I’m a true 18/20 with curves, bumps and lady lumps..... I’m not busty, however I found the breast area to be small... I’m tall, 5’11 and it hit right at the ankle..... I will definitely need a shaper to smooth out the ripples but it’s a great fit and I like it a LOT!!!!! I ordered XL....

reviews.title: A Tall Girl’s Dream!
reviews.text:
I bought this dress in dark green and black for an upcoming vacation.

I am 6’0 225lbs and I ordered a XXL after reading sizing and measurements. I am quite bottom heavy with hips that measure ~50” and this dress fits beautifully. I am often hesitant about maxi dresses because they’re always too short, but the length on these dresses is a dream. Wearing flat sandals the dress hits right above the floor.

The pockets lay nicely in front of my hips so they don’t poke out in a weird way to make you look square. The dresses are extremely lightweight but not see through with nude underwear and a nude bra.

reviews.title: Nice dress, great material but I just wish it ...
reviews.text: Nice dress, great material but I just wish it was a little longer. However, I am 5’11 lol I purchased a L. Maybe I should have went a size up! If you’re thinking about it, get it!

reviews.title: Really happy so far
reviews.text:
Really happy so far, very stretchy, flowy, thick material.
I'm 5'6", 230 lbs, 42D
I feel like if you're any shorter you'll have problems walking in this dress.
And if you're more heavy up top I do think it'll stretch to accommodate. Really nice dress.

reviews.title: Vacay Dress
reviews.text: Always worried about length on Maxi dresses. I am 5'10 and this hits me at the top of my feet, so I'm pleased with that. Bought the dark green and love the color. Only complaint is it has a weird smell to it. Hoping I can wash the smell out without losing the positives of the dress, color & length

reviews.title: Watch Out for Pattern Placement!
reviews.text: I ordered this dress in the Mix Blue color/pattern to branch out from my usual solid colors. When it arrived in the mail, I was ecstatic that it was long enough (sometimes a toss up with maxi dresses at 5'7) , it was VERY comfy, and it had pockets. However, my excitement subsided when I looked in the mirror and saw the unfortunate placement of the pattern (see photo). Sadly, I will be returning this dress and reordering in a standard solid color. This is what I get for branching out.

reviews.title: Love the dress
reviews.text: Love the dress. It's very comfortable and can easily be dressed up with some accessories. I wear a size 22 pant and the XXL fits just fine. I've gotten lot of compliments on this dress every time I wear it. Would definitely buy again.

reviews.title: Comfy maxi dress
reviews.text: I like it. But if you are busty it will fit a bit differently as most things do. I’m 5’4, an 18/20 and 42G. I purchased the 2xl. It is long on me, I don’t mind. A little clingy, not more than most maxi skirts or dresses. The pockets are awesome and I loved the color. Would get another color or two.

reviews.title: Cute skirt, has pockets, nice length
reviews.text:
I was looking for mid-shin skirts, something for the fall that I can wear athletic capris under for an extra layer. This skirt isn't quite long enough for my capris, but it's wonderful regardless. If you're a bike-shorts-under-skirts kind of person, this will suit you just fine.

I usually wear an American size 4 Petite, but I sized up and purchased this Yige Women's High Waist Flared Skirt Pleated Midi Skirt with Pocket in a size 6.
It fits perfectly -my waist is 28" and my hips are 39".

The skirt arrived new and folded in a simple plastic sleeve. I steamed out the wrinkles with a little travel steamer, and even though I was hasty, the wrinkles were removed easily. The garment hangers are a nice touch, but I love the pockets! They may not be huge, but they are functional and will hold my phone (iPhone SE (same size as iPhone 5)). A nice liner is sewn in, it is almost as long as the skirt (not short like some liners) and it is a good color match, at least in khaki. The zipper didn't give me any trouble and is perfectly invisible.

The pleats in the front and back are simple, classic, and evenly spaced. When I twist and swirl the skirt does not rise very high -so modesty is…

reviews.title: Absolutely love this skirt
reviews.text:
Absolutely love this skirt! Classic look for work; good length with flats or heels; love having pockets to keep my cell phone handy while at work; fabric doesn't get horribly wrinkled after riding in the car for hours at a time.
Sizing: I ordered up after reading many reviews that said it ran small, but found that wasn't necessary. I'm 5'4", 112 lbs and usually wear a 2 in most brands. Going by the size chart, I ordered a 6, but returned it for a 4. A 2 would probably work as well, but might be a touch snug in the waist by the end of the day since the fabric has no stretch.
If you value your other clothes, please please please wash this all by itself the first time. I ordered this in black and navy blue, and the dye bleeds. A LOT (see photo). Rinsing in the sink first, then using a Shout Color Catcher sheet in the washer helped avoid any disasters though.

reviews.title: Great skirt! Thoroughly impressed!
reviews.text:
I purchased this item as a regular "wear to work" piece. I have now worn it twice.
The package arrived timely as indicated by Prime shipping. It was well packaged, and was not too wrinkled upon opening. One quick steam in the bathroom while showering dropped most of the more noticeable wrinkles. The material is nice...it has the nexture of denim, but a thinner material. The zipper works perfectly and seems to be made a sturdy quality. It dress up well, but can also be worn more casually (I have worn it with a black/white polka dot top and a denim button up; both looked great!)
The skirt is hand wash only, something I didn't realize before ordering. I don't mind, though, but it is something to keep in mind.
Size-wise, it does run a little snug. I am usually a size 14 (5'1", 175 lbs) it sits at my natural waist, and is just a bit tighter than I prefer, but it zips comfortably.

reviews.title: A great skirt for the price
reviews.text: A great skirt for the price! I chose my size by looking at the size chart because the skirt does run small. I'm 5'6" and 148lbs and ordered a size 10. It fits perfectly around my natural waist. The skirt is lined, has pockets, and goes a little past my knees. 4 stars because the fabric is kind of on the cheaper side and the color is a bit paler than pictured.

reviews.title: True to size! Love this, buy more than 1!
reviews.text: I am 5' 2" and 138 lbs, I normally wear a 8 and ordered a 10 due to reviewers saying to size up... the 10 sat at my "wearing waist" not my true waist so I returned it for an 8 which is perfect. I loved it so much I bought a second one. I have Navy & Black. The Navy I would say is not a true navy, it has just a touch more purple in it, I would call it an Ink Blue... I have a pleated skirt from White House Black Market that is a similar color... I tried to show in a close up pic the skirt next to cobalt blue, black and a blueish purple to get a feel for the color. The fabric is soft and flows nice.. not too thick not too thin. Pockets are just right. Pics are of both the black and navy skirt.

reviews.title: Would absolutely order again (& probably will!)
reviews.text: I am in love with this skirt! For reference, I ordered a size 16, which is what I generally wear in jeans & anything that I want to fit over my hips & butt, but I actually probably could’ve gotten away with ordering a size down, even if I let it rest on my hips instead of wearing it waist-high. That alone makes me feel awesome about this order, but throw in the fact that the material is not too heavy or light, the color is just as shown, & the length is just right, too, & I’m swooning. I’ll definitely be ordering again!

reviews.title: Perfect Fit!
reviews.text: Perfect Fit. I wear a 14 and I ordered size 14. It fits exactly as expected. Love finding true to size clothes on here! The olive is a rich deep color, perfect for fall/winter but I think not could be worn year round. The fabric weight is perfect for Florida. It's not heavy wool but it's a great quality fabric with some shine to it and a little sleekness almost like taffeta but without all the noise. Iys also a very modest length. I'm 5 foot tall and it came well last my knees, like mid calf so even an average height girl could still pull this off as knee length for church or the office. It has a nice flare to it. Not too bulky so it doesn't make you look wide even when you're short like me. I think it will need ironing as it had some wrinkles coming out of the package but not too bad. I'm thrilled with the fit and quality and plan to order in more colors.

reviews.title: Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU!
reviews.text: For so very long (years!) I have been looking for a simple A-line skirt like this. Modest length, well lined, and pockets that are REALLY POCKETS! My hand actually fits into them! And as an added bonus with this skirt, the material is of a nice quality. I am so very pleased and have bought two of these skirts, one tan, one navy blue. I am a simple girl and for all those other simple girls out there that likes to dress nice with little hassle and be comfortable, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this skirt. Thank you so very much YIGE! I hope in time you will also come out with a few tasteful prints for your skirts as well. If I could, I would give you 10 stars.

reviews.title: Very Very Happy with this top!!
reviews.text:
I was worried when I ordered this but was very pleased when I received it. It’s nice a flowing. Material is pleasing and it draps and covers my stomach very well. It stays put at the shoulders which is a huge deal
To me!! I am 5’4, 219 lbs, 38 B, and typically wear XL or 1X. Highly recommended this top!!

reviews.title: Super cute and stays put!
reviews.text: This is a really cute style, flattering, and stays put with a “trick” I learned from another reviewer. 1st off, it’s a nice material.. it does not feel cheap at all. It’s adjustable with the tie, so you can snug it up to your actual waist line so it’s not too billowy which makes it flattering. I am a Jr’s large or ladies M, (5’7 and 160lbs.) and I ordered the M which fit great. I did wear a body shaper tank tucked into my jeans so I would not be showing my midriff. Now for the *trick* I pulled one of the ties through my jeans’ button hole and knotted it tight enough to keep the top securely off my shoulders and this also kept the top from riding up my waist all night. LOVE and going to order another color now!

reviews.title: Adore!
reviews.text: I bought two colors in size medium. I am 5 ft 3, 140lbs, 38D bust. People love them, and so do I. I plan to order another color!

reviews.title: Really good quality and made well
reviews.text: Really good quality and made well. Stays on shoulders. I’m 5’10 160lbs and got a medium and it fits just right. I do however have a long torso so when tied all the way it fits more like a belly shirt so just something to be aware of for tall girls.

reviews.title: I LOVE this top
reviews.text:
I LOVE this top! I am 5’10 and about 180 lbs. I typically wear a 12-14 pant and an L or XL top (depending on the top).
This top is a large. It’s more cropped in the front than I thought, but ties a little loser and I used a mid rise pant. Perfect! Thin material- but will be perfect for the concert in Vegas. Super cute!

reviews.title: Super cute, great fit!
reviews.text: Super cute shirt! Will be ordering more colors. I got the XL, I am a size 16, 38DDD. Maybe could have gone with a size L? It fits perfectly tho, flowy and very light, I have thicker arms and top stays put off shoulders. Love how flattering it is, even slimming while hiding my tummy...and uhh muffin top issues. Ha.

reviews.title: Great top for the price
reviews.text: I love this top, and I have received so many compliments on it! It does fit very loosely so you don’t need to size up to get that look. I’m usually a medium on most tops because of my bust size, but I ordered a small and it was perfect. I’m 5’6” 145 lbs and 34DDD. I like that it’s somewhat adjustable with the tie in the front, allowing me to make it longer or shorter depending on the type of pants I wear with it. Great price and I plan to purchase more with different prints/colors.

reviews.title: Comfortable and cute!
reviews.text: Comfortable and cute. Received many compliments!

reviews.title: The best jeans for curves!!!!
reviews.text: I loved these jeans. I was very skeptical because of how curvy I am but they fit better than my other jeans. Actually these fit the best!! If you’re curvy like me, you will LOVE them. Normally I’m a size 12 but these are an 8 and they fit just the way I love. Yes they are very very stretchy.

reviews.title: Don't even hesitate to buy these, they are awesome!
reviews.text: I rarely write reviews yet felt it was really important to share how fantastic these jeans are. I always struggled in the past to get a flattering pair of jeans and hardly ever wore them because i simply didn't feel comfortable or think they looked that great on me, with some recent weight loss and change in attitude I discovered these online and decided to take the gamble to order them, especially since they offer free returns. It really was the best decision I made! They are so comfortable, they look great, they are really flattering (I have quite meaty thighs and have an hourglass shape and they are really slimming!) they are super trendy and for the price are really good quality. I am so happy I actually ordered 2 pairs one size up for 'comfy days' and my usual size for going out, I stuck with the darker color because they are the most flattering on me, I am 5ft 4 and they show a bit of ankle on me. Its crazy I never thought a pair of jeans could make me so happy!!

reviews.title: COMFORTABLE WOW!
reviews.text:
I love EVERYTHING ABOUT THESE!
I might could have worn a size 8 but I chose to go with a 10. The chart says to order a size 12. Those would definitely been too big. These are a bit loose in the waist but still don't need a belt yet...
Comfort is a great thing with jeans and these are that in a nut shell.
I was feeling I've gotten to where I've aged out for buying ripped jeans but at age 66 I'm going to enjoy regardless because I've never bought ripped boyfriend jeans before. Loving everything about these...even purchased a second pair!

reviews.title: Size varies for each color, but good overall.
reviews.text:
I almost never write reviews. But I always read them, looking for bigger girls like me to decide whether or not I'm going to like them. And thats rare so in case you're a chubby chick like me, here i am to guide you. I am 208lbs and 5'6" VERY pear shaped.

I saw the reviews saying the pants ran large, so I ordered a 14 thinking I'd size down from my typical16. Well to my surprise the pants were actually a bit too big. I sent them back and ordered a size 12 which fits almost perfectly. They're probably my favorite and most comfortable jeans, but I wasn't thrilled to see they weren't really high rise, more of a mid rise. Well, I've had a c section so it hitting an inch below my belly button isn't the most flattering spot but I've been wearing shapewear under and that solves that problem.

So I decided I love the jeans so much that I wanted to get a black pair for work or trying to look put together. I ALMOST asked a question on here whether anyone knew if all the colors fit the same but I didn't. Well, I wish I did.

They DO NOT fit the same. The size 12 "dark wash" (which arent really that dark) fit amazing, they're incredibly stretchy they're just perfect. I try to pull on the…

reviews.title: Stretchy and runs a little large. Super comfy.
reviews.text: LOVE these! For girls with lovely lady lumps and thick thighs, these are supervisor comfy! I am 5" and thick. I usually wear a m/l in skirts, but xl in sweats because I have a smaller waist and thick thighs/hip/booty. I read the reviews and sized down to 12 from my usual 14. Could have done a 10. Legs fit great, but slightly loose at the waist. A little lighter in color than expected, but it's fine. Was hoping for ankle or above, but it's fine that the back reaches the ground- it doesn't drag, so it's workable. Took a star for the loose tummy/waist area, size, and color, but I'll buy again when these wear out.

reviews.title: Just as Described - Perfect
reviews.text: I just received my jeans today and I'm very glad I took the plunge based on everyone's reviews. They were a tad too big in the seat but I'm hoping a first wash will help that. I'm 5'4/174 lbs and ordered a size 14. I've lost 40 lbs and I'm having a difficult time (psychologically?) trying to get the right size jeans and these were perfect. They're very stretchy and good quality.

reviews.title: Stunning, Soft, Affordable. My favorite jeans!
reviews.text:
These jeans are absolutely my new favorite! Totally affordable price and ridiculously soft and comfortable.
The material is a soft jean, with lots of give to them (in a good "I can bend over in these without ripping something" kind of way).
I am 5'3 and 210lbs. Shorter legs, with thick thighs and lots of booty. There is NO GAP AT ALL in the back area, where almost all pants like to gap.
The rise is a comfortable height, right on top of my belly button. Does not dig in while seated.
I found the sizing to be accurate, at a size 16, like I always wear. Could I have fit into a 14? Probably. Should I fit into a 14? Nope.
The length is maybe 2 inches longer than I would have liked, but rolling them up is super cute, and the Lord blessed me with short legs. It is what it is.
Order these jeans. They are so cute! Sister, you deserve them!

reviews.title: Comfy and cute with real pockets!
reviews.text: I bought a size 10 and the pants were a little roomy. I'm 5'3" and 150 lbs, and I think a size 8 would have been too small. I can sit comfortably in these jeans, but they aren't as snug as I would like, but finding pants that can accomodate my curves is pretty difficult. If I order this brand again I might try to find jeans in a size 9 (if they offer that size). I wore these to work (warehouse) and was able to throw boxes, bend over, squat, and run around without feeling restricted. They're also very cute and have usable front pockets! Overall I'm pleased

reviews.title: Hard to find product since it has the Comfort Flex Waist Band .
reviews.text: Have bought this jean for at least 20 years. My local store that sold them closed. Elsewhere they were as much as $39.95 on line. The waist band will stretch about 1 to 1 1/4 inch. NOTE: The body of this jean is 100% cotton and not part spandex. The fabric content label shows, "99% Cotton, 1% Spandex". That 1% is only in the waistband. Avoid those that have spandex in the total material. They do not look like a "real" jean and seem hotter. I bought a pair once by mistake. I just marked one pair as "work jeans" and they are over 5 years old. I write the purchase date inside each pair I buy in case of a failure in under 1 year.. There was a 3 month period where Amazon did not have this product, so when they do, I order two pair. They now have a new color, SLATE, which I also like and the material appears to be a little lighter weight, which is fine for warmer weather. they are a great "dress" jean for a dance, or a night out. Use caution when shopping as the Wranglers with spandex in the legs will be labeled something like "comfort fit" or "flex fit". What i buy is labeled, :"Wrangler Men's Regular Fit Comfort Flex Waist Jean". thanks for reading my review, JohnA

reviews.title: They fit like a glove
reviews.text: I'm one of those oldsters that fluctuate between a 38" waist and a 40" waist. So, I have to either buy a 38 or a 40 waist pair of jeans, depending on my girth. This is really troublesome. I have a whole closet full or 38's and 40's; which means, I can wear half of them, most of the time. With this pair of Comfort-Flex Waist jeans from Wrangler, I can cover all of my bases. I got this pair yesterday, and I tried them on. They fit like a glove. I'm right now in that zone between 38 and forty; neither one nor the other. I put them on. They look great! They feel great! Wrangler, you outdid yourself. It looks like a tailor made a pair just for me. I'm definitely buying more than I pair; and they have them in a couple of different shades.

reviews.title: Hard to find Jeans that Fit and These Really Do. UPDATED
reviews.text:
I'm getting older (56 as I write this), and I've been between 34 and 36 pants for years now. I really need 35" waist in my jeans, but when I buy that size, they slip down over my hips. I'm wearing my first pair of Wrangler Comfort Fit with the elastic waist for the first time today, and they feel great - I got 34's, which I can barely get on without the elastic, but these went on easily and feel fantastic.

Highly recommended for older guys with no butt, and other folks who are hard to fit.

UPDATE: I wanted another pair in a lighter color - I was disappointed that "light stonewashed" were still pretty dark, so I ordered a third pair in "Slate", and they look really worn out already, or like I've already been wiping my hands on my pants - see picture I just added. The pair on the left are the new slate color comfort flex, an the others are a pair of regular old Wrangler regular fit jeans that I pulled out of my drawer - they're probably 3 years old, washed weekly.

reviews.title: VERY COMFORTABLE AND STRETCHY WAIST A PLUS!
reviews.text: I’m older and have no butt and Levi’s inch down if my pockets are full. With the stretchy waist, I get a better fit and they drift down much less. Also, they are very comfortable.

reviews.title: ... of jeans that fit a large frame without looking like a bag
reviews.text: A pair of jeans that fit a large frame without looking like a bag ! This is my fourth pair and I am pleased beyond expectations. Wrangler produces a competitive look-good,feel-good men's blue jean in what they call "AUTHENTICS" and the price is far less than Levis. Shrinkage is minimal as is fading from regular laundering.

reviews.title: Lasted less than 3 months
reviews.text:
I purchased 2 pairs of these jeans almost exactly 6 months ago to date. They were extremely comfortable and I was certain I had found my new go-to work jeans.

Last week I was wearing a pair at work (I do finish carpentry and drywall) and noticed the crotch was semi-blown out. Embarrassing to find at a clients home but definitely not something that hasn’t happened before, no biggie. I went home and put them on the shelf to repair at a later date since I am past warranty.

Yesterday, at the same clients home, I am wearing my second pair of these Wranglers, bend over to pick up a piece of crown molding when I hear the noise no one wants to hear. The sound of your entire Butt on your jeans blowing out. That’s 2 for 2 - in one week!!!

This is very disappointing - especially considering the fact that COVID had us out of work for 3.5 months and I never wore either of these jeans during that period. That means they lasted around 2.5 months in total. That being said, I can not recommend these.

reviews.title: Passed the Comfort Test
reviews.text: I purchased these for Mr. Cranky, who usually buys the “old man” full elastic waist jeans from another company. First, he was reluctant to try them on, whining that they wouldn’t fit around the waist..but I was happily surprised by his reaction! He loves these! Says they are really comfortable around the waist, (they really do have some stretch in the waistband) and he is so happy to have jeans without the wide elephant legs that seem to be on most large size pants. And..after washing, they’re still fitting! (We hang to dry & fluff in dryer for 10 minutes to remove wrinkles) So glad I took the chance & ordered them!

reviews.title: Great jeans.  Great price.
reviews.text: These are the most comfortable and good fitting jeans I've worn in a long time. Not only that, but they look nice. The waist expands just a bit for comfort, but the legs don't balloon out like clown pants. A common theme on most jeans for portly gents. Liked these so much I immediately bought another pair.

reviews.title: Sure ain't like the old days of Levi Strauss!! :(
reviews.text: I've worn Levi 517's for 30 years, and it seems the material weight is getting lighter and flimsier as time goes on. It's bad enough that such an American icon is made in foreign countries and still costs what it would if good paying, American workers. What's the profit margin on these, I wonder? Also, I know Levi's have always had some bleeding of the dye used, but I've washed this pair twice, and both times the water was so dark blue as it washed and rinsed, I couldn't see any of the clothes in the water. (Only wash blue clothes with these the first 4 or 5 times or you'll be sorry). The second wash was just as dark as the first. As I said, they aren't nearly as stiff as the old heavy duty material, and the dye must be some cheap stuff, but after the first wash they seemed very 'flimsy' compared to the old days, when they were so stiff you couldn't hardly bend your legs or sit down for the first half dozen washes. Engineered for maximum profits, not maximum life.

reviews.title: The real deal!!
reviews.text:
These 517's are the real deal. I've not changed my pants for forty some years. Still wearing Levis! But I was getting close to changing because of the thinner, cheaper denim they've been using lately. I was happy to see as I had been led to believe, that these are the same old sturdy, stiff and thicker denim. They call this "Raw Unwashed Denim". So if you're looking for the original thickness, make sure you order the "Raw Unwashed" version. I knocked them down to a 4 star only because of the price. You can buy them cheaper elsewhere but I paid the higher price because of the return policy. If they weren't the heavier denim, they would have been sent right back.
 Hope this helps you!
 Ted

reviews.title: Bought Levi's since I was a kid. These are ...
reviews.text: Bought Levi's since I was a kid. These are seconds being sold full price. What are seconds? Miscut, missewed, whatever you want to call them, rejects! Bought them for work pants and they'll do, but I won't take the chance and order pants on line. I can go anywhere that sells Levi's, grab a pair in my size, and without trying them on they'll fit perfectly. Not these! That's how I know they're seconds. Even the belt loops aren't right and smaller.

reviews.title: DYE RUBS OFF STILL AFTER MULTIPLE WASHINGS!!!
reviews.text: Noticed that the dye used for jeans was on my hands. Long story short, I've washed and the jeans five times and the dye STILL comes off in your hands.I usually get 501s and this never happend before! unwearable!!

reviews.title: BUYER BEWARE OF INCONSISTENT SIZES OR MISTAGGING
reviews.text: I always wear the same levi;s 517 boot cut 32 x 34 and they always fit but this pair of levi's 517 boot cut 32 x 34 is way too small.. I always wash them before I wear them and like I said this is the ONLY brand and style I ever buy so generally I don't have to try them on before I wash them. This pair I have to spray the waist with water and stretch them before I can even get them buttoned. I don't know if the wrong tags got put on them or just a different assembly line that their measurements are a bit different but these are definitely not the regular Levi's 517 boot cut 32 x 34 that I usually get, and I have been ordering these online for the last 15 years.So buyer beware of the size changes and try them on before washing even if you buy the same style and size every time. So after a couple more washes I probably won't even be able to get them on. What a waist of good money due to inconsistency of sizes from the assembly lines or mistagging the item.

reviews.title: Not the same Levi's
reviews.text: The fabric is not the same as it use to be, it is much thinner. If you have a blem or a loose weave (small fabric loop) esprecially in the front thigh area, it will be the place that the fabric fails. You can feel these if you rub your hands along your lap. If you have light dye spots sometimes almost white, these too can be a quick source of fabric failure. These jeans will deteriate very quickly once the fabric weave fails. Amazon was great concerning returning one pair out of four ordered, but the replacement has it's issues and will show problems before the exchange window expires. They are made in Mexico and lack the old "MADE IN USA" quality. I would rather see Levi's keep the old standard and charge me more because they would be worth it. They should offer a "Heritage" fabric option. Other than the fabric, they are the same. I still love my Levi's and have been wearing them for over 35 years!

reviews.title: Levi's 517 Boot Jean was not the advertised size
reviews.text:
I ordered a pair of 517 jeans using a size I had used for years. The jeans mailed to me showed the size on the Levi's patch, however they were several inches too long and the waist was much wider than normal. This was definitely not the size stated on the label.

Very frustrating, especially after we were eagerly anticipating their arrival 2 weeks after the order was placed. I hesitate to mail-order jeans again after this experience.

reviews.title: Not happy. Photo shows difference in length between 505 and ...
reviews.text:
I wear a 33 34 505. Decided to try some 517.
Ordered 33 34. Tried them on, and they seemed OK, a bit tighter than the 505. Then I washed them. Not I have clown pants that I cannot button or zip. Length after washing is near 2 inches shorter than the 505 after washing. Waist is at least an inch tighter. Not happy. Photo shows difference in length between 505 and 517.

reviews.title: I just got my coat today. It fits perfectly ...
reviews.text: I just got my coat today. It fits perfectly. I'm 6'3 240 lbs. I ordered the XL. I have A 79" reach. I haven't winter tested it yet. I'll update as soon as possible.

reviews.title: Will be incredibly warm!
reviews.text:
I ordered this jacket a couple of days ago, and it wasn't exactly what I was expecting.
I am still rating it five stars, because it is an awesome jacket, and it was most likely
my fault for not reading the description carefully enough to realize this is a much heavier
jacket than what I was looking for.
I live in Northeast Pennsylvania, and it gets chilly here in the winter, often getting into
single digits in January and February.
I think this jacket is designed for the Tundra though! I was wearing it for five minutes in 40 degree
weather, and I was sweating buckets when I took it off.
Way too warm for me, but that is what this jacket is designed for.
So, for a more lightweight alternative, I order the Sherpa Lined Sandstone Ridge Jacket:
http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B002GHCFF8/ref=oh_details_o00_s00_i00
This is exactly what I was looking for!
So way to go Carhartt, you make a product for everyone!
Amazon shipping and returns are awesome, was able to return the old jacket with the UPS man who delivered
my new jacket.
So all in all, this is a great jacket, but make sure you need something to keep you incredibly warm in below 0
weather.
If you're like me and run hot as it is,…

reviews.title: Good jacket.
reviews.text: I wanted to write a review for this jacket because I wasn't sure what size to order when looking at the size chart. I weigh 310 pounds and am 6 foot 1 inch tall. I ended up ordering the 3XL tall size since that's what I wear in t-shirts and other clothes. This jacket is really big in the shoulders, but fits properly across my stomach and will zip up easily with no problem. Carhartt wear is really good quality. I was sort of disappointed that the jacket didn't come in their brown color -- it's sort of like a soil color or dirt color that's a medium-dark brown. That's the color I used to wear in their jackets. I've been using Carhartt for outdoor and work clothes since I discovered their brand at their downtown store in Seattle. I really like their work pants and jackets and this won't disappoint you. A lot of big and tall clothes you might be able to find locally are usually flimsy when it comes to outdoor wear and won't last or isn't warm enough with just cheap fabric and filling. This jacket is great quality and you should consider one if your looking for a plus size winter coat. The jacket has a small pocket on the left interior that zips open and shut and a pocket on the right…

reviews.title: Made in the USA
but I like my clothes a bit lose around the shoulders
reviews.text: Typical Carhart quality. Be careful when ordering one of these as concerns size. I normally wear an XL size in just about everything I wear around my shoulders. I'm 6'1" and about 200 lbs, but I like my clothes a bit lose around the shoulders. Probably be a good idea to order this jacket at least a size smaller than your usual shirts, jackets. I ordered a L and it is more than big enough. Even with a couple of layers underneath, it is more than big enough.

reviews.title: First Carhartt jacket that didn't fit well
reviews.text: I ordered a medium fits like a large. ( I'm tall and skinny) It will work okay for when the temp gets down to 15 degrees and colder. That is I can wear it with my heavy winter shirts to stay warm and it does work well with my insulated bibs I like that. The other thing I don't like is the double zipper, but there a pros and cons too that. I may go ahead and buy a size small just when I need a jacket on. I just hope it fits.

reviews.title: Huge arms if you order it tall.
reviews.text: I first ordered the XXXL T because that's usually what I wear in shirts and jackets. I'm 6'5" and around 280 lbs. The arms were enormous. They were too long and very wide, I probably could've fit my legs in them. I then exchanged it for a XXLT. I swear the arms were the same size on a smaller bodied jacket. This jacket seems like it was designed for someone who is built like He-Man but with much bigger arms. I gave up.

reviews.title: NOTHING beats Carhartt
reviews.text:
Ask anyone that's been in the construction industry in cold climates for any length of time and they'll tell ya, NOTHING beats Carhartt.

I know that it has become "popular" for guys that have never turned a wrench or used a shovel to now wear workboots and Carhartts as some fashion statement. And I crack up every time I see a rapper wearing it. Don't expect your Carhartts to fit like designer clothing. Yes, I know Carhartt is now making fashionable wear too, but I don't buy that. I buy Carhartt for one reason and one reason ONLY - they make the best work clothes - PERIOD.

You want warmth and ruggedness? You wear Carhartts. It will last forever. And the best part about the style is that it will never go out of style.....because it was never in style. haha It's built for warmth and ruggedness and not for fashion shows.

Note to folks new to Carhartts: You MUST treat the zippers when new. Use bar soap, candle wax or pencil led. The zippers are heavy duty and work like a bear if you don't lube 'em. Also, the water repelling needs to be replenished after washings. You can buy cans of silicone clothing waterproofing. Finally, Carhartts are HEAVY fabric and need to be broken in.…

reviews.title: As good as you're going to get for this little money.
reviews.text:
I am reviewing the rigid denim 13MWZ, purchased May 2017.

These classic Cowboy Cuts are the best bang for the buck out there. In terms of design, Cowboy Cuts are an improvement on Levi's in many ways that make a difference in everyday use:

1) Higher back pockets. This looks better on asses, doesn't look saggy, and it's more practical.

2) Wider/deeper watch pocket. The Levi's watch pocket is useless.

3) Double-felled outseams, as opposed to double-felled inseams on Levi's. This is more comfortable on inner thighs, and doesn't wear down as quickly.

4) Generally thicker denim with a more durable broken-twill weave. Levi's are 10–12 oz. denim, while most colors of Cowboy Cuts are at least 14 oz., and some are over 15 oz. To be fair, some colors of Cowboy Cuts are made from lighter weight denim, but not the standard blues and blacks (mostly light colors like white and tan, and some grays).

5) Riveted back pockets.

6) Smooth rivet caps so you don't scratch stuff

7) More belt loops

8) Higher waistband, closer to where a waistband should be on most people (at the belly button).

9) Straighter leg than Levi's, from top to bottom. This means they fit tighter in the thighs and ass,…

reviews.title: Know What You're Getting!  They're Different Than Other Wranglers.
reviews.text:
These are well-made, durable jeans, but you need to be aware of some details if you have only worn other Wrangler styles before.

First, compared to Wrangler's "Regular Fit" jeans, these "Cowboy Cut" jeans are much slimmer in the waist, lower abdomen, and seat. Also, the pockets are tight to the jeans and not very deep; a thick wallet is tough to get in and out. Finally, the material is board-stiff when new, and requires many washings to soften up.

Again, these are good, well-made jeans. No disrespect. But they are different than what you may be accustomed to.

reviews.title: Wranglers Wrock!
reviews.text: Wrangler jeans have always been my choice; 13MWZ style is what I have worn as long as I can recall wearing jeans. There's a saying among Wrangler wearers...if they ain't Wranglers, they ain't jeans. For users new to rigid jeans, there will be a learning curve. The denim in not prewashed or prepared in any way, so they are rigid. Washing them 3 times, inside out, before wearing them will get rid of some of the dye and will loosen them up a bit. You should also NOT machine dry them for the first few washes. Just put them on and do deep-knee bends to help stretch them. Wear them a long time before washing again; Wranglers will last a very long time and need some break-in work.

reviews.title: Amazingly comfortable and fitting jeans.
reviews.text: These jeans are perfect! Seriously, they fit amazingly well and look great on me. My butt looks amazing and so does the front side. Looks as I though I may become a wrangler man after all. I have just ordered some more in different colors. I will try to upload some photos for a better view.

reviews.title: Good fit
reviews.text: I purchased the "Cowboy Cut" Wrangler jeans for my husband's birthday. He is particular about the cut of his pants, preferring the regular fit vs. relaxed, so I was a little concerned about what "Cowboy Cut" meant. However, I worried needlessly as these are now his favorite pair of jeans. They fit nicely and look great!

reviews.title: Great Fit and Look, if Unexpected
reviews.text: If you're familiar with Wrangler jeans you'd find at Target or WalMart (with the "Premium Quality" patch on the waist), you might be surprised. Cowboy Cut Original Fit jeans are higher-waisted and fit a little roomier in the thigh than a straight-leg fit, and at first I was skeptical. But these jeans on their own merits are comfortable, move well and fit snug in the seat and crotch just how I like, and the legs fit great and "stack" nicely over boots. Terrific pair of jeans, once I gave them a chance!

reviews.title: First Experience with Wrangler and It's Good
reviews.text:
I decided on these over logger or carpenter jeans because these were not so baggy and had a better body conforming fit. This is the first "rigid" jean I had bought since HS. After three washing, there is a good fade emerging and a better fit. I got them with the understanding they were "shrink to fit". I had bought a pair of used Wrangler 35x32, prewashed, off Ebay as a trial run into this brand since I normally wear 34x31. Those used ones were a bit tight perhaps shrinking some. What I noticed is they did stretch back out.

The Wranglers I got from Amazon were the rigid 36x32. I wore them a couple of days and decided to wash them inside out in hot water, no detergent. I let them air dry after a brief period on low heat in the dryer. There was no noticeable difference in color or size.

The next day I used the jean for gathering firewood and operating the tractor in the woods to pick up what I had cut with the saw. I washed the jeans this time with detergent inside out on hot. I dried them on low heat for 20 minutes and then took them out. No noticeable difference in color or size.

I decided I would give them the full treatment, hot wash (inside out) and hot dry to…

reviews.title: Third time was the charm
reviews.text: I ordered the first pair 33x30 like always. It came way too tight. Then I ordered 34x30 and it came 34x33. The third order was for 34x30 again and it came through 34x30 and it fits just great. Too much work but amazon prime made it go smoothly. UPDATE: DO NOT BUY!!! Here's why: on the second washing they shrunk to where I couldn't wear them. And I bought them oversize: 34x30 instead of 33x30. And no I did not dry them on high heat. I dry everything on the lowest setting. Hope this helps someone. I'm going back to Carhardt even though they wear out too soon. Can't wait for HEMP to be legalized.

reviews.title: Comparison of Columbia Tamiami II, Bahama II, Blood & Guts III, and Bonehead PFG Shirts
reviews.text: Columbia makes some fantastic shirts, but make sure to order the appropriate size. I am 5’10”, 195 lbs, and would typically wear a Large in most similar styled (button-up) shirts, but I have to get a Medium in Columbia PFG shirts. (The Medium is still a moderately loose fit, as the Large is like a tent on me). Tip number two is that because these shirts are on different sizing scale, many get returned to the Amazon Warehouse, so keep an eye for Amazon Warehouse deals on these shirts (see tips to finds the easiest way to compare prices across sizes and colors at the conclusion of this review). I have tried the Tamiami II, Bahama II, and Bonehead (AND new Blood & Guts III – see below for updated comparison including the BG3 series) versions of the Columbia PFG shirts, and have been mostly pleased with all of them. The Tamiami II was my favorite due to the cooling effect of the weave, but the similar Blood & Guts III is now right there with it. My reasoning for giving the Bahama II 4 starts instead of 5, is that out of the four series discussed in this review, it is my least favorite. The Bahama II tends to wrinkle, is not as cool feeling in extreme heat as the open weave Tamiami or…

reviews.title: Yes to the slightly roomy sizes!
reviews.text: Most want to know the size! I am 6 feet, 175 lbs., and always wear a large, 34-35 sleeve. I ordered a Large long sleeve and the sleeves fit perfect. The rest fits a bit big, in the shoulders and body. I then ordered this short sleeve in Medium. Fit is more typical of a large, as compared side by side along all my large shirts. I included pictures and measurements because they tell the truth, I wish more reviewers would also! If sleeve length is not an issue, the medium fits best if you normally wear a large, unless you want that extra room. Being slim and trim, the medium is still more roomier than my other large shirts. Medium body is 24.5", and large is 26" wide. Length from armpit to tail, med. 15.5", large is 16". Shoulders from seam to seam is, med. 21.5" and large 22.5" The sleeve length of a long sleeve is 33.5. on a large.

reviews.title: Fits as expected: Let me help you with sizing….
reviews.text:
My husband is always an XL in everything (very reliable) and the sizing of these Columbia shirts is highly variable depending on style. It’s impossible to see the differences on the models, so I’m happy to explain what we discovered to save you the same hassle. We ordered 3 different cuts in Columbia men’s field shirts. The seamed fairly comparable in quality and UV protection.

Silver ridge 2.0 long sleeve: runs very small. An XL would not fit at all. Arms are also very slender, you would have to order 1-2 sizes up if you have large biceps. A very very slim fit.

Bonehead shirt: runs large. An XL fit but was extremely baggy. We are going to keep it, the extra room could be advantageous hiking in hot weather. This is an ideal shirt if you like the loose, baggy look/fit. We could have sized down one size and it would have still fit.

Bahama: fits exactly as expected. Tight enough to wear to dinner yet comfortable and roomy enough to wear on a hike.

Hopefully this information helps you find the right fit and saves you some hassle. Good luck!

reviews.title: bahama
reviews.text: I love the shirt. It is cool in this hot and humid climate. The one fault I have discovered is the breast pockets are too large and are always billowed out. Other than this the shirt is great.

reviews.title: Awesome shirt
reviews.text: I'm so glad I read the reviews first before buying, the shirt is one size larger than normal, I'm 6'2" 200lbs and I bought a Medium and it fits perfect with room to spare, so trust me when I tell you to definitely order a size down, i tried the Large on in store and it looked like a tent on me so I'm happy with Medium for sure, Columbia PFG shirts are meant to be a LITTLE roomy on you for breathability, the shirt is definitely wide regardless of the size you get, my only minor complaint is that it wrinkles really bad so you'll have to iron it or throw it in the dryer for about 10-15 minutes to get the wrinkles out before wearing it, other than that great shirt!

reviews.title: Great Style & Fit
reviews.text: I have 4 other Tamiami II short sleeve shirts that are always my go to. The material is great for hot weather. I am 6' 215lbs with an old man stomach, and the large fits like most XL shirts. I accidentally ordered this Bahama II and almost cancelled the order. Glad now that I didn't cancel. The fit seems to be a bit more snug than the Tamiami II. The material is not quite as thin but still very nice and cool. I like the pocket flaps to give a bit different style at times. I always wear the shirt tail out, and it is plenty long for that. I did get the white so only time will tell how long it keeps its clean look. I would like to have another few colors of the Bahama II. No way to go wrong with Columbia brand. Thank you Amazon for fast delivery.

reviews.title: Great for warm weather travel and outdoor activities, but still look nice for casual occasions.
reviews.text: Love these nylon shirts. Great for warm weather travel. Can be washed out by hand. They dry quickly if the weather isn't too humid, but will usually drive overnight even if somewhat humid. If you don't ring them out, hang them wet, and smooth out the fabric with your hands, they are quite presentable to wear without any ironing. The back yoke is vented. Front breast pockets have Velcro to secure the flaps and drain holes in case you go in the drink. Button-down collar. So many colors to choose from too and I've received many complements from friends and strangers when wearing a pleasant bright color. The shirt's color will fade slightly after repeated washing, but you could minimize this by not machine washing. The slight fading is not a big deal in my opinion for a pastel casual travel shirt. Obviously, you won't have that issue with white or some of the very dark colors. These shirts are very light to pack and can be rolled and placed in packing cubes. I'm hoping Columbia keeps making these for some time to come. Last word - these shirts run a bit large. I usually like to purchase all my shirts in size 'Large' since I prefer my shirts a bit loose fitting, but in the case of these…

reviews.title: Columbia Shirt Runs Way Too Big, Buy Smaller Size
reviews.text: I read the comments and reviews before buying this PFG Columbia shirt. I ordered the Vivid Blue color in an XS (Extra Small). I always wear medium shirts, but not this time. This shirt fits perfect on me two sizes below what I normally wear. The back of the shirt is very cool. If it was a size small it would have been too wide on me. I'm 6'1'' and 170lbs. Cool shirt, but Columbia needs to work on the optimal size.

reviews.title: Very happy
reviews.text: I received this today ans tried it on right away. I am pleased with the way it fits. I am 5 '2" and weight about 180. I'm only complaint would be it's a little long for me. But I tend to have that problem with clothes with being short. It is a little loose in the sleeves by the wrist. Overall I like this dress and would buy it and another color.

reviews.title: Favorite item
reviews.text: This is my favorite item of clothing I've ordered on Amazon! So comfy, appropriate length, great fit, and there are POCKETS! 5'6, 145, size medium.

reviews.title: Poor fit, sheer, returning.
reviews.text:
I was looking for a simple slightly loose long sleeved dress. However I am returning this. The material is really thin and even in black you could still see my printed bra though it.
The fit was odd. The arm pit area was extremely big compared to the pictures shown. I am 125lbs and 5 4” and I ordered a small.
Pockets were also not the same size. The right pocket was noticeably smaller and I had a hard time fitting my hand in while the left was normal size. The pockets are pointless, the fabric is too thin to hold more than a credit card.

reviews.title: Adorable! Must buy!
reviews.text: So cute!!! 5'7, 150lb... normally a medium. The medium fits great!

reviews.title: Great fit, true to size
reviews.text: Great fit, true to size. I brought this one and the Coffee color. Immediately washed in cold water and even let it tumble in the dryer a bit. The color didn't fade nor shrink. I am 5'7 size 38D size 10/12. I got a XL for a loose fit and more like a dress look to pair with a denim jacket which was perfect because it hit right at the knee. The coffee color I got in a large to wear with leggings/knee boots and it hit right above the knee. I definitely plan on buying more colors. I did appreciate the more you brought the more you saved...

reviews.title: I love this inexpensive dress.
reviews.text: I am 5'0, 130 pounds, 36D. This dress hits me right in the middle of my knee. After reading reviews I got a medium because I have a large bust and a booty. It fits great, is so comfortable, and I love the pockets. It's soft and stretchy, like a good t-shirt. I've ordered two more.

reviews.title: Great t-shirt dress.
reviews.text: This is a great t-shirt dress (size M) and very versatile (I bought three different colors). Since it's still warm where I live, I am wearing it with sandals and thin leggings. Later on, I am planning to layer it with a vest or sweater and boots. Nice bargain too. I am 5' ft. 2 inches tall and weigh 147 pounds.

reviews.title: Great t-shirt dress.
reviews.text: This is a great t-shirt dress (size M) and very versatile (I bought three different colors). Since it's still warm where I live, I am wearing it with sandals and thin leggings. Later on, I am planning to layer it with a vest or sweater and boots. Nice bargain too. I am 5' ft. 2 inches tall and weigh 147 pounds.

reviews.title: XXL - Great top - Hopefully this helps with your sizing questions
reviews.text: LOVE this top. For those with sizing questions, I hope this helps. I ordered the XXL size. I am 5'4", 204 lbs., 42C. I usually wear an XL or 0X. With that being said, this top fits great on the upper part, however, please know that if you have a "spare tire" around the middle, this top will accentuate this part of your body. I loved the sleeve length for those who have heavier upper arms and the arm holes are large enough to accommodate heavier arms. The v-neck is respectable and not too low whatsoever. This top is somewhat longer but does bunch up at the bottom which of course it is intended to do. It does narrow greatly at the bottom so the material does cling to mid portion of your waistline so if you have larger tummy area or spare tire, it will show more. The top is not very see through at all so you do not have to wear a cami under it if you don't want to. I do hope this helps those with sizing questions like I did when I ordered it. Great summer top!

reviews.title: Great shirt but color was off
reviews.text: I bought the grey one in large. I'm a size 10 and a large chest and it fit perfectly. I ordered the heather grey but when it arrives it was much lighter than expected. The fabric is clingy and unforgiving if you have curves or bumps you don't like pointed out, I recommend a darker shirt. I thought this one was darker so that is why I bought it.

reviews.title: Comfortable and light shirt.
reviews.text: I am overweight and I am 330 lbs and 5'2 if that helps anyone. I got 4x size.I know there is not many reviews where people are my size and try and buy clothes. I am pretty happy with these shirts. I got three colors. The sleeves are even better then I expected, sometimes I feel shirts will have tiny sleeves and these were just how I would like them to be. The shirt is long and can cover my butt when I wear leggings too. The shirt does cling to my belly but I just do have a big belly I guess, I carry most of my weight there. The shirt is still very comfortable and breathable. Its light and I like that because I live in very hot weather. I am very happy with these and I am glad I chose these tops because I spent a very very long time deciding on what ones to buy.

reviews.title: They are comfortable tops, perfect for summer or hot climates (I ...
reviews.text: I got this in a XXL in a few colors. The material of these tops are light and airy. They are comfortable tops, perfect for summer or hot climates (I have summer year round). I'm 5ft 11" and wear 42DD and find this top adequately roomy in the bust area. It also falls great at the waist with enough material to sit above the hips or below if that's what you prefer. I do wish that I had bought a few of my tops in a XXXL so that it would have fall off the shoulders a bit. I found the sizing in all 13 of the tops that I bought to be the same. Whether I wear these casual with jeans or dressy casual, this is a great top.

reviews.title: "JADE" is beautiful
reviews.text: My interpretation of this shirt in Jade is that it is a greenish turquoise rather than a yellowish green that you find in some jade. To give you a visual, my turquoise necklace harmonized with color or this shirt, and I have a jade necklace which clashed with it because it looked more green. Therefore the color is a little more bluish than in the picture on the product page on Amazon, which was a nice surprise because I like that color better. Also, I usually wear a Small or X-Small top, and ordered the Small, which was very roomy. I am glad I did not size up as some reviews had suggested. It had no wrinkles after I washed it by hand and drip dried. Not sure how long the fabric will hold up, it is somewhat thin, and I would imagine a lighter color in this shirt would be more see through but this one is not. I like it so much that I plan to order two more colors.

reviews.title: Love it!!
reviews.text: Love this shirt, it's cute & comfy... I'm 5 5 I ordered a Medium it fits perfectly... I'll be ordering in more colors :)

reviews.title: What color to order next?
reviews.text: I recently purchased 2 maxi skirts and wanted a form fitting (but not skin tight) top to pair with them. I am 5'3 have a wee bit of a "paunch" (I'm working on THAT one!) and not one to flaunt my upper arms except at the beach....in my bathingsuit... up to my neck... in the water! (Yeah, I'm working on that too!) That being said, I read the reviews for assistance in which size to order. When not a form fitting top, I'll order a M. In this case I figured L would do and in white. It arrived earlier than expected. Immediately I took it out of the package and tried it on. I LOVE this top! It looks and feels fabulous and fits very much to my liking. I can pull it up so the shirring is more around my belly making it appear smaller (yaaaay!). The sleeves are a perfect length and when I lifted my arms and you can't see up the sleeve. The material is like that of a stretchy tshirt. AND best of all it's made in the good ole USA! It's ok if it's a hand wash/line dry. It's worth it and the price is right too!! I just ordered it in Black and Purple just before I wrote this review! Thank you, MBJ!

reviews.title: Love this COZY top!
reviews.text: Wanted something professional enough to wear during online teaching yet comfortable enough to hide COVID weight. I carry my weight in my belly, have always had curvy hips & a round bottom. If you do not want to draw attention to the belly, this top tapers at that spot but shirring helps hide it a bit. Material is stretchy. I am a 36C & bought a large. Fits PERFECTLY! Has plenty of space on top if you are a bit bustier.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised....
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised by the quality, fit, and price of this turtleneck shirt! Also, quite warm w/o being itchy! It has been coooold up here in the Northeast and this fit the bill perfectly! I hope this was HELPFUL?!

reviews.title: Great TNeck!
reviews.text: Everyone (including myself) Loves this turtle neck!

reviews.title: Very good value
reviews.text:
I ordered two navy blue, one white and two black turtlenecks. All the same size: men's large. The white and the blue shirts were shipped separately from the two black. I tell you this because the two shipments made a difference in the fit of the shirts. The shirts arrived within the time promised, a day apart.

The shirts' material is a cotton/polyester blend which feels quite comfortable on the skin. The white and blue shirts fit perfectly (I am 6', 215 lbs.). Arm length was just right for me (I am a 35" sleeve) and shirts fit around the chest, waist and, very importantly for a turtleneck, around my 16" neck. Not too tight, not too loose, whether wearing the neck rolled down a little (as I prefer) or full length extended up to my chin.

The black shirts also fit well in the arms and around chest & waist. Where they failed for me was in the size of the turtleneck, much too large and too much of a gap for me to use whether rolled down or fully extended. Even after washing in hot water, the neck was still too large. As a result, I will not wear these and will give them away to the local thrift shop. My guess is that the neck would probably fit someone with a neck size 17…

reviews.title: Great fit. Functional, wish the neck was larger
reviews.text: I like the texture, and the size was truly true to fit with the appropriate width and length. Very comfortable and smooth. I wish the actual turtleneck was larger/more pronounced, as to me, it's slightly subdued... But complicit. I like to wear turtlenecks with blazers to give that smooth, mature, outside the box look while everyone one else wears a tie. This is serviceable enough especially for the price. Buy your true size... It'll fit...i.e, I'm 6 ft 2, 225 lbs, long arms with some muscle, so an extra large is very comfortable for me without it being too large (no swimming here!) Or too tight (getting rid of a little holiday belly). If I had no belly I would go for size large for that nice sexy but not ridiculous tight fit.
