Get your true fit, only sizing up if you're relatively small but have a little extra belly. I got it in black and in white.

reviews.title: Buy this turtleneck NOW
reviews.text:
This turtleneck did what it was supposed to do. Full disclosure - my friends and I all ordered this awesome piece of finery for our close friend, Mike’s, bachelor dinner. Why would a group of adult males choose to ALL wear this garment to a formal dinner? Because the groom (Mike, previously mentioned) still dresses like a swinger from an awful 1970’s exploitation film. His style hasn’t evolved since 7th grade, when our mothers dressed us like we were failed extras in Starsky and Hutch.
The irony? Mike was the only one to show up not wearing a turtleneck. We looked awesome. So the joke was on him.

reviews.title: I've never looked better.
reviews.text: I have a feeling for big things on the rise, like when I predicted the dot-com bubble when I was in grade school and predicted the St. Louis Blues would win the Stanley Cup in 2019 way back in 2007. Turtleneck as high fashion is coming back in a BIG way and if I were you, I wouldn't be lost in the mix looking like a chump with a cold neck. Put simply, I look amazing in my Turtleneck. This warm weather in June is not going to stop me. Shall our paths cross, you shall see me sporting my T-Neck in casual and formal environments, even as the mercury rises to triple digits. I may have to buy another as it has become quite laborious to wash it every evening. All I can say is stop what you are doing and buy this essential garment.

reviews.title: Nice turleneck
reviews.text: We got this as a costume, and the shirt is actually very nice quality. I don't know if my husband will wear it again, but I might borrow it on colder nights. Recommend if this is what you're looking for!

reviews.title: comfortable, long lasting
reviews.text:
A bit warm for summer, fine for winter. I've had these for a year or two and they hold up well.
UPDATE:
Another year gone by and these shirts are like new. The fabric doesn't pick up odors quickly- I can wear them several times between washing. I recently had to wear some old cotton turtlenecks with a similar heavy fabric. They felt stiff, uncomfortable, scratchy, and they didn't move with my body as well as these shirts. I'm changing this from 4 to 5 stars, but beware another review claims that the 2018 version of these shirts is a thinner material.

reviews.title: Overall really cute, despite a few flaws. Good quality for the price.
reviews.text: Overall, this jacket is really cute. It fit pretty well, slightly short in the torso, but it's not as short as a bomber jacket. It has the fit of a true motorcycle jacket. The leather is really soft to the touch, but a little too squeaky...that may buff out as it gets worn more...who knows. The inside zipper hoodie is a cool idea, but a few inches shorter than the outside (see photo). It looks awkward wearing the inside zipped and the outside unzipped. It fits good for me, except when I wrap my arms around to do the shoulder test, but it's not unbearable and it's still wearable. the hood is a little small, but it works. You can completely unzip the hood and the inside zipper if you don't like it. The inside is NOT a full sweater, it's just an insert...it does not have sleeves attached to the hooded part, which I like because it doesn't make the jacket bulky or heavy. Overall, I love this jacket despite it's few flaws...I will definitely be keeping it. To give you an idea of the fit, I ordered a XXL and I am 5'10' and 200lbs with a long torso and broad shoulders.

reviews.title: Not a bad jacket, sleeves are a bit short
reviews.text: This jacket does look the same in person as it does in the pictures! I got a small and overall it fits alright, but yes, the sleeves are a bit short (I'm 5'2" and have pretty short arms and I can't comfortably wear it with my thumbs in the thumb holes; they rub pretty bad. I'm sure if I kept this the fabric would wear out really fast). Beyond that there's really nothing wrong with it, it's pretty cute.. not sure it's worth $50, but not bad.

reviews.title: love it!
reviews.text: love this jacket! super cute and comfy. really good quality for being feux leather. I ordered a medium and it fits as expected (I'm 5 feet tall, about 130 lbs, 34c bust)

reviews.title: My new favorite jacket!! 10/10!
reviews.text: I cannot recommend this jacket enough! The size is perfect, the quality is stellar....it's just a great buy! I am 5'2, 125lbs and I usually wear between a small and a medium. I got the small and it fits like a glove! I like a fitted look, so there's no room for a thick hoodie in this size. I would say buy a size up from your usual if you want to layer it. This is a VERY flattering jacket! This is my new favorite! I even want to start learning how to ride a motorcycle it looks so good! 10/10 for me!

reviews.title: Dream Come True!
reviews.text:
Update: it's now almost January of 2020, and I bought this back in 2016. Still going strong! Still my favorite leather jacket currently owned, and I have many :)

Absolutely love this jacket!!! I had another faux-leather jacked from TJ-Maxx and after a few years the back was falling apart to the point it looked like a bear attacked my upper back, haha. But I am actually pretty (*cough* extremely *cough*) picky, and couldn't seem to find a new one in any store that I liked enough to replace my old one in ANY store/mall. I found this and loved it. After seeing all the mix-moshed comments about the sizing/fitting, I was a little nervous on what size to order it.
I'm pretty tiny, (about 5'3 or 5'4 tall, and about 110/115 pounds), and I wanted it to be fitted since it was leather, but the only thing I was worried about was length - I dont care if its suctioned to my skin tight, but I hate when a jacket barely comes down far enough to kiss my jeans, so I ordered a Small instead of a XS. It fits absolutely perfectly!
The fabric is amazing, it looks phenomenal - EXACTLY like the picture! Believe it or not this was basically my first online order, and I am beyond ecstatic!
If I HAD to put a…

reviews.title: I'm in love!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this jacket. Not only is it super cute alone, I really love to switch out the inside zip in for my different colored zip up hoodies. And the biker collar and overall stitching/design is totally badass. I love it!

reviews.title: unflattering fit for pear-shaped gals
reviews.text:
I was so excited for this jacket and was pleasantly surprised by the excellent texture and color when it arrived. However, it was apparently designed for someone with stick-thin arms who is 3-4 months pregnant.
If you're pear-shaped your probably don't want your waist to look bigger than it is. This jacket kind of floats out in the front for no good reason. As other reviewers suggested, I ordered a size up (medium) which had juuuuust enough room for my arms. I'm athletic so my arms aren't tiny; unless your arms are pencil thin, this jacket is not for you. My two pictures show how the jacket naturally lays compared to how it looks with my tugging it back so you can see how much excess material there is. How sad. For reference I'm 34b chest, 25" waist, 41" hips.

reviews.title: Great purchase!
reviews.text: The jacket I ordered was exactly what it showed in the picture. I am very happy with my purchase. I bought the dark brown jacket with the hood to wear to an outdoor fall wedding and it will be perfect. It is heavier than I expected which is even better. I normally am a medium but after reading some reviews and looking at the size chart I went with a large and am very happy I did. The length of the jacket is a tad bit shorter than I'd like but nothing to complain about. I am 5'6 and about 150 pounds. I had read a few reviews about the quality of the jacket seeming cheap and flimsy but this jacket looks and feels very well made. I can't wait to show it off!

reviews.title: SHOWSTOPPER
reviews.text:
This coat is just as beautiful and quality looking as the product photo. The shape did not disappoint. Once steamed the coat falls just the way that it should. The black fur even looks just the same. The only thing that I ran into is that the upper arm movement seemed a little restricted, but that typically happens with a lot of things I order especially online. However, I know that if I go up a size it will be too baggy in the mid-section. Zeagoo clothing runs very true to size so I wasn't worried about that. If you are on the fence about buying...simply jump off the fence now and purchase because I can tell that this coat will be a showstopper for me this winter!

It does have pockets. I am size 6 in dresses; 34DD bra; Medium to Large in tops on here.

reviews.title: SCAM COAT NOT AS PICTURED. NO SHAPE LOOKS LIKE IM WEARING A JUMBO BOX OR TENT
reviews.text: SCAM! It was HUGE even when I button it. NOT AS POSTED AND I HAVE TO PAY RETURN SHIPPING. THEY HAVE BEEN GIVING ME THE RUN AROUND ABOUT MY MONEY THAT I HAVE TO CONSTANTLY GET AMAZON INVOLVED IN. I FILED A CLAIM WITH AMAZON AND GOT ALL MY MONEY BACK. NOT WOOL AT ALL CHEAP CARDBOARD TYPE OF MATERIAL. Literally there was NO SHAPE TO THIS and the shoulders are unflattering. LOOKS LIKE IM WEARING A TENT OR A FAKE FUR BOX. HAD TO PAY RETURN SHIPPING FOR A CHEAP QUALITY MATERIAL FROM CHINA. AMAZON IS INVESTIGATING THIS SELLER! SHOULD HAVE LISTENED TO THE ONE STAR REVIEWS!

reviews.title: I picked the right company to buy this coat from
reviews.text: Love this coat I wanted this coat for two years but so many bad reviews but one reviewed helped a lot by saying another company had this coat and it was not the original because she loved the coat and it looked exactly like the picture she couldn't have been more right however the other websites had it listed for a lot lower price this is the actual coat threw Zeagoo. Around $89 and it is exactly as the picture and I thick wonderful warm coat I'm so happy that I took a chance and got this coat I waited for a long time because it came all the way from China about 4 weeks I am about 5 5 and weigh about 135 lbs i got a Med and the arms fit and it's still big enough I can wear a sweater or warm clothes underneath it as well I didn't want to write a review at because I feel like this coat would have been sold out two years ago , if it would have been for all the bad reviews lol and I like being original , but for sure another company was scamming people taking a picture of this coat and selling it and it not being the same coat the coat looked a little alike but by far the same coat people was saying , however this company the original company that has the right coat the Blue violet is…

reviews.title: HIGH QUALITY.
reviews.text:
I ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS COAT!
ITS PRECIOUS!!
I HIGHLY RECCOMEND IT AND I CAN SURELY TELL YOU IT IS TRUE SIZE.

IM 21
I WEIGHT 152
MY HIGH IS 5'6
I ORDER LARGE
IT WAS JUST A LITTLE BIG, BUT JUST A LITTLE! HOWEVER IT FITS ME PERFECT.
VERY FAST SHIPPING...
I POSTED A LOT OF PICTURES FOR OTHERS TO SEE IT.
IT IS JUST WHAT I WAS EXPECTING.

reviews.title: Adorable and Surprisingly Warm!
reviews.text: My favorite coat right now. I grew up in the Mid-West and experienced my fair share of winters (22 of them in fact). I am now a full Floridian who cannot deal with the cold. So when my girlfriends and I decided to plan a Girls' Weekend in NYC at the end of January, I knew I needed a coat that was cute, but more importantly, something that kept me warm. This jacket did both so well! I wore a regular long-sleeve shirt underneath and the coat completely blocked out any cold and wind as we walked around the city. I purchased a few other coats and none of them fit nearly as well as this one did. Needless to say, I am beyond satisfied with this coat and have started planning another visit up north soon just so I can wear it again!

reviews.title: Cozy and Cute!
reviews.text: This coat is not only completely adorable but it's pretty well made. I'm a picky person on comfort but this has met my standards. The fabric is soft and thick and buttons are not likely to fall off ever. Hope this lasts long! But my only problem was the size, I'm a small type but the sleeves were a little constricting and short and usually when I order small it fits perfect. So I suggest u get a size up on ur order!

reviews.title: I LOVE IT!!!!!
reviews.text: Absolutely Amazing!!!!! Its a must buy .... Now I'm thinking of buying it in red !!!!!

reviews.title: AMAZING!!!
reviews.text: SUPER CUTE! Also very warm! I bought a 2x in case it was too small but it's actually bigger than I thought. BUY YOUR ACTUAL SIZE. Still very comfortable. I love it! And it even came with matching leather gloves!!!

reviews.title: Love love love!!!!
reviews.text: Love love love this Cardi!!! It’s super soft and feels warm. I am not a brown/tan person so I thought I’d broaden my closet a bit and the color is beautiful. I will DEFINITELY be buying this again in Another color. I’m 5’5” 145lbs and wear a size 10 and I ordered a Medium and it’s perfect.

reviews.title: Cute sweater
reviews.text: So I don't normally buy clothes on amazon but wanted a cute, casual sweater so decided to give it a try. Found this one somehow and it had good reviews so went ahead and ordered it. I actually had it shipped to an amazon locker as I didn't want anyone stealing the package off my porch and when I went to pick it up I was shocked at how small the box was and thought at first I got the wrong item. Opened the package and it was vacuum sealed in the box, hence why it fit. It's pretty soft and comfy so I will keep it. I also like the color fine but was expecting it to be little more turquoise I guess, not as deep as the color actually is. All in all a good first time clothing experience. If you are wondering about sizes to buy, for reference I am 5'8 and 135 lbs and bought the size small and it fits perfectly.

reviews.title: Soft, Light and Perfect weight
reviews.text: I love this cardigan! I love the color which is like a black raspberry ice cream. It is super soft and I know will be versatile for layering.

reviews.title: Beautiful and cozy
reviews.text: It’s soft and cozy , not to mention beautiful. It says dry clean only I haven’t washed it yet but I plan on hand washing and drying flat.

reviews.title: Beautiful sweater
reviews.text: This sweater is amazing. I'm 5'7" and usually a size 6/8. I ordered a small and it fit perfectly. Long enough to wear it with leggins. I received many compliments.

reviews.title: Love
reviews.text:
I ordered the L and XL in maroon which are both pictured on me and then side by side. I'm 5'9" 165lbs and found that the XL gave me that oversized fit like on the model. I wasn't able to wrap the L around me, it sat higher up on my thigh and the sleeves were tighter and shorter (as expected in a smaller size). The XL was perfect and I went back and ordered more!
One other thing that was interesting. The 2 sweaters side by side in the same color but different sizes were different shades and felt different. My Large was very thick and tightly woven wheras the XL was a lot looser and more drapey, and not as tightly woven. Lastly, others say this is SUPER SOFT. I don't feel its the softest ever, but it's very cozy and snuggly. Love it.

reviews.title: Perfect purchase
reviews.text: Love love love! This is by far my new favorite cardigan! Super soft, stylish, and I love the length. I absolutely am very happy. True to size for me.

reviews.title: Perfect fit/Nice & warm
reviews.text:
Bought this for me Bride of 21 years for her Birthday & she absolutely loves it! Her arms & hands are constantly cold! She really likes sweaters and this one is now one of her favs!
1 thing though...it states that it should be dry-cleaned...I washed on hand-wash cycle & in the dryer for about 4-5 mins...then draped over a hanger so as not to get shoulder points...perfect! Hope this helps everyone!
Thanks for reading my review!

reviews.title: Well I'll Be Darned
reviews.text: Hey ya'll. SOOO, i definitely lost sleep worrying about this dress not fitting me, not shipping soon enough (for a wedding i have tomorrow... my fault on that one), and ruminating after reading ALL, okay, not all, but a lot of the reviews. Going back and forth between those who gave 5 stars and those who gave 1 (and everything in between). Ultimately, i wouldn't know if the dress would fit until it came in. I had prime and selected one day shipping. Good news, with a few delays, it arrived on time! A lot of people were saying how it came crumpled in a bag, and while the dress was indeed wrinkly, it did not look like it was crumpled. I've seen worse. It came in a clear zip lock sort of bag inside a plastic shipping bag. I've had bridesmaid dresses shipped in similar bags and the dress was fine. I tore open the bag and was impressed right away at the color. It looked just like it did in the pictures. I put it on (slipped it over my head because ain't nobody got time for those buttons) and was impressed i could fit it over my shoulders. I have not been blessed with boobs any larger than a B cup and mind you I'm 5'6" and around 240 pounds. No boobs. Which might actually be a…

reviews.title: it looked so flowy and beautiful! I twirled a lot when I put it ...
reviews.text:
From reading the reviews, I was expecting a very tight fit so I decided to go with medium to be safe. I'm 5' 8 and about 140 and 34D. It was a bit larger than I had hoped for. The shoulders were a little far apart on me and the waist could've been a a few inches smaller. All that aside, it looked so flowy and beautiful! I twirled a lot when I put it on because I love the way it fans out. It makes me want to frolic in a meadow! Also, it is very, very comfortable. I got it in the "light green" Looks great paired with my yoga slings, too.
*If you found my review helpful, please let amazon know and hit the "helpful" box below! 😊

reviews.title: Very pretty but wish I got my normal size.
reviews.text: Love this dress after reading all the reviews I went up in size. I normally would buy a large but bought an XL. I'm exchanging for a large. I'm 5'8 170lbs. I wear a 10/12 in clothes. This dress is roomy.

reviews.title: SO many compliments!! Seriously buy this dress!
reviews.text: I bought this dress on a whim and was a little skeptical about it. I have never received so many compliments on a dress before. I wore it on a trip to the Biltmore Estate with my husband and in laws and we honestly couldn't get through the day without someone stopping me every few minutes to ask where I got my dress or to tell me how gorgeous it was. It flowed beautifully on that windy day. I'm obsessed with it, I even bought two more in different colors. I highly recommend!!!

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text:
Such a beautiful dress and it's so cheap! I loved it for my beach trip. Wash it in cold water and air dry it. I did such a cool photo shoot in it! ❤️
I got so many compliments on it!!

reviews.title: Comfortable and Pretty Dress
reviews.text: I LOVE this dress. Ordered the black/red. Colors are as shown. I checked at all the reviews on sizing and decided on Medium and it fits beautifully. The empire waist leaves lots of room for someone with a larger bottom half. I am 5'5" and 145 lbs. Most of my weight is in belly and butt. My measurements are 37-29-39. I wear 36B and buy size 8 or 10 dresses (depending on style) and 10 or 12 in skirts and jeans. The back of the dress just misses the floor in bare feet. I hope this helps in deciding what size you should order. Although you could probably order six mediums and each may fit differently. Hope that's not the case here. I also ordered the Pink but shipment has been delayed. This is a really pretty, comfortable lightweight dress. The darker color is not too see through, but I would wear a slip if going out someplace (other than the beach or around home. I am a girly girl and feel so much better in dresses. If you're the same, this dress is for you.

reviews.title: Don't wash in washing machine
reviews.text: I loved this dress. I had purchased one a year before and have worn it numerous times as well as washed it in the washing machine (cold) and dried it in the dryer despite no label with washing instructions. This dress fit the same (XL), looked great, and felt great on. The label said machine Rayon, machine wash cold, dryer low. I now have an extra small dress :( All that said, I may purchase again knowing it will have to be dry cleaned.

reviews.title: Terrible cut
reviews.text:
Terribly cut!!!!
I bought this a few weeks ago for summer. I had yet to try it on. It is cut so poorly that there are inches of difference on the bottom from one side to another!!!!
This is frustrating, yes I should have tried it on upon receipt but how could this go so unnoticed at quality control.... maybe there was none.

reviews.title: I like the Goodthreads cardigan’s look and feel but the size runs small.
reviews.text:
I ordered three Goodthreads cardigans - all size large. The cardigans were received within three days of purchase. Upon trying each one of them on - it became apparent that they fit me like a medium and not like a large. I ordered the washed black, heather grey, and washed grey colors. I received the washed black and heather grey colors, but I mistakenly received a washed olive color in lieu of the washed grey color. Given that I will be returning all three in exchange for size XL - that color mishap is a mute point. Unfortunately, Goodthreads is out of size XL washed black color, so I will revisit that option at another time.

Worth noting - I took a picture of my JCREW blue cardigan (size large) lying adjacent to the Goodthreads washed black (size large) cardigan. The JCREW cardigan is definitely larger than the Goodthreads cardigan even if it may not be readily apparent in the photo. With that said, I recommend you order a size bigger than you normally would if you are accustomed to wearing a JCREW cardigan.

I’m 5’9” - 178 lbs - waist 32/33 - with more of a Mark Wahlberg build than a slim Ryan Gosling. If you are 5’9” and slim - like 150 lbs - then size large will probably work…

reviews.title: Actually paid for it and love it
reviews.text: So I actually purchased this item and wanted to leave a review since the rest were people who got it for free. I was apprehensive about getting it due to that fact but I figured free returns id give it a shot. It is awesome. Seems really nicely made, nice and heavy, and fits well. If your looking at it id get it, its a great deal. I'm 6' 210lbs and got an xl for reference.

reviews.title: Great Purchase
reviews.text:
This turned out to be exactly what I was looking for. I work in a large grocery store and the bosses keep the AC cranked to the max, which is uncomfortable on an 8-10 hour shift. This is warm enough to wear over just a T-shirt when the temperature is 60 or even the high 50s (early in the morning when there are no customers it's genuinely that cold in there), and I'm a hot-weather guy who normally thinks he's freezing to death when the temp gets that low. I'm six feet, just under 200 lbs, and bought the 2XL, which is slightly too big, but that's what I was after; I can easily pull my hands up inside the sleeves when they're cold, and it hangs down just past my...well, past things below my belt that can always use a little extra warmth. Super soft, not even a little bit itchy, and the collar is thick enough to keep my neck warm, too. I adore it!

Are there no negatives? Well, I wish the pockets were bigger. That's it, though. If you're thinking about buying a new cardy, I can definitely recommend this one.

reviews.title: Wash and dry seperately. be prepared to pull lint from washer and a full dryer trap
reviews.text:
The sweater was correctly sized and appears well constructed except for the fabric which shed lint straight from the package. Thought it best to wash it before giving to brother who lives in assisted living facility. After washing (by itself thankfully) I spent about 5 minutes pulling small gobs of sweater colored (red) lint out of washer drum and off of agitator. Cleaned dryer filter before drying (thankfully) and then dryed on low heat using wool balls as anti static /softeners. After drying, filter was packed with fluffy fabric lint. Another run through the dryer on cool air showed that a majority of the lint was gone.

The fit and construction were good but the fabric used was nowhere close to being ready for use. Not a bad price for the product be be aware that you should look at it carefully and be prepared to launder ASAP.

reviews.title: Exceptional bargain
reviews.text: Thick material, fit as expected and the color is nice. I’ve been looking for more types of these sweaters. They are perfect to lounge in, throw in to run out or wear over a dress shirt. Guess I’ll need a few more in other colors.

reviews.title: Nice for the price
reviews.text: I purchased the olive sweater. I initially purchased a large since I wear a large shirt. However, the large was too big. I am 5'10, 150 with a long wingspan. I exchanged it for the medium. I loved it so much I then ordered two more (a black and gray sweater). It can be steamed to get the initial wrinkles out. Mulitple people have commented how they liked the look and feel of it. Overall, it is worth the price of $40.00 each.

reviews.title: Nice Cardigan!
reviews.text: This is a very nice sweater, well made, nice color and so on. However, my husband is a med-large fit and we ended up sending back the large for an XL, especially since it is cotton and almost always cotton shrinks no matter how you wash it. We also ordered a second one in a different color so he has two now and wears them often.

reviews.title: Sweater ripped apart in less than a week
reviews.text: My new cardigan sweater ripped apart in just a few days of arriving. I would advised against anyone from buying this sweater.

reviews.title: Great light, stretchy, comfy cardigan
reviews.text:
I love the fabric and the feel. It looks great. I am wearing a red long-sleeved shirt under it and the shirt underneath is NOT showing through the white. That's pretty impressive. The little drapey pleats in the front on the photo are not really there, that's just how it's hung on the mannequin for the photo. But it has plenty of fabric in the front and looks good wide open or closer together. It's perfect for my business-dress office job.

I am 5'6, 150 pounds, and I got a size Large. I normally wear a size medium, depending on the fit/cut, but I wanted to wear this over long sleeves for an extra layer (my office seems to be air conditioned in the winter!), so I got a large. It's a perfect fit.

reviews.title: What the heck?

There are also…

reviews.title: One of my favorite tops now

I have large hips and sometimes the bottom bands on shirt just don't go over. But not only did this fit over my hips and the material is stretchy, it didn't stretch out at all and retained it's shape. I tend to be self conscious about my upper arms being exposed, but these sleeves are perfect. The lining fabric stops like a tank top, so only the chiffon-ish fabric extends as a sleeve. reviews.title: Adorable, stretchy, but a bit snug
reviews.text:
I bought this in an XL after seeing some other plus sized/curvy ladies rock it in the reviews. I usually wear a 16/18 and am a thick hourglass shape.

The fabric is a nice dark black, and the tag says it is 97% Polyester and 3% Spandex. The stitching on my dress is perfect. No loose threads, no crazing serging excess, and the hem is very nicely finished. The zipper is gold and the pearl pull on it is super cute. As for fit: straps are nice and stretchy, but the dress is a bit snug for me. It was difficult to get zipped and would be too tight to leave zipped and slip over my head to get on. Husband had to help me. I was hopeful that the length would be just enough since i'm 5'4", and the front goes just above my knees but the back BARELY covers my ass. The tiniest bit of bending and whew! I may add some lace to the bottom for just a bit of length.

Overall, it's super cute and will make a nice once in a while item to layer.

reviews.title: Super cute!

If I do order them, I will usually get the largest size and hope it's large enough. I decided to listen to the reviews for this skirt and get the 2XL instead of the 3X and I'm glad I did. I'm 5'2" and about 200lbs and the 2X fits PERFECTLY. It's a good length, the elastic is comfortable around my waist when it's zipped up, and it just looks good on me. It's a very flattering piece and I can't wait to finally wear cute clothes more often instead of my usual jeans/t-shirts. The little pearl on the zipper is such a sweet touch too! And it's SO SOFT! The only issue I ran into was that the zipper stuck a little right out of the bag. Nothing a little wax can't fix. I will definitely be getting this in the pink color as well.

reviews.title: Does not feel like the classic Levi’s
reviews.text: When these jeans arrived, I thought they were fake. The denim felt thin and cardboard stiff. But I wore them a lot and washed them a little, thinking it was just a problem with new jeans. My first impression was correct. I’ve owned several pairs of these exact 511 Levi’s, but this was the first bought online. I don’t know if these are “fake,” but these are not like the Levi’s you’d buy at a department store. While the jeans look fine, the fabric is very thin and it has not gotten any softer with age - which is what happens with real denim. What upsets me is that I didn’t save anything buying on Amazon; it was just convenient. I’m sticking with department stores for jeans from now on.

reviews.title: 3 belt loops missing
reviews.text:
I recently bought a pair of these Levi's jeans. Upon arrival, I tried them on and they fit and looked perfect. I then left them in my closet until today where I wanted to wear them. This is when I discovered that the 3 belt loops in the left side were missing, making the jeans basically useless for me because I cannot wear the jeans with a belt!

The return window closed some weeks ago, so I cannot return the jeans. I have tried to find a way to make a complaint to Levi's through Amazon, but it does not seem to be possible.

I hope someone from Levi's or Amazon will notice my complaint through this review and get in contact with me.

Thanks

reviews.title: they’ll make you look like Townes Van Zandt
reviews.text: I switched from 501s to 511s a couple years ago, after putting on a few pounds. I have a beautiful mistress and her name is Modelo Especial. Feel me? I found that a 32x30 as opposed to a 30x30 in a 501 was a bit too baggy for my taste. The 511 solved this problem, offering a slim fit that comfortably accommodated my slightly bigger waist size. These pants are lightweight, comfy, and breathable, and are a nice balance between the lumpy potato sacks favored by your dad and the sort of painted on skater jeans that pair best with an Avenged Sevenfold hoodie. Beware though - these jeans seem to run a little longer than they used to. I recently had to switch from my normal 32x30 to a 32x29, which fit just right. Good luck, and say hi to Poncho & Lefty for me!

reviews.title: These jeans have been really hit or miss in sizing depending on the style you get.
reviews.text:
I am 6' and 180lb and bought 32x32 Rigid Dragon, New Khaki and Rigid Grey. I had previously bought the Jet Black and they fit just fine, so I was excited to revamp my jean drawer.

Unfortunately these three did not come as expected.

Rigid dragon: Baggier in the calf for some reason. Had to make sure I'd bought the same Slim Fit, and I had. After a wash, they fit perfectly.

New Khaki: Came in way too baggy. I felt like I was wearing snow pants, especially because they make that *swish swish* sound when you walk for some reason (only pair that does this). Drying on high heat got these to a managable but not ideal fit :/

Rigid Grey: These had the worst change. They came in baggy just like the New Khaki, then after a regular wash shrunk significantly. I still gave them a chance and am currently sitting here in my office, ankles uncomfortable cold. I have to wear them lower at the waste than is comfortable just so the bottom of the jeans touch my shoes when standing. Heaven help me of I stretch my legs out or bend my knee though, leaving my ankles and above bare.

It seems different styles have different fits. Really disappointed after finding one good pair, then paying over a…

reviews.title: Love Them ❤️

Some of the designs are sorta skin tight depending on your body type but I don’t mind I prefer a snug fit. Would highly recommend getting a few pairs of different colors just to have some variety, also the sizing is on point I wear 30/32 and they fit true to size I hope this helps those who are trying to decide to purchase 👍

reviews.title: the best 511 style in my opinion
reviews.text:
Different colours of the Levi's 511 jeans never fit quite the same. It must be intentional since they are so disparate. It may also have something to do with in which country they are made.. Some 511 styles fit very tight at the waist while other 511 styles fit looser at the waist. Then there are some that fit very roomy down the leg while others are quite slim.

The Rinsed Playja fits normally at the waist but it's slimmer down the leg than most of the other 511. The 511 sequoia is very roomy by comparison and longer too. It's obviously simply a function of each individual's build which 511 suits one best. For me, rinsed playa is the best 511 style.

reviews.title: Nice looking jeans, very thin fabric.
reviews.text:
Got these jeans for my husband who is picky. They fit as expected and he said they were very comfortable so they would have been great but they wore through in the front around the pockets in less than 4 months. If he had been out horseback riding in them or doing construction work maybe it would be more understandable but instead he was wearing them to a desk job.

I understand that because these are skinny jeans they need a percentage of spandex in them for stretch but that's no reason to skimp on the sturdiness, especially at this price point.

reviews.title: Perfect fit, perfect look
reviews.text: I haven't worn Levis in years and I'm really glad I got a pair of 511s. They're slim but not skinny. These are my absolute best fitting pair of jeans and I plan to get a few more pairs in different colors. There's enough room in the thigh area and throughout the leg to be comfortable while still being and looking like a slim fit jean. What's really nice is that the flex material isn't just all over. It seems to be strategically placed in places where you'd need it most. Around the waist is where I notice it the most. I never have any problems zipping or buttoning these jeans at the waist because of the flex feature. I have lots of other jeans that fit me all over but for some reason don't want to button at the waist and make me feel fat. These are the same size and style as jeans I've been buying from the Gap for years and these are so superior and cost far less. Wish I'd have given Levis a second look years ago.

reviews.title: Wher is the gator?
reviews.text: What the hell happened to the alligator. They have this new "icon" on the front that is not the classic reptile. Back in the day you were nobody without Izod shirts and a members only jacket, This bastardized shirt does not coordinate with the classic look we all know and love. Back in high school I had a friend who's mom would buy the Izod socks just for the little alligators (they were cheap). She would take the embroidered carnivores and sew them on a cheap polo type shirt and voila: instant ersatz Izod shirt. I miss the good old days. Bring back the gator.

reviews.title: Nice...very nice shirt
reviews.text:
The 60/40 IZOD shirts are some of my favorites. The fabric is soft and durable and the colors do not fade much if at all. One thing I have noticed is that the fabric will shrink a little, even when laundering in cold water, delicate cycle and drying with low heat. Normally I wear between an XL or 2XL but I buy these in 3XL and run them through a regular warm wash and a hot drier as soon as I open the package. This shrinks them to close to perfect for me--still big and loose with room for air circulation to help with cooling in the summer. Order your normal size if you like a snugger fit.

IZOD shirts are generally fairly reasonably priced. Amazon often has some colors and/or sizes on sale prices and that's when I buy. I'm not that particular about colors. Being on sale is why I ordered this in "Real Red", normally a little too bright for my taste. After wearing a few times, I actually have begun to like the color.

reviews.title: Five Stars
reviews.text: Wonderful Grest shirts. Reordered two more

reviews.title: Favorite shirt but...
reviews.text:
As someone who lives and dies by the polo, I found the IZOD Advantage Performance polo to be THE shirt to buy when you're looking for the best bang for your buck. The material is a little heavy if you're a golfer (of which I am not) but perfectly suited for offices and dinners. So this shirt meets a lot of criteria and that is reflected in my order history which shows that I have ordered seven (7) of these in the past three years.

The Good:
Athletic cut, perfect length sleeves and the material slowly retains its shape so it never really stretches out during normal wear and tear. The color holds up extremely well under heavy washing schedules as in my climate (Southern USA), you can't wear a shirt more than once without washing. Also, there is very little shrinking that occurs so you can be reasonably assured that if you accidentally dry on high heat, you won't see too much of an effect.

The Bad:
As a guy that is into fitness, the bands around the biceps tends to begin unraveling at the seams under the arm where they intersect with the band after a period of a year or so. You will develop holes there. Additionally the last three shirts I ordered were almost embarrassingly tight…

reviews.title: Shrinks!!
reviews.text: Beautiful shirt, fits somewhat small and even smaller after washing. Have worn and washed this shirt twice, cold water both times. First time, hung to dry...turned out ok with minimal shrinking. Second time, decided to put into dryer on low setting...considerable shrinkage. Quite disappointed!

I'm no longer young (Daddy was feeling his oats when Ike was in the White House) and much of the vanity that plagued me in my youth has dissipated. Be forewarned as you continue reading, that comfort, not appearance, now tempers all my purchasing decisions. It was time to purchase a couple pairs of jeans, and because Eddie is getting awful pricey, I decided to see what was being offered here on Amazon. The price was right, and the reviews were good, so I ordered a pair of these "just to see". Boy, I'm I glad I did!! These jeans are designed for guys who want comfort over a full range of movement. First, the material; although the description says "flex denim", it is not "stretchy" (remember double-knit?). I think they may be referring to…

reviews.title: These are made of denim, magic, and sorcery!
reviews.text:

I'm 5' 7.5" and I've always had a small waist relative to my hips and butt, and when you add that combo to long legs?! Fuhgeddaboudit when it comes to finding pants and jeans with the right fit...or so I thought until I tried these babies on.

To terribly exaggerate, once I easily fastened them, colors were brighter, lights shone down from the heavens while denim-tuxedo clad angels sang Ginuwine's "In those Jeans!"

In the real world, I made my husband stare at my hips and butt as we both marveled at how amazingly these jeans fit. I even had jeans left at the ankle, and that is HUGE for me. I got 2 pair to try on through Prime Wardrobe and I'll be getting all available colors now that I'm aware of this magic. Thank you to Levi's and Prime Wardrobe for changing my life! reviews.title: Some colors are skinny and others are jeggings.
reviews.text:
Different colors of these jeans do not fit the same. I was looking for a mid-rise, skinny jean. I ordered 2 different colors. Bae and Immaculate. Bae was perfect. Waist hit just below the belly button. They are skinny from thigh to ankle without being skin tight. Very, very comfortable and cute and I'm able to wear them to work. Immaculate is more of a High-rise, Jegging. Waist hit right at the belly button, which is uncomfortable for me after a couple of hours or when sitting. From thigh to ankle, they are skin tight. I have to really pull to get them past my feet. Cute for going out, but uncomfortable and inappropriate for work. I wish they hadn't lumped all these jeans together. I want another pair of the true skinny fit in a different color, but don't want to end up with another jegging.
FYI - I'm 5'6, a curvy, ample-bottomed 150 lbs., and wear a 12M.

reviews.title: Poor quality. Returned.
reviews.text:
I was so excited for this piece to arrive based on the reviews I read, but disappointed immediately after opening the package.

It came well packed, snapped up and folded in a clear plastic bag. As I unsnapped the shirt to try it on two of the snaps fell apart in my hands. "Are you f****** kidding me" I uttered as pieces of the new shirt rolled in between the floorboards. Further inspection of the shirt revealed other snaps were misaligned, and stitching misplaced.

reviews.title: READ BEFORE BUYING.
reviews.text: I purchased this jacket for my husband's birthday. The pictures on this jacket look phenomenal and exactly like something he would wear - and the pictures on the ad are the exact same jacket you will receive, however it's very hard to decipher the texture that the exterior of the jacket is made of. We were expecting it to be a soft suede like cotton material and although it is soft, it's definitely more of a water repellent cotton that appears almost silky and shiny like a faux leather in person. It's a very well made jacket but the exterior was not at all what we were expecting. After inspecting the entirety of the jacket, all the buttons and stitches were perfect and the jacket had a nice heft and a very good looking cotton flannel lining that did exclude the interior of the arms. We can't tell you how the product will wash or last because we just received it but we were very surprised upon opening it because of the texture and appearance of the outside of the jacket. The tags match up identically to the ad's listing of the jacket's material (Shell - 63% Cotton and 37% Polyester, Body Lining - 100% Cotton, and Sleeve Lining - 100% Nylon). reviews.title: Same Sizes, Different Fit
reviews.text: I actually ordered two golf shirts for my husband from Amazon Essentials, a yellow one and a white one. Both of them are labelled XXL, as I'd paid for, however, they each fit him differently when he tried them on. The yellow shirt's sleeves are noticeably tight around his arms. And what's more is that the left sleeve fits his arm tighter than the right. Definitely poor tailoring. Once he tried the white shirt, we could both tell the difference immediately, as it fit him the way a XXL should, loosely comfortable. I've been impressed with the quality of Amazon Basics' tech accessory products so far, but I'm a little disappointed with their venture into clothing.

reviews.title: Comfortable work shirt

UPDATE 3/27/2017: I have sent this shirt through the washer AND dryer 3 times now and it still fits perfect. It did not shrink or become uncomfortable like other shirts I have bought in the past. I would definitely recommend this shirt and I hope Amazon releases new styles/patterns soon to have more of a variety. I'd replace my entire wardrobe with these shirts.

reviews.title: A great shirt for the price
reviews.text: I bought several colors from this line about six weeks ago and they've been worn / washed multiple times. Usually, I'm wary of inexpensive polo shirts because they typically either look cheap or the collar frays relatively quickly. So far, I'm very happy with this product. Two considerations to keep in mind ... First, the sizes run large; I normally wear medium size shirts but ordered the small size based on reviews and they fit great. Second, while the fabric looks nice, it is relatively thin; this makes them great shirts if you live in a warm / humid climate but I've begun wearing a thin t-shirt (i.e. the kind worn under dress shirts) with this polo.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text:
Good value. All polyester is not the most comfortable feel for me but first, it means it won't shrink, and second, it is better at keeping me cool when I'm exerting myself.

These definitely run large. I'm 6'2" and 200 pounds, overall kind of scrawny but with a modest spare tire around the middle. What I hate about buying shirts is that medium usually looks like it's spray painted on, and large flaps around me like a mainsail, with sleeves so huge that I look like a kid wearing dad's shirt. I ordered these in medium and they are just what I want. Not clinging to me around the belly at all, but not yards and yards of extra fabric. The sleeves have some extra room--maybe even a bit more extra than I'd prefer--but I don't look ridiculous.

I was on the fence whether to order large. Glad I didn't! I bought some Arizona medium polo shirts in a store recently, and got large--they are if anything smaller than these!

One other thing, these are plenty long enough. Another thing I hate about buying mediums is when they are just short enough to expose part of my belly. No problem with this shirt.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Not sure what's up with people's expectations but this is a $15 polo - and frankly, the first in years that's fit like it should. Better than ones 4x the price.

Because you see, this guy's sleeves actually come down to your inner elbow. The way polos USED to do before someone thought it was a good idea to make "smedium" sleeves. Ugh

About the only thing I don't like is that it's 100% polyester, rather than a blend. As a result, it's on the thinner side. Consider a wife beater or something underneath for maximum comfort.

EDIT: another thing specific to white/light colors, they stain easily and the stains don't come out easily. Likely a material issue.

reviews.text: [[VIDEOID:cf7d82d8d6b73a6ef7e0b7761d220cc1]] I ordered 5 or 6 of these shirts . First the good . They fit good , material is good , I like them. I would actually order 10 more . reviews.text:

reviews.title: SHUT UP AND TAKE MY MONEY
reviews.text:
Oh. My. God. Shut the front door and slap your grandma. Hold on tight because these jeans are gonna get you pregnant. I’m too hot, call the police AND the fireman. Songs immortalize fantastic behinds and if you’ve never felt like the subject of those songs then buy these jeans and buckle up! You’re about to feel like a honkytonk badonkadonk, baby got back, fat bottomed girls, and your anaconda is about to make girls go, “oh my gawd, Becky!”

Now that the funny part of this review is over... shut up and buy these jeans. Buy ten pairs because Lord knows as soon as you find a pair of jeans you like you’ll never find them again. I am 4’11” tall, 173 lbs, 45” hips, 33” waist (definitely pear shaped), and I can never - I mean NEVER - find jeans that fit me. These are the right length. They fit my hips. They don’t gap at my waist. And this inner tummy slimming panel? Oh sweet baby cheezus YES. I have a two year old, an awesome mom pouch, and a healthy love of bread. These jeans make me look even better than I did before I grew another human being. Literally ditching every other pair of jeans I have and stocking my entire wardrobe with these.

reviews.title: Amazing Fit & Comfort!!!
reviews.text:
These are absolutely amazing!!! The reviews were great, but I was still skeptical because I have a very hard time finding jeans that fit well and are comfortable. These are amazing!!! I carry the majority of my extra weight in my stomach and despise any type of pants that cause muffin top, so I tend to order bigger rather than smaller to avoid that. The result is usually pants that won’t stay up and I am constantly pulling them up all day. These are perfect! They are pull on, so no buttons or zippers. And they somehow stay up, yet are not too tight in the waist. No muffin top, and no falling down. The legs are snug but very comfy. And they are flattering. A miracle! I am going back to buy the darker color right now!

So now the important part. You came here to see what size would fit you best, so I won’t leave you hanging - the most helpful part of a review is the stats. Without them, the review is basically useless. Nothing worse than people who write, “these fit great!” but then give no stats. So here you go: I am just under 5’9, about 200 lbs (+/-), and typically wear size 14-16, depending on fit (again, I hate tight waists, so I am probably a 14 but always size up for comfort).…

reviews.title: These jeans are so wonderful. I am 35 and a mother
reviews.text:
These jeans are so wonderful. I am 35 and a mother. I love my body but most jeans today are not made for moms. Here is what I love

1. They stretch but do not become loose after wearing. I do not have to keep pulling these up after I have had them on for awhile. They keep their shape!
2. They are stretch material but are also jean. They look like jeans, not stretch material.
3. They allow me to move comfortably while knowing my parts are securely covered.
4. They come up a little higher but not too high.
5. The waist allows for some give so there is no muffin top even if you in fact have a muffin top
6. Emotional peace. It is hard to recognize that it is time to start purchasing women's jeans. Women's jeans are often awful. These jeans are made for a woman's body but do not look like women's or mom jeans. So I get to feel comfortable while wearing jeans that look youthful!
7. MY BUTT LOOK AMAZING!!! I do not get to say that often but holy smokes, it's looking nice ladies.

Update: after washing and drying I probably should have got a 18. A little snug. Also, I'm a pearish 5'4, 220 shape....the pic are with a 16S.

reviews.title: Best jeans I have EVER owned!
reviews.text:
The fit: there is a meshy band (like heavy duty pantyhose) across the belly that completely eradicates my "Mommy" tummy. I have a little pooch, loose jiggle, and sometimes it buldges if the waist line pinches. The waist band on these secures and FIRMS my entire waist - no jiggles or buldges. Then there's my rear, which isn't so perky anymore. These grab my cheeks and pull them up - my butt isnt flat in these. My inner thighs are smoothed out, and cellulite is hidden everywhere.
The fabric: they feel high quality, well made. Soft, but durable like a denim/canvas - and they stretch and give when I bend/move without loosing shape or stretching out of shape when I srand back up. I wore these to 3 childrens birthdays in one day and still felt so confident in them to rock to a friends party that night.

Size: I am 5"11, 160, bought the black long in a size 10 and they fit great. ps - the long still barely hits my ankle bone, but at least thats better than capri length.

These pants are magical and I am SSOO bummed the other colors are out of stock.

 I did order their recommended similar jeans (skinny, signature, totally shaping) but they zip - dont have waist band and dont lift my rear…

reviews.title: Perfect summer shirt!
reviews.text: Honestly, love how thin it is. Perfect for summer days and soft enough to not have that stiff texture. Getting more of these for sure. Bought it at a size Small being a 5'5 skinny female.

reviews.title: Reviews are right! Shrinks in wash
reviews.text:
I've had really mixed results ordering stuff like this from overseas manufacturers. I trusted the reviews and ordered one size up. When it arrived I almost sent it back - it was way too big. But I washed and dried it and sure enough it shrunk by at least a size. (Ordered xxl, shrank down to a roomy xl.)

Great shirt. Super light. It washed well - no weird puckering or twisting on the placket like you so often get with this type of cotton material. It's so light, who knows... it may disintegrate in a few months. For $20 if I get a spring and summer out of it I won't complain!

reviews.title: Sizing is... weird.
reviews.text:
I was going through reviews trying to figure out the sizing. I gathered that most people had gone up a few sizes-- some people had gone up 3 sizes, etc. so I figured I'd play it safe and get an extra-large instead of a medium. I probably should've gotten a large. The extra large was really long, but not SUPER long so I'm guessing a medium would've been too small. For reference I'm a 5'7" 150lb female.

The shirt itself is cool? It looks like described. The material is very thin, not great quality but it's alright. Overall I'm satisfied, I just wish the sizing was a little more accurate lol

reviews.title: Loungewear for a louche
reviews.text:
Are you trying to capture a late-era Gary Busey vibe? This is the shirt for you. There is a real 70s dirt bag vibe with these shirts that makes me want to read the rum diaries and hit on middle age ladies at the nail salon. I’m trying not to buy any more of these shirts so I don’t quit my job.

They are kinda loose and flowy by design. I usually wear xl in most things but enjoy the streamlined look of a large. You might be tempted to buy your normal size. But ask yourself: what would late-era Gary Busey do? He wouldn’t care about his gut. He’d button it up half way - at most - and get trashed at happy hour at Hooters. Screw it I’m with Gary. Time to buy a couple more of these.

reviews.title: Upgraded to 4 stars
reviews.text: Upon arrival I thought this shirt was too big for me. I am 6.1 / 185 lbs and I ordered L size which is what I always wear. However these shirts are at least one size larger and I felt like wearing a XL. My initial review was quite negative because I didn’t like the fact that the sleeves reached my elbows (quite long for my taste) however this is what you see in the pictures so I shouldn’t be expecting something different. The material is a bit light and the white is a bit transparent but not a terrible problem since you are not paying any premium here. I bought 3 and after washing them the initial smelly tint odor went away, so all is good now. You also may need a scissor to cut some small threads from the buttons but again, the price for these are a bargain. Can’t speak about durability yet because I rotate them frequently but all in all, these are good / decent shirts that you won’t regret wearing after a wash or two. Go for them!

reviews.title: Stains too easily, tired of replacing them
reviews.text:
Won't be ordering any more of these. Any food that gets on them leaves a stain that never comes out. I've never had shirts stain so easily. If you spill a drink on it, it beads up and rolls off, which is cool. But any kind of sauce, oil, anything with fat will instantly and permanently bond to the shirt.

On the plus side they fit great and look nice. Fabric is thin and cool. I wear them every day as work shirts. But I can't be replacing them constantly because I get a little dribble of salad dressing on them.

reviews.title: Durable and have retained original shape and color for 6 months.
reviews.text: I purchased these polos 6 months ago for a new job. They are extremely comfortable and have retained their shape and original color after all this time. I work in the food industry so staining is usually an issue but not with these and the collars have retained their original shape and haven't buckled with use as you see with many jerseys. The only complaint that I would state that I have is that they are a little larger than your average US size. I bought extra large sizes and they are more like the average US XXL (I am 6ft tall and 220 pounds). So in conclusion a great value for your money, just make sure you actually go by your chest measurements and don't assume that they will fit like the average polo.

reviews.title: Fake Jacket
reviews.text: The jacket I received is a fake. I also ordered a tall to compared the lengths. See pictures. The tall jacket is on the left off the 1st 3 pics and the bottom on the last. The fake jacket does not have Columbia embroidered, it is a sticker of some sort. Also the tag on the inside is different as with the "Omni-tech" on the sleeve. The fake jacket does not have "Packable" on the inside of the pocket. The jacket appears nice and I would have not questioned its authenticity if I didn't have the tall jacket to compare. I am returning it.

reviews.title: Gump
reviews.text: I got rained on this past weekend. I'm talking forest gump rain. I was the only dude who was dry. And so was my cell phone so I could look at the radar and see that the flood Noah talked about was truly here.

reviews.title: Columbia or Amazon couldn't verify counterfeit
reviews.text:
Based on the other reviews I couldn't verify if the item I received was authentic or counterfeit. I got a replacement and both items had a non embroidered chest logo, missing packable tag in the pocket, and a non diamond omnitech logo on the left sleeve.

I called Columbia and the best they could do is verify that the product number on the tag matched the number in their system, which it did. They couldn't address the concerns listed above.

I contacted Amazon and they also couldn't verify if the product was authentic or counterfeit and will open an investigation.

reviews.title: Nicely Made (and a word for you if you're on the L/XL line)
reviews.text: I am on the border of large and x-large with most my clothes (36" give or take waist). From other reviews, I read it's a little big, so decided to size down and went for the large. It fits nice with a t-shirt underneath, but not a lot of extra room for my... ugh... expanded mid section. With a fleece mid-layer, it's a bit snug me. So if you're right on that L/XL line in most your clothing due to an over-indulgence in yummy trail treats and plan to wear over thicker clothing, I'd go with the XL. But if you plan to be using it as a summer raincoat over just a tee for hiking and so on (that's my plan with it), then I'd go with the L. It's really that fine of a line for me.

reviews.title: More Than a Rain Jacket
reviews.text:
A Review of the Columbia Men’s Watertight Rain Jacket

The Columbia Men’s Watertight Rain Jacket is a lightweight waterproof jacket with a slim design. As the name suggests, the jacket is very much capable of keeping you dry on a rainy day; however, its value goes way beyond a rain coat. Here are several features that make this jacket a wonderful addition to your wardrobe.

Waterproof and Windproof
This jacket is truly waterproof. It helps you stay clean and dry even in the pouring rain. With the waterproof technology comes the wonderful stain repellent feature. No matter how dirty the jacket gets during a rainy day, a simple wipe is enough to take care of it. The windproof feature provides an extra protection against the cold. Meanwhile, the fabric is still breathable that it allows moisture vapor to move away from the skin. The only downside is that the waterproof feature can post difficulty when it comes to washing this jacket. You may find a pouch of water when you take it out of the washer. An extra cycle of drying will take care of the issue if this ever occurs.

Design
This jacket is lined with a soft layer of mesh and is very light weight. The longer arm length and body…

reviews.title: Five Stars
reviews.text: I feel very happy with my new Rain jacket, from amazon!!

reviews.title: NOT Waterproof at all!!!
reviews.text:
I bought this to go hiking on the Inca trail in Peru. Even though it was rainy season, luckily we had no rain.
But, then I took it on a trip to NYC where I wore it during a rainstorm on the way to a house lunch. Was dry for the 15 minute walk in light but steady rain. Hung the jack up to dry. When I went to put back on the jacket, the moisture had SOAKED ALL THE WAY THROUGH the entire jacket. Like putting on a wet washcloth. Very disappointing.
The jacket looks nice, feels well, but most sincerely very NOT WATERPROOF AT ALL.
Never washed or did anything with jacket.
Seller: If you think I got a bum jacket, please let me know. Would try another to see if works.

reviews.title: Good Buy
reviews.text:
I ordered it with a 20% off code from slick deals and got it for around $38. It is lightweight and waterproof. For those of you who are worried about the Packable part. The Jacket can be rolled very small and you can actually pack the whole thing into the front left pocket! 3x4x6 inches would be my guess. Rough estimate. Point is no need for an extra bag and it can be packed.

On the size front. It fits perfectly while wearing a sweater that isn't too thick and keeps me pretty warm. I am 5'9 and 165 pounds. With an athletic frame ( Asian if that matters )

Warmth:It is just a shell so if you get cold easily, and want an all in one jacket this might not be for you.
 I plan to take this with me where ever I travel and will be layering so this should be prefect for me.

Hope this helps. Worth the money in my opinion.

reviews.title: Inconsistent sizing
reviews.text:
OK, here's the problem... These are really great work pants (especially for the price), but I'm not certain that I can buy them online again.
I usually wear size 34 waist, 32 inseam. I bought a pair at the local hardware store, in that size (without trying them on) took them home, and they fit great!

I liked them so much I decided to buy another pair, and saw them on Amazon for a few bucks less. I ordered the same size and model, and when they arrived I was surprised to find that they did not fit. I literally took off my first pair (the ones that fit so well) and then put on the new pair... (so I did not put on a few pounds!). No go! I took measurements of both pants to compare, and found that the new pants were 1.25 inches smaller around the waist and .75 inches shorter in the length (and this is before washing)! The only difference I could find (other than measurements) between the two pants was that the first ones were made in Honduras, and the second ones made in Nicaragua. Normally, I might just say that these pants run a bit small, and that I need to size up. But who's to know where the pants are made before you buy them?

Anyway, sent the new pair back to Amazon, went back…

reviews.title: For small hands only
reviews.text: The fabric seems durable and fit-and-finish is good but the pockets are designed for girl-hands. Normally, the pockets are tight but if you want to "deep- carry" a folding knife, the pocket becomes useless for anything else. The back pockets are ok but would be better with a flap or something for some extra security.

reviews.title: Comfortable But Comes Out Of The Dryer Feeling Like Crumpled Sheet Metal
reviews.text:
Pants fit a bit smaller than the regular brands (Wrangler, Levi). My biggest issue with these pants is they come out of the dryer looking like a Prius that got sandwiched between two freight trains. Not just wrinkled, but holy jumping batshit wrinkled. The kind of wrinkled that your iron looks at and says, "Oh hell no!" Surprisingly comfortable for pants that come out of the dryer feeling like crumpled sheet metal.

These pants are not worth washing at home. Just take them to the cleaners and tell them NO STARCH. They're already hard enough to break concrete if you drop them.

And for those of you who may think I simply overloaded the washer and dryer.... the photo i submitted was from a small load with only these pants and 4 tshirts. I thought the same; maybe I'm overloading it and they cant tumble right. Nope, these pants just suck like that.

reviews.title: Being cheapened and QC going downhill
reviews.text:
Update on 12-11-21 Purchase.
I really need to find another similar type of work pants because this is just getting stupid. Until now I had at least gotten lucky with pretty consistent sizing. This pair is pretty good in the waist but the entire rest of the pants are really baggy compared to others I've bought and I've been buying/wearing these for years. And everything else I said below in my original review still stands. Even if you win the QC and sizing crap shoot they've removed 2 belt loops, made the fabric thinner, and seem to be making them fatter/baggier in the crotch and legs. These used to have 7 belt loops, fit maybe just a hair looser than a normal pair of jeans, and were nice heavy canvas and lasted much longer. They were awesome. Now the heavy weight ones are about the same as what the light weight ones used to be. And they have fat stove pipe legs, I guess to pacify the handful of weirdos that complained they wouldn't fit over their moon boots. I've only ever worn these with work boots and there was never an issue. They would have fit over cowboy boots the way they were made 15 years ago. I don't know what kind of ogre was having problems or what kind of astronaut…

reviews.title: Even a blind squirrel...
reviews.text:
I've been rather harsh on Dickies apparel in other reviews (shirts, pants, socks). But these, I must admit, have been exceptional. I bought two pairs of these jeans over two years ago, and I wear them -- well, one pair at a time -- every weekday at work. I perform field repairs at various sites, often very dirty. I do a lot of kneeling, sitting, climbing, bending, etc. I am 6'3" ~185 pounds and the 38W 36L fit well and feel comfortable.

Alas, these have finally sort of worn out. One has an open knee (the right, which is always the first thing to go on my pants), and the other's thigh pocket is open inside (small tools fall through to my boots). The two side-thigh pockets are perfect for holding my LED flashlight and a smallish tool, which probably has simply punched through the material. The ring pocket is great for holding my wedding ring (which I do not wear on the job). The major pockets, fore and aft, have held up, no holes, even after using them for about everything. Minor fraying, but o other rips or defects.

I tend to wash these after two days, sometimes daily, using my machine's Power Wash, which has probably hastened the wear -- but it gets them clean : a tribute to my…

reviews.title: These Run Small and are Cut Tight - Not Comfortable
reviews.text:
Let me skip to the end for a second and reccomend another style Dickies that work much better for me. I have found the following style Dickies that fit true to size, and they are more comfortable than the style covered in this review:[[ASIN:B00B6EAKGI Dickies Men's Relaxed Straight Fit Lightweight Duck Carpenter Jean, Timber, 34x30]]

I ordered the "Moss" color pants in 34x30, which is what size I wear in 90% of my pants regardless of brand. These were extremely tight in the waist, and although the inseam is long enough, they have a very short crotch section that is particularly uncomfortable. The rigid texture of this pant accentuates the tightness and discomfort of this pant. I can button them, so they are not completely out of size range, but every time I try to bend or sit, I'm either singing Soprano or the waistline is gashing into my gut. A secondary complaint related to the fit is that the pockets are so tightly sewn to the pant that it is…

reviews.text:

I work in the Railroad industry and these pants have proven to be as durable as they feel. I used to have to by 10-15 pairs of pants a year due to wear and tear and the 5 pairs I purchased all look new and are 8 months old. reviews.title: Poor quality
reviews.text: Poor Quality, got the pants on April 9th and they are falling apart in less than a month, all the seems are coming apart. The picture shows one of the seems.

reviews.title: Nice long sleeve t-shirt for SUMMER / WARM weather use.
reviews.text:
This is a nice long sleeve t-shirt for SUMMER / WARM weather use. Construction quality is good / very good.

It is NOT a heavy weight t-shirt. I wish it was, but it is not. It is not chinssey 'paper thin' either, it is somewhere in the middle of a great heavy weight T (the old Jerzees T shirts I still have and love) and a el' cheap-o T shirt.

If you buy it with the intentions of keeping some sun off your arms in warm weather, for that purpose you will be satisfied. In cooler weather I wore this long sleeve T and another print screen type heavy weight short sleeve T over the long sleeve T. This layered combo worked great for 50 - 60 degree temps.

Sizing; I ordered the medium, and it was slightly small. Given a wash and a dry in the dryer (shrinkage) and it would have been too small. I sent back the mediums for Large. The large fit me perfect. I am 5'11+ (almost 6'), 44 chest, 33 waist, 185 pounds.

Hope this review help you. If yes... give the review a vote ! Thanks !

reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: Bought this for my partner for our family Christmas pictures and it turned out better than I thought

reviews.title: Good shirt
reviews.text: Ordered a medium & was a good shirt. Was comfy but just a little roomy but not that big of a deal. I'm assuming i can shrink it if it tried & it won't be as roomy since it's 50% cotton.

reviews.title: Fit is on the mark!
reviews.text: I bought this long sleeve t shirt to wear for outdoor exercise when the weather cools down a bit. It's nice and light, and wicks moisture. The one aspect of this shirt that makes it stand out for me is the fit, which is spot-on for the marked size. I am pretty much a perfect size medium (5'8" and 160 pounds, with an athletic build) but in some cases I get stuck buying a large because the medium is too tight across my chest and shoulders. In those cases the large is always too long in the body and arms which makes it look and feel sloppy. This Jerzees shirt is proportioned just right for me in my actual size. This will be my go-to brand for this type of shirt from here forward.

reviews.title: Works for men and women
reviews.text: I’m a 5’8 155lb female. I got a small in both the black and white. Fits well. They are thin shirts though. Not thick. And the white is a bit see through, which was kind of expected.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: I bought this for myself because womens long sleeves are too expensive for a piece of clothing. I just needed an undershirt for my uniform. Fits good and is thin which is perfect. For reference I’m 5’5” and 105lbs, I usually wear womens XS or S.

reviews.title: Light weight, good for exercise, but seams open up at the cuff and need mending
reviews.text:
I needed lightweight long sleeve large roomy shirts for hiking (long enough to cover my behind) and these do the trick well enough. I thought I wanted cotton, but the 50/50 blend and the light weight really works much better than my heavy cotton shirts which just get heavy with sweat as opposed to these shirts which are light enough to dry as I hike.
My one gripe is that of the 4 shirts I bought, THREE of them sprung a hole in the same place - the seam on the arm right by the cuff. The seam came open and on one of the unraveled so that the whole cuff came off. I put a few stitches on the seam near the cuff on the others and they've been fine.

reviews.title: Look great, "breathable," snug fit
reviews.text: Well, they're a little snugger than I expected, but I love the fit. They are not tight at the arm pits, it's just intended to be a form-fitting shirt. Very nice. I am a tall-ish woman with arms 3/4 inch longer than "average," so the sleeves of shirts and tops made for women are always too short. A men's size small has been my go-to for decades. These shirts seem to "breathe" well. I am active in an unheated part of a large building and wanted long sleeves, but hopefully not a fabric so thick that I can't cool off during the times when I have a lot of lifting and shuffling boxes to do. These are perfect. They have a lovely, soft feel, not nylon-y. I've been washing them on the delicate cycle, drying them half way dry, then hanging them to finish drying. I think the instructions are just wash/dry, but I want these to stay new looking. Quality shirts.

reviews.title: Apparently they have adjusted the oversize issue because it fits as expected.
reviews.text:
My husband is in between a medium and a large. He prefers to go with large but can get away with a medium. Based on the reviews (which I see now are from a few years ago) I thought he would be swimming in this jacket if I bought the large so I went with a medium and it fits him perfectly. So if it runs big, it is only slightly, maybe 1/2 size. Since it is 100% cotton flannel I am a bit concerned about it shrinking when washed/dried but he doesn't want me to switch it out for a large. He really likes the look of this jacket and I find it to be quality. The flannel is very soft, the layered look makes it special (and the reason I paid more than I wanted to for a flannel jacket-worth it) and it's the ideal warmth for Fall months in Maryland with averages in the mid 50's.

UPDATE: We are almost into December here in Maryland with temps in the low 40's and my husband has not taken this jacket off. I love it when I get something right! He can be really picky. Glad I didn't wait until Christmas to give it to him which was my initial intent.

He washed it and if it shrunk at all, it was minimal. Relieved.

Another Update: 2019 My husband has already broken this jacket out this year. It has…

reviews.text: I bought on Men size because I really like the style . I ordered size small . I'm 122 lbs 26 waist 32 C .

reviews.title: Lessen Your Expectations
reviews.text:
2 big Cons-
1- Sizes run VERY big. I am 6'3" 220lb and the XL looked like i was 10 wearing my father's coat.
There seems to be a disparage in the quality as well because the 1st one I received (XL) was heavier weight and seemed a bit better made whereas the L-Tall seems a bit lighter and less overall
2- Regardless of Prime marking, you will not get this item quickly.

Summary
In all, it's a good piece of clothing. Had I not seen the better made XL, I would have been happy with the L. Order a smaller size than you think and knowing that you won't get it right away, and you'll be okay.

reviews.title: dont buy this garbage.

reviews.title: I like my cold gear kind of baggy/loose

Enough room to lair up underneath, but not super puffy looking. Super happy with it.

reviews.text: It is beloved by receiver. Great gift!

reviews.title: Fits perfectly
reviews.text: I was a little worried about the blazer but once I tried it on, it was so cute. It fit perfectly. I’m 5’7, 197, small C cup and bought the extra large. My frame is athletic with strong shoulders.

reviews.title: Order usual size...size chart is not accurate to fit
reviews.text: I bought the orange and it was true to picture color. I do not feel the blazer is “stretchy” since it has a full liner with no give but I was not looking for this feature. Now the sizing: I am 5’1” and exactly 130 pounds. I wear a size 8 comfortably and usually medium tops with a 36B bra size. The size chart put me at a size S for this blazer with accurate measurements taken. I opted to follow suggestions to order “usual size” which for me is a M despite the size chart measurements being much larger than my actual ones. The medium fits perfectly and I am able to button the front. Sleeves are a little long but I expected that since I usually buy petites. The size S would have been way too small.

reviews.title: Stiff Fabric
reviews.text: This blazer looked good on me from certain angles, but I felt like from other angles it made me look boxy. The fabric is thick and a bit stiffer than I would ideally like, so unless I was standing or holding it just right it wouldn't really conform to my shape very well. I ended up sending it back.

reviews.title: Met expectations perfectly
reviews.text: I am 5'4" and 145 lbs, and would normally buy a small. After reading these reviews, I learned that the product runs small and to order at least one size up. Since I didn't want it to be 'baggy', I did just that. The sweater arrived within a week of ordering it (I am in the US) and I love everything about the fit: near form-fitting but not too tight, except the length. It's very long and I am not a long torso'd person. It is a thick sweater (think sweatshirt), but not too bulky. I have yet to wash it, it just arrived today, and hope it shrinks just a little when I dry it. Oh, the laundering instructions, from what I make out, definitely says NOT TO WRING DRY, to wash in 30°C / 86°F (does not specify machine or handwash), and I am not sure about how they expect you to dry it, but I am going to try the clothes dryer on a light heat setting at 10 minute increments. Wish me luck!

reviews.title: Solid, stylish sweater with a few caveats
reviews.text:
This is definitely a good buy. It's soft and warm. It looks great and you will get compliments on it. That said keep in mind a couple of things:
1) Pay attention to the sizing here on the page provided by the seller. You will need to size up if you are a Westerner. I wear a US Large size and a XL in this sweater. This will be snug on you even with sizing up, which is great if you want to show off your gym body a little. If you want something a little looser you need to size up two sizes.
2) It will smell a little funky/chemically when you first get it. Wash it once and the smell will go away.
3) If you tumble dry this on high it will shrink a little. Dry this on low or lay it flat to dry to make sure you don't cause it to shrink.

reviews.title: Super warm and comfy
reviews.text: This sweater is very warm and comfy. It is definitely not classic sweater knit fabric but it very soft and looks well made. The collar comes up high but that just adds to the warmth factor. Fits perfectly and can wear another shirt underneath. This is definitely something you would not wear underneath something else.

reviews.title: Stylish sweater
